title: 半導體製程工藝
summary: 以 20 個模組、520 個學習步驟，拆解晶圓製作、元件、微影、薄膜、蝕刻、互連、量測與製程整合。
summaryEn: Twenty modules and 520 learning steps explore wafers, devices, lithography, films, etch, interconnects, metrology and integration.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學拆解；模組編號是學習順序，製程分支與實際前後關係另有說明。520 步不代表任何廠商的完整量產配方或固定製程數。所有步驟使用明確標示的代表照片；重複使用照片不等於每步專屬實拍。操作為原創概念模擬與工程推理，實驗資料需自行提供或查閱來源。
scopeEn: Educational subdivisions based on public principles. Module numbers describe learning order; process branches and actual dependencies are identified separately. The 520 steps are not a proprietary manufacturing recipe or universal process count. Every step has a labeled representative photograph; reused images are not step-specific process photography. Activities use original concept simulations and engineering reasoning; measured data must be supplied or obtained from sources.

summaryEn: Study nanosheet devices, contacts and backside power delivery. A process-node name is not the physical size of every feature.
scope: 公開原理的分層工程教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務，並非原廠配方、施工圖或操作許可。
scopeEn: A layered course in public engineering principles. Steps are verifiable learning tasks, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, or operating authorization.

title: ASML 微影機系統工程

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例
workedExample.text: 假設隔離樣本中有 20 件真實事件：偵測 18 件且另誤報 12 件。召回率=18/20=90%，精確率=18/(18+12)=60%；樣本並非部署成效，未包含事件基準率漂移。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 20 true incidents in an isolated labeled dataset, 18 detected and 12 false alerts. Recall=18/20=90%; precision=18/(18+12)=60%. This is not deployment effectiveness and omits base-rate drift.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。
workedExample.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch.
workedExample.assumptions: 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設三個獨立零均值位置標準差為 0.3、0.4、0.2 μm，合成 σ=√(0.3²+0.4²+0.2²)=0.539 μm；若另有 0.8 μm 系統偏差，它必須獨立保留，不能放進 RSS 後當作可抵消誤差。
workedExample.textEn: Assume independent zero-mean position standard deviations 0.3, 0.4 and 0.2 μm: combined σ=0.539 μm. A separate 0.8 μm systematic bias must remain explicit; it is not a canceling random RSS term.
workedExample.assumptions: 機械公差模型需有同一座標與相關性假設；V 溝可定位包層，不會自動量到纖芯和光學模態中心。

Real constraints and displacement direction require separate analysis; 6.25 dB is not measured performance.

workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical unity-gain photocurrent I₀=5 μA and M=10, mean multiplied current is 50 μA. workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想網路兩條路徑 S-A-T 的損耗為 1+1=2 dB；S-B-C-T 為 1.5+1.5+1.5=4.5 dB。若發射 0 dBm、接收門檻 −6 dBm，正常裕度 4 dB、備援裕度 1.5 dB；要求保留 2 dB 時備援雖連通仍不合格。移除共用 S 或 T 則兩路均失效，不能宣稱全節點 N−1。另作容量檢驗：假設兩條互不共用瓶頸的路徑各100 Gb/s，正常共200 Gb/s；失去一條後剩100 Gb/s，若最低服務需150 Gb/s，仍有連通也不合格。
workedExample.textEn: Hypothetical routes S-A-T lose 2 dB and S-B-C-T lose 4.5 dB. With 0 dBm launch and −6 dBm receiver threshold, margins are 4 and 1.5 dB. A 2 dB reserve rejects the connected backup. Removing shared S or T disables both, so full node-N−1 is not achieved. For a separate capacity check, two paths with no shared bottleneck at 100 Gb/s each provide 200 Gb/s normally and 100 Gb/s after either fails; a 150 Gb/s minimum fails despite connectivity.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想無增益線性路由；門檻與損失為教學假設，未包含非線性、相干串音與 FEC。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal linear routes without gain; assumed thresholds/losses exclude nonlinear effects, coherent crosstalk and FEC.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 非發光邏輯教學假設：偵測延遲 0.5 ms、控制延遲 1.0 ms、致動回應 2.0 ms，名義總延遲=3.5 ms。若各自獨立最大界限另加 0.2、0.3、0.5 ms，保守相加為 4.5 ms。這只是排程上界，不是安全暴露時間，也不推定任何雷射等級合格。

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設四顆晶粒在既定篩選後各有 0.99 的可用機率，三個接合界面各有 0.995 的成功機率，且所有事件獨立，則 Y=0.99⁴×0.995³=0.9463，約94.63%。這是未提供重工的教學模型；若有共同污染、測試漏失相關或挑選配對，應改用條件機率，不能當成 SoIC 量產良率。
workedExample.textEn: Assume four screened dies each have 0.99 usable probability and three interfaces each have 0.995 success, all independent: Y=0.99⁴×0.995³=0.9463 or 94.63%. This no-rework teaching model is not SoIC production yield; common contamination, correlated escapes or selection require conditional probabilities.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設互連等效 C=20 fF、電壓 V=0.7 V：電容儲能½CV²=4.9 fJ。理想電阻充電時電源供能 CV²=9.8 fJ，其中一半在充電路徑耗散；完整充放電週期從電源取9.8 fJ。若活動率定義為每週期0→1機率，P=αCV²f；不能把4.9 fJ稱為完整晶片每位元能量。
workedExample.textEn: For C=20 fF and V=0.7 V, stored energy ½CV²=4.9 fJ. A resistive charge draws CV²=9.8 fJ from the supply, half dissipated during charging; a full charge/discharge cycle draws 9.8 fJ. If α is the probability of a 0-to-1 event per cycle, P=αCV²f. The 4.9 fJ is not full-chip energy per bit.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想線性電容與電阻充放電，排除漏電、短路、驅動器、時鐘和協議開銷；數值不是 Foveros 規格。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal linear capacitor/resistive charging excludes leakage, short-circuit, drivers, clocks and protocol overhead; values are not Foveros specifications.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。

workedExample.text: 製程窗口練習：ArF 浸潤式 λ = 193 nm、NA = 1.35、水折射率 n = 1.437。邊緣光角度 sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939，θ = 70°。高 NA 景深用 DOF = λ/[2n(1 − cosθ)] 估算：cos70° = 0.342，DOF = 193/(2×1.437×0.658) = 193/1.891 ≈ 102 nm，與近軸 λ/NA² ≈ 106 nm 相近。對焦預算以均方根合成：晶圓形貌 25 nm、晶圓台對焦 15 nm、鏡頭場曲 10 nm、調平感測 10 nm，RSS = √(625+225+100+100) = √1050 ≈ 32 nm；取正負兩側共 2×32 = 64 nm，留給光阻製程的可用景深約 102 − 64 = 38 nm。若 CD 以 k₁ = 0.28 計為 40 nm，CD 容差 ±10% 即 ±4 nm，Bossung 曲線必須在這 38 nm 內維持此容差。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何機台規格。
workedExample.textEn: Process-window exercise: ArF immersion with λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and water index n = 1.437. The marginal-ray angle is sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939, θ = 70°. Estimate the high-NA depth of focus with DOF = λ/[2n(1 − cosθ)]: cos70° = 0.342, so DOF = 193/(2×1.437×0.658) = 193/1.891 ≈ 102 nm, close to the paraxial λ/NA² ≈ 106 nm. Build the focus budget in quadrature: wafer topography 25 nm, stage focus 15 nm, lens field curvature 10 nm and levelling sensor 10 nm give RSS = √(625+225+100+100) = √1050 ≈ 32 nm; counting both sides, 2×32 = 64 nm, leaving about 102 − 64 = 38 nm of usable depth of focus for the resist process. With CD = 40 nm at k₁ = 0.28, the ±10% CD tolerance is ±4 nm, and the Bossung curves must hold that tolerance across those 38 nm. All values are teaching assumptions, not any tool's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 波前預算練習：假設投影光學六片鏡子各分配 RMS 面形 0.15 nm、鍍膜 0.08 nm、對準 0.1 nm、熱漂移 0.1 nm。每片的面形貢獻為 2×0.15 = 0.30 nm；單鏡 RSS = √(0.30² + 0.08² + 0.10² + 0.10²) = 0.342 nm；六片 RSS = 0.342×√6 = 0.837 nm；Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×0.837/13.5)²] = exp(−0.152) ≈ 0.86。若面形放寬到 0.25 nm，六片 RSS ≈ 1.29 nm，Strehl 降到約 0.70，低於 0.8 的常用判準。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Wavefront-budget exercise: assume six projection mirrors, each allocated 0.15 nm RMS figure, 0.08 nm coating, 0.10 nm alignment and 0.10 nm thermal drift. Each mirror's figure contribution is 2×0.15 = 0.30 nm; the per-mirror RSS is √(0.30² + 0.08² + 0.10² + 0.10²) = 0.342 nm; six mirrors give 0.342×√6 = 0.837 nm; Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×0.837/13.5)²] = exp(−0.152) ≈ 0.86. Relaxing figure to 0.25 nm raises the six-mirror RSS to about 1.29 nm and drops Strehl to about 0.70, below the common 0.8 criterion. Values are teaching assumptions, not any tool's specification.

title: EUV 光源錫滴控制概念
summary: 以 13.5 nm 雷射電漿（LPP）錫滴光源為對象，從錫離子的 4d–4f 發射帶與 CO₂ 雷射的臨界密度出發，建立從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈，再拆解錫滴產生器、前脈衝與主脈衝、錫滴偵測與雷射導向、劑量統計、氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔，最後以可用度與反射率衰減記錄完成驗收。本課為教學模型，不含任何操作程序。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 功率鏈練習：驅動雷射 20 kW、50 kHz，每脈衝 0.4 J；CE = 5% 得 20 mJ 帶內 EUV 進入 2π 立體角，即 1000 W。集光鏡收集 5 sr（0.80）、反射率 0.60、氫氣透過率 0.90，η = 0.43，IF 功率 ≈ 430 W，每脈衝 8.6 mJ。進入掃描機後經照明系統 4 片、光罩 1 次與投影光學 6 片共 11 次反射，每次 0.65，0.65¹¹ ≈ 0.0088，晶圓處約 3.8 W。對 30 mJ/cm² 的光阻與 300 mm 晶圓（面積 π×15² ≈ 707 cm²），每片需 21.2 J，純曝光時間 21.2/3.8 ≈ 5.6 s；實際產能再受晶圓台步進、縫隙掃描開銷與劑量餘裕限制。若集光鏡反射率降到 0.50，IF 功率變為 358 W（下降 17%），曝光時間拉長 20%。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何光源規格。
workedExample.textEn: Power-chain exercise: a 20 kW drive laser at 50 kHz gives 0.4 J per pulse; CE = 5% yields 20 mJ of in-band EUV into 2π steradians, i.e. 1000 W. The collector captures 5 sr (0.80) with reflectance 0.60 and hydrogen transmission 0.90, so η = 0.43 and IF power ≈ 430 W, 8.6 mJ per pulse. Inside the scanner the light sees 11 reflections, 4 in the illuminator, 1 at the reticle and 6 in the projection optics, each at 0.65, so 0.65¹¹ ≈ 0.0088 and about 3.8 W reaches the wafer. For a 30 mJ/cm² resist on a 300 mm wafer (area π×15² ≈ 707 cm²) each wafer needs 21.2 J, a pure exposure time of 21.2/3.8 ≈ 5.6 s; real throughput is further limited by stage stepping, slit-scan overhead and dose margin. If collector reflectance drops to 0.50, IF power becomes 358 W (a 17% loss) and exposure time grows by 20%. All values are teaching assumptions, not any source specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 掃描與誤差預算練習：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s、光罩台 2.0 m/s、加速度 20 m/s²。加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 6.25 mm；掃描 33 mm 場加 8 mm 縫隙共 41 mm 需 82 ms；每點在縫隙下 16 ms。伺服交越 300 Hz 時 ω_c = 1885 rad/s，無前饋的加速度追蹤誤差 a/ω_c² = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm，前饋精度 99.9% 後剩 5.6 nm，這是 MA 的一個主要項。量測側：干涉儀死程 300 mm、10 mK 溫度變化給 2.8 nm，改用 3 mm 氣隙的光柵編碼器後為 0.028 nm。MA 預算取編碼器殘差 0.4、Abbe 0.3、伺服 0.5、熱 0.4、光柵 0.3 nm，RSS ≈ 0.87 nm；若保留干涉儀的 2.8 nm 空氣項，RSS 變成 √(0.75 + 7.84) ≈ 2.9 nm，超過 1.5 nm 的套刻分配，這就是光柵編碼器取代長光程干涉儀的工程理由。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Scan and error-budget exercise: wafer scan speed 0.5 m/s, reticle stage 2.0 m/s, acceleration 20 m/s². Reaching 0.5 m/s takes 25 ms and 6.25 mm; the 33 mm field plus 8 mm slit, 41 mm in all, takes 82 ms; each point sits under the slit for 16 ms. With a 300 Hz servo crossover, ω_c = 1885 rad/s, the acceleration tracking error without feedforward is a/ω_c² = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm, and 99.9% feedforward accuracy leaves 5.6 nm, a major MA item. On the measurement side, a 300 mm interferometer dead path with a 10 mK change gives 2.8 nm, whereas a grating encoder with a 3 mm air gap gives 0.028 nm. The MA budget with encoder residual 0.4, Abbe 0.3, servo 0.5, thermal 0.4 and grating 0.3 nm gives RSS ≈ 0.87 nm; keeping the interferometer's 2.8 nm air term instead raises the RSS to √(0.75 + 7.84) ≈ 2.9 nm, beyond a 1.5 nm overlay allocation, which is the engineering reason grating encoders replaced long-path interferometers. All numbers are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 二級光譜練習：100× 物鏡配 200 mm 筒鏡，f_obj = 2 mm；NA 1.4 油浸在 550 nm 的單側景深 n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm。若用 N-BK7（ν = 64.2，P_gF = 0.535）與 F2（ν = 36.4，P_gF = 0.583）做消色差，g 線焦點偏離 Δf = f·ΔP/Δν = 2 mm×(−0.048/27.8) ≈ −3.4 µm，是景深的 8 倍，藍色影像必然模糊。改用異常色散對（ΔP ≈ 0.004、Δν ≈ 50），Δf ≈ 2 mm×8×10⁻⁵ = 0.16 µm，落在景深內。再算整機 Strehl：物鏡 25 nm、筒鏡 15 nm、對準 15 nm、蓋玻片殘差 20 nm，RSS ≈ 38 nm，Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] ≈ 0.83。若橫向色差為 0.1%，視場邊緣 125 µm 處紅藍錯位 125 nm，超過 196 nm 解析極限的一半，所以橫向色差規格也要訂在 0.05% 以下。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Secondary-spectrum exercise: a 100× objective with a 200 mm tube lens has f_obj = 2 mm; NA 1.4 oil immersion at 550 nm gives a one-sided depth of field n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm. An achromat built from N-BK7 (ν = 64.2, P_gF = 0.535) and F2 (ν = 36.4, P_gF = 0.583) places the g-line focus at Δf = f·ΔP/Δν = 2 mm×(−0.048/27.8) ≈ −3.4 µm, 8 times the depth of field, so the blue image must blur. An anomalous-dispersion pair (ΔP ≈ 0.004, Δν ≈ 50) gives Δf ≈ 2 mm×8×10⁻⁵ = 0.16 µm, inside the depth of field. Now the system Strehl: objective 25 nm, tube lens 15 nm, alignment 15 nm and cover-glass residual 20 nm give RSS ≈ 38 nm and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] ≈ 0.83. With 0.1% lateral colour, red and blue are displaced by 125 nm at the 125 µm field edge, more than half the 196 nm resolution limit, so the lateral-colour specification must also be set below 0.05%. All numbers are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 非球面加工練習：拋物面 R = 50 mm、k = −1、口徑 50 mm。邊緣矢高：拋物面 r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm，同頂點球面 50 − √(50² − 25²) = 6.70 mm，偏離量 0.45 mm；對最佳擬合球面約 110 µm，邊緣斜率約 31 mrad。干涉儀：1000 像素相機每像素 50 µm，可量斜率上限約 3.2 mrad，條紋間距在邊緣只有 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm，因此採用 CGH 零位測試。加工：研磨後 3 µm PV，去除體積 1963 mm²×1.5 µm ≈ 2.9 mm³，MRF 以 0.1 mm³/min 需 29 min；收斂比 7，兩次循環後 0.06 µm PV。對心：10 µm 偏心乘 31 mrad 得 0.31 µm 表面誤差，乘 (n − 1) = 0.52 為 0.16 µm 波前 ≈ 0.25 波，因此對心公差訂為 1 µm。驗收：面形 25 nm RMS、CGH 量測不確定度 13.6 nm，量測比 1.8:1 不足，改用面形 5 nm 的 CGH 基板後 RSS ≈ √(25+36+25+25) ≈ 10.5 nm，接近 2.4:1，並以輪廓儀交叉驗證。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Asphere manufacturing exercise: paraboloid R = 50 mm, k = −1, 50 mm aperture. Edge sag: paraboloid r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm, same-vertex sphere 50 − √(50² − 25²) = 6.70 mm, departure 0.45 mm; about 110 µm from the best-fit sphere with an edge slope of about 31 mrad. Interferometry: a 1000-pixel camera at 50 µm per pixel can resolve slopes up to about 3.2 mrad, while fringes at the edge are only 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm apart, so a CGH null test is chosen. Fabrication: 3 µm PV after grinding, removal volume 1963 mm²×1.5 µm ≈ 2.9 mm³, 29 min of MRF at 0.1 mm³/min; with a convergence ratio of 7, two cycles reach 0.06 µm PV. Centring: 10 µm of decentration times 31 mrad gives 0.31 µm of surface error, times (n − 1) = 0.52 gives 0.16 µm of wavefront ≈ 0.25 waves, so the centring tolerance is set at 1 µm. Acceptance: figure 25 nm RMS with a CGH uncertainty of 13.6 nm is a 1.8:1 ratio, insufficient; a CGH substrate of 5 nm figure gives RSS ≈ √(25+36+25+25) ≈ 10.5 nm, close to 2.4:1, and a profilometer cross-check is added. All values are teaching assumptions.

title: 自由曲面光學量測
summary: 以一片口徑 50 mm、對最佳擬合球面偏離 200 µm、最大斜率 20 mrad 的自由曲面反射鏡為案例：先說明無對稱軸的表面為何讓六個剛體自由度與面形誤差糾纏，必須靠基準與定位標記配準；再比較 CGH 零位干涉、傾斜波非零位干涉、接觸與光學探針輪廓儀及次口徑拼接的物理限制，建立含 CGH 寫入誤差、基板、回溯誤差與熱漂移的不確定度預算，最後以兩種獨立方法交叉驗證並把量測圖回饋到確定性修形與實測重最佳化。
summaryEn: Using a 50 mm freeform mirror with 200 µm departure from its best-fit sphere and 20 mrad maximum slope as the case, the course first shows why a surface without a symmetry axis entangles the six rigid-body degrees of freedom with form error and must be registered through datums and fiducials; it then compares the physical limits of CGH null interferometry, tilted-wave non-null interferometry, contact and optical probe profilometry and subaperture stitching, builds an uncertainty budget covering CGH writing error, substrate, retrace error and thermal drift, and closes by cross-validating two independent methods and feeding the map back into deterministic figuring and as-built re-optimisation.

workedExample.text: 自由曲面 CGH 量測練習：鏡面口徑 50 mm、最大斜率 20 mrad、公差 20 nm RMS。雙程波前斜率 40 mrad，CGH 局部線距 0.633/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm；寫入機定位誤差 50 nm 產生 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 波 ≈ 2 nm 波前，即 1 nm 表面，取保守值 2 nm。基板面形已量測並扣除，殘留 3 nm；對準與回溯 3 nm；參考面 2 nm；熱漂移 2 nm（鋁鏡矢高 5 mm、0.02 K 對應 2.3 nm）；雜訊 1 nm。RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，量測比 20/5.6 ≈ 3.6:1。配準：三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各 1 µm 不確定度 → 10 µrad 轉動 → 半口徑 25 mm 處 0.25 µm → 乘 20 mrad 得 5 nm，仍在預算內。交叉驗證：輪廓儀不確定度 8 nm，差異圖期望 RMS √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm；若實測差異 25 nm，先檢查探針半徑補償（20 mrad 處 100 nm 的高度修正）與 Y 軸方向約定。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Freeform CGH metrology exercise: mirror aperture 50 mm, maximum slope 20 mrad, tolerance 20 nm RMS. The double-pass wavefront slope is 40 mrad, so the CGH local line spacing is 0.633/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm; a writer placement error of 50 nm gives 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 waves ≈ 2 nm of wavefront, i.e. 1 nm of surface, taken conservatively as 2 nm. The substrate figure is measured and subtracted, leaving 3 nm; alignment and retrace 3 nm; reference surface 2 nm; thermal drift 2 nm (an aluminium mirror with 5 mm sag at 0.02 K gives 2.3 nm); noise 1 nm. RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of 20/5.6 ≈ 3.6:1. Registration: three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline at 1 µm each give 10 µrad of clocking, 0.25 µm at the 25 mm half-aperture, which times 20 mrad is 5 nm, still within budget. Cross-validation: the profilometer uncertainty is 8 nm, so the expected RMS of the difference map is √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm; if the measured difference is 25 nm, first check the probe-radius compensation (a 100 nm height correction at 20 mrad) and the Y-axis sign convention. All values are teaching assumptions.

title: 光學玻璃精密退火
summary: 以一塊厚 100 mm 的 N-BK7 光學玻璃毛胚為案例：從黏度與 Maxwell 鬆弛時間說明退火點與應變點的意義，推導冷卻速率如何透過假想溫度改變折射率、毛胚內溫差如何依 Adams–Williamson 關係凍結成殘餘應力，再談精密退火爐的均勻性要求、應力雙折射與折射率均勻性的量測，最後設計一份完整的退火程式並以熔次資料表完成與光學設計的交接。
summaryEn: Using a 100 mm thick N-BK7 blank as the case, the course explains the annealing and strain points through viscosity and the Maxwell relaxation time, derives how cooling rate changes refractive index via the fictive temperature and how the temperature difference inside the blank freezes into residual stress by the Adams–Williamson relation, then covers the uniformity demands on a precision annealing furnace, the measurement of stress birefringence and index homogeneity, and finally designs a complete annealing schedule and hands the melt data sheet over to optical design.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 退火程式練習：N-BK7 毛胚厚 100 mm，熱擴散率 a ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s，Eα/(1−ν) ≈ 0.73 MPa/K，光彈常數 27.7 nm/cm 每 MPa，目標雙折射 ≤ 4 nm/cm、折射率公差 ±0.0002。第一步：1 K/h 時 ΔT = q·d²/(8a) = 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(4.16×10⁻⁶) ≈ 0.67 K，永久應力 σ ≈ (2/3)×0.73×0.67 ≈ 0.33 MPa，雙折射 ≈ 9.1 nm/cm，不合格。第二步：改 0.3 K/h，ΔT ≈ 0.20 K，σ ≈ 0.10 MPa，雙折射 ≈ 2.7 nm/cm，合格。第三步：若玻璃廠的參考速率為 h₀ 且退火係數 m ≈ −0.001，0.3 K/h 相對 h₀ 的折射率偏移為 −0.001×log₁₀(0.3/h₀)；要落在 ±0.0002 內，0.3 K/h 必須在 0.63h₀ 到 1.6h₀ 之間，否則把偏移量寫進熔次資料表供設計重算。第四步：時間預算為保溫 2 h、慢冷 80 K/0.3 = 267 h、快冷 460 K/5 = 92 h，共約 15 天；快冷段暫時應力 ≈ 1.7 MPa，安全。最後以偏光儀與均勻性干涉驗收，並做熔次重算。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Annealing-schedule exercise: an N-BK7 blank 100 mm thick, diffusivity a ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s, Eα/(1−ν) ≈ 0.73 MPa/K, photoelastic constant 27.7 nm/cm per MPa, target birefringence ≤ 4 nm/cm and index tolerance ±0.0002. Step one: at 1 K/h, ΔT = q·d²/(8a) = 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(4.16×10⁻⁶) ≈ 0.67 K, permanent stress σ ≈ (2/3)×0.73×0.67 ≈ 0.33 MPa, birefringence ≈ 9.1 nm/cm, a failure. Step two: at 0.3 K/h, ΔT ≈ 0.20 K, σ ≈ 0.10 MPa, birefringence ≈ 2.7 nm/cm, a pass. Step three: if the maker's reference rate is h₀ and the annealing coefficient m ≈ −0.001, the index shift of 0.3 K/h relative to h₀ is −0.001×log₁₀(0.3/h₀); to stay within ±0.0002, 0.3 K/h must lie between 0.63h₀ and 1.6h₀, otherwise the shift is written into the melt data sheet for the design recompute. Step four: the time budget is 2 h hold, slow cool 80 K/0.3 = 267 h, fast cool 460 K/5 = 92 h, about 15 days in all; the transient stress in the fast segment is ≈ 1.7 MPa, which is safe. Finally accept with the polarimeter and homogeneity interferometry and perform the melt recompute. All numbers are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.text: 確定性修形練習：直徑 300 mm 熔融石英平面，初始面形 25 nm RMS、120 nm PV。去除函數為高斯，峰值 R₀ = 1.0 nm/s、FWHM = 10 mm，σ = 4.25 mm，體積去除率 = R₀·2πσ² = 1.0 × 113 = 113 nm·mm²/s。假設修正需要的平均去除深度為 70 nm（高於最低點的平均高度 60 nm 加 10 nm 底層），工件面積 π×150² = 70,686 mm²，總體積 70 × 70,686 = 4.95×10⁶ nm·mm²，修形時間 ≈ 4.95×10⁶/113 ≈ 43,800 s ≈ 12.2 h；加上 21% 邊緣溢出約 14.8 h。誤差預算：束流穩定 1% × 70 nm = 0.7 nm、量測 0.5 nm、對位 0.3 mm × 1 nm/mm = 0.3 nm、週期小於 20 mm 的不可修正中頻 2 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.7² + 0.5² + 0.3² + 2²) ≈ 2.2 nm RMS，收斂 91%。熱平衡：束流 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W，7.8 kg 石英（密度 2.2 g/cm³，熱容約 5.8 kJ/K）若不散熱每小時升溫 40×3600/5800 ≈ 25 K，所以必須靠夾具導熱與限制電流把穩態溫升壓在 30 K 以下。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何機台規格。
workedExample.textEn: Deterministic-figuring exercise: a 300 mm diameter fused-silica flat with initial figure 25 nm RMS and 120 nm PV. The removal function is Gaussian with peak R₀ = 1.0 nm/s and FWHM = 10 mm, so σ = 4.25 mm and the volumetric rate = R₀·2πσ² = 1.0 × 113 = 113 nm·mm²/s. Assume the correction needs a mean removal of 70 nm (60 nm mean height above the lowest point plus a 10 nm floor); the part area is π×150² = 70,686 mm², the total volume 70 × 70,686 = 4.95×10⁶ nm·mm², and the figuring time ≈ 4.95×10⁶/113 ≈ 43,800 s ≈ 12.2 h, about 14.8 h with 21% edge overrun. Error budget: beam stability 1% × 70 nm = 0.7 nm, metrology 0.5 nm, registration 0.3 mm × 1 nm/mm = 0.3 nm, uncorrectable mid-frequency below a 20 mm period 2 nm, residual ≈ √(0.7² + 0.5² + 0.3² + 2²) ≈ 2.2 nm RMS, a 91% convergence. Thermal balance: beam power 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W; without cooling the 7.8 kg silica part (density 2.2 g/cm³, heat capacity about 5.8 kJ/K) would warm by 40×3600/5800 ≈ 25 K per hour, so fixture conduction and current limits must hold the steady-state rise below 30 K. All values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.

workedExample.text: 非球面修形練習：直徑 100 mm 的 BK7 非球面，初始面形 60 nm RMS、300 nm PV。去除點以 10 s 靜止得到 0.40 µm 深度，峰值去除率 40 nm/s = 2.4 µm/min，D 形點 10 mm × 4 mm，體積去除率 ≈ 0.4×10×4×2.4×10⁻³ ≈ 0.04 mm³/min。駐留圖需要的平均去除量取 0.25 µm（高點平均 0.20 µm 加 0.05 µm 底層），體積 0.25×10⁻³ mm × 7854 mm² ≈ 1.96 mm³，修形時間 ≈ 1.96/0.04 ≈ 49 min，含 21% 邊緣越程約 59 min。誤差預算：去除率漂移 3% × 250 nm = 7.5 nm、量測 1 nm、對位 20 µm × 0.5 µm/mm = 10 nm 以 RMS 計約 1 nm（斜率只在邊緣大）、中頻紋理 3 nm，殘差 ≈ √(7.5² + 1² + 1² + 3²) ≈ 8.2 nm RMS，縮小 7.3 倍。第二次迭代去除深度降到約 30 nm，漂移項 0.9 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.9² + 1² + 1² + 3²) ≈ 3.4 nm RMS。穿透波前貢獻 (1.517 − 1)×3.4 ≈ 1.8 nm ≈ λ/350。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何機台規格。
workedExample.textEn: Aspheric-figuring exercise: a 100 mm BK7 asphere with initial figure 60 nm RMS and 300 nm PV. A 10 s stationary spot is 0.40 µm deep, so the peak rate is 40 nm/s = 2.4 µm/min; the D-shaped spot is 10 mm × 4 mm with a volumetric rate ≈ 0.4×10×4×2.4×10⁻³ ≈ 0.04 mm³/min. The dwell map needs a mean removal of 0.25 µm (0.20 µm mean height of the hills plus a 0.05 µm floor), a volume of 0.25×10⁻³ mm × 7854 mm² ≈ 1.96 mm³, a run time ≈ 1.96/0.04 ≈ 49 min, about 59 min with 21% edge overrun. Error budget: rate drift 3% × 250 nm = 7.5 nm, metrology 1 nm, registration 20 µm × 0.5 µm/mm = 10 nm at the edge but about 1 nm as an area-weighted RMS because slope is large only near the rim, mid-frequency texture 3 nm, residual ≈ √(7.5² + 1² + 1² + 3²) ≈ 8.2 nm RMS, a 7.3-fold reduction. In the second iteration the removal depth falls to about 30 nm, the drift term to 0.9 nm, and the residual ≈ √(0.9² + 1² + 1² + 3²) ≈ 3.4 nm RMS. The transmitted-wavefront contribution is (1.517 − 1)×3.4 ≈ 1.8 nm ≈ λ/350. All values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.

title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
summary: 從單層膜的 Fresnel 振幅相加出發，用特徵矩陣與導納轉換推導四分之一波堆的反射率與阻帶寬度，再討論氧化物與氟化物材料、蒸鍍與濺鍍的微結構差異、石英晶體與光學監控、分光光度驗證與逆向工程、入射角與環境造成的光譜位移，直到均勻性夾具、環境測試與驗收交接。
summaryEn: Beginning with Fresnel amplitudes adding in a single film, derive quarter-wave-stack reflectance and stop-band width with the characteristic matrix and admittance transformation, then cover oxide and fluoride materials, the microstructural difference between evaporated and sputtered films, quartz-crystal and optical monitoring, spectrophotometric verification and reverse engineering, spectral shifts with incidence angle and environment, and finally uniformity fixtures, environmental testing and acceptance handoff.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 四分之一波堆練習：設計 550 nm 的 TiO₂/SiO₂ 高反射膜 Glass | (HL)⁹H | air，n_H = 2.35、n_L = 1.46、n_s = 1.52。各層厚度 d_H = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm、d_L = 550/(4×1.46) ≈ 94.2 nm，19 層總厚度 10×58.5 + 9×94.2 ≈ 1433 nm。導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)¹⁸·n_H²/n_s = e^{18×0.476} × 5.52/1.52 ≈ 5.27×10³ × 3.63 ≈ 1.92×10⁴，R ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998（無吸收時）。阻帶半寬 Δg ≈ 0.150，阻帶約 478 到 647 nm。若整批厚度一致偏厚 1%，整個光譜紅移 5.5 nm；以 10° 入射使用時藍移 0.44%（2.4 nm），兩者部分抵消。以 IBS 0.1 nm/s 沉積需 1433/0.1 ≈ 14,300 s ≈ 4.0 h；石英晶體監控一層 94.2 nm 的 SiO₂ 對應 Δf ≈ 56.6 × 2.2 × 9.42 ≈ 1173 Hz。數值為教學假設，不代表任何鍍膜廠的設計或製程。
workedExample.textEn: Quarter-wave-stack exercise: design a 550 nm TiO₂/SiO₂ high reflector Glass | (HL)⁹H | air with n_H = 2.35, n_L = 1.46 and n_s = 1.52. Layer thicknesses are d_H = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm and d_L = 550/(4×1.46) ≈ 94.2 nm, a 19-layer total of 10×58.5 + 9×94.2 ≈ 1433 nm. The admittance Y = (n_H/n_L)¹⁸·n_H²/n_s = e^{18×0.476} × 5.52/1.52 ≈ 5.27×10³ × 3.63 ≈ 1.92×10⁴, so R ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998 without absorption. The stop-band half-width Δg ≈ 0.150 gives a band from about 478 to 647 nm. A uniform 1% thickness excess red-shifts the whole spectrum by 5.5 nm, while use at 10° incidence blue-shifts it by 0.44% (2.4 nm), partly cancelling. Depositing by IBS at 0.1 nm/s takes 1433/0.1 ≈ 14,300 s ≈ 4.0 h; one 94.2 nm SiO₂ layer on the quartz-crystal monitor corresponds to Δf ≈ 56.6 × 2.2 × 9.42 ≈ 1173 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions, not any coating shop's design or process.

title: 增透膜設計與沉積
summary: 從 Fresnel 反射與多片鏡頭的穿透率損失出發，用導納匹配條件推導 MgF₂ 單層、四分之一波雙層 V 膜與四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜的殘餘反射率，再討論低折射率膜材與熱基板蒸鍍、透鏡上的厚度分佈、低反射率量測的背面陷阱、入射角與偏振的影響，最後把殘餘反射換算成鏡頭鬼影與穿透率預算並完成驗收交接。
summaryEn: Starting from Fresnel reflection and the transmission loss of multi-element lenses, derive the residual reflectance of a MgF₂ single layer, a quarter-quarter V-coat and a quarter-half-quarter broadband design from the admittance-matching condition, then cover low-index materials and hot-substrate evaporation, thickness distribution on lenses, the back-surface trap in low-reflectance metrology, incidence-angle and polarization effects, and finally convert residual reflectance into lens ghost and transmission budgets for acceptance handoff.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 增透膜設計與整合練習：BK7（n_s = 1.52）透鏡，工作波段 450 到 650 nm，主光線入射角 0 到 30°。先評估單層 MgF₂：R(550) = [(1.52 − 1.38²)/(1.52 + 1.38²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/3.424]² ≈ 0.0126，400 到 700 nm 平均 1.48%，不符 0.5% 的要求。改用四分之一／半波／四分之一設計（520 nm）：MgF₂ 94.2 nm、ZrO₂ 126.8 nm、Al₂O₃ 79.8 nm，矩陣計算 400 到 700 nm 平均 0.20%，30° 時 0.31%，仍在 0.5% 內。二十面中十六面以此膜計 0.25%、四面陡峭面計 0.5%，鏡頭穿透率 ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ × 0.98 ≈ 0.92，最亮雙面鬼影 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵。製程公差：蒙地卡羅各層 ±3% 厚度擾動一千次後平均反射率落在 0.19% 到 0.28%，良率 100%；邊緣傾角 30° 的面厚度薄 13%，需把夾具傾斜或把設計中心上移 5% 補償。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Antireflection design and integration exercise: a BK7 lens (n_s = 1.52) working from 450 to 650 nm with chief-ray incidence from 0 to 30°. First evaluate single-layer MgF₂: R(550) = [(1.52 − 1.38²)/(1.52 + 1.38²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/3.424]² ≈ 0.0126 and a 400 to 700 nm average of 1.48%, failing the 0.5% requirement. Switch to a quarter-half-quarter design at 520 nm: MgF₂ 94.2 nm, ZrO₂ 126.8 nm, Al₂O₃ 79.8 nm; the matrix calculation gives a 400 to 700 nm average of 0.20% and 0.31% at 30°, still within 0.5%. Counting sixteen of twenty surfaces at 0.25% and four steep surfaces at 0.5%, lens transmission ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ × 0.98 ≈ 0.92 and the brightest two-surface ghost is 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵. Process tolerance: a thousand-trial Monte-Carlo run with ±3% thickness perturbation per layer keeps the average reflectance between 0.19% and 0.28%, full yield; a surface with a 30° rim tilt receives 13% less thickness and needs a tilted fixture or a 5% upward bias of the design centre to compensate. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.

title: 高反射雷射鏡片
summary: 雷射鏡片與一般高反射膜的差別在於損耗以 ppm 計、功率以損傷門檻計：本課從 1 − R = T + A + S 的損耗帳出發，分析四分之一波堆內的駐波場與損傷起點、超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷、離子束濺鍍與退火對吸收的要求，再用光腔衰盪、光熱吸收與 ISO 21254 損傷測試驗證，最後處理高功率熱效應、安裝污染與規格交接。
summaryEn: A laser mirror differs from an ordinary high reflector in that loss is counted in ppm and power in damage threshold: starting from the loss ledger 1 − R = T + A + S, the course analyses the standing-wave field and damage origin inside a quarter-wave stack, superpolished substrates and nodular defects, ion-beam sputtering and annealing requirements for absorption, then verifies with cavity ring-down, photothermal absorption and ISO 21254 damage testing, and finishes with high-power thermal effects, mounting contamination and specification handoff.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 1064 nm Q 開關雷射腔鏡練習：Ta₂O₅/SiO₂（2.10/1.45）於熔融石英，設計 (HL)¹⁵H 加半波 SiO₂ 保護層。穿透：(2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴，Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵，T ≈ 4/Y ≈ 20 ppm。散射：基板 σ = 0.15 nm，S ≈ (4π×0.15/1064)² ≈ 3.1 ppm；吸收：退火後 A ≈ 2 ppm；1 − R ≈ 25 ppm，R ≈ 99.9975%。衰盪驗收：L = 0.5 m 的雙鏡腔 τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 2.5×10⁻⁵) ≈ 66.7 µs，量測 1% 精度對應 0.25 ppm。損傷：證書 20 J/cm²（10 ns、1-on-1），使用 8 ns 換算 17.9 J/cm²；200 mJ、w = 2 mm 的峰值能量密度 2×0.2/(π×0.04) ≈ 3.2 J/cm²，安全係數 5.6。熱效應：1 kHz 重複率平均功率 200 W，吸收 2 ppm 即 0.4 mW，ΔT ≈ 0.0004/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 0.06 K，可忽略。駐波場：第一個 H/L 界面 |E/E₀|² ≈ 0.91，保護層中央 1.90。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Cavity-mirror exercise for a 1064 nm Q-switched laser: Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ (2.10/1.45) on fused silica, design (HL)¹⁵H plus a half-wave SiO₂ overcoat. Transmission: (2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴, Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵, T ≈ 4/Y ≈ 20 ppm. Scatter: substrate σ = 0.15 nm gives S ≈ (4π×0.15/1064)² ≈ 3.1 ppm; absorption after annealing A ≈ 2 ppm; 1 − R ≈ 25 ppm, R ≈ 99.9975%. Ring-down acceptance: a two-mirror cavity with L = 0.5 m has τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 2.5×10⁻⁵) ≈ 66.7 µs, and 1% timing precision resolves 0.25 ppm. Damage: certificate 20 J/cm² (10 ns, 1-on-1) scales to 17.9 J/cm² at the 8 ns in use; a 200 mJ pulse with w = 2 mm has peak fluence 2×0.2/(π×0.04) ≈ 3.2 J/cm², safety factor 5.6. Thermal: at 1 kHz the average power is 200 W, 2 ppm absorption is 0.4 mW and ΔT ≈ 0.0004/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 0.06 K, negligible. Standing wave: |E/E₀|² ≈ 0.91 at the first H/L interface and 1.90 in the middle of the overcoat. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.

title: 偏振光學元件製作
summary: 本課以消光比與延遲量兩個核心指標貫穿偏振元件的製作：先用 Malus 定律與雙折射建立規格的物理意義，再分別處理石英波片的定向、研磨至延遲量與零級複合結構、方解石 Glan 稜鏡的全反射幾何、奈米線柵與 MacNeille 薄膜偏振分光器、Fresnel 菱體的消色差延遲，接著用 Sénarmont 與消光比量測建立誤差預算，最後處理應力雙折射安裝與規格交接。
summaryEn: Two figures of merit, extinction ratio and retardance, run through this course on fabricating polarization optics: Malus's law and birefringence give the specifications physical meaning, then quartz-waveplate orientation, polishing to retardance and compound zero-order construction, the total-internal-reflection geometry of calcite Glan prisms, nanowire-grid and MacNeille thin-film beam splitters and the achromatic retardance of the Fresnel rhomb are treated in turn, followed by Sénarmont and extinction-ratio metrology for the error budget, stress-birefringence-free mounting and specification handoff.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 複合零級石英四分之一波片練習（633 nm）：Δn = 0.0091，零級厚度差 d = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm，以兩片約 700 µm 的石英片光軸交叉組合。延遲量公差 λ/300 對應厚度差公差 633/(300×0.0091) ≈ 0.23 µm；拋光速率 0.1 µm/min 時公差窗約 2 分鐘，必須以 Sénarmont 回授停機，Sénarmont 讀數 0.05° 給 λ/3600 的量測不確定度。使用條件：波長 ±0.5 nm → 零級敏感度 4×10⁻⁴ 波/nm → 2×10⁻⁴ 波；溫度 ±5 K → 2.4×10⁻⁵ 波/K → 1.2×10⁻⁴ 波；入射角 ±2° → 2.5×10⁻⁴ 相對 → 6×10⁻⁵ 波；安裝應力控制在 36 kPa 以下 → λ/1000 = 1×10⁻³ 波。總預算 RSS ≈ √(3.3² + 0.2² + 0.12² + 0.06² + 1²)×10⁻³ ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ 波 ≈ λ/290，符合 λ/250 的系統需求。若改用單片 10 級波片，光僅波長項就達 0.016 波/nm × 0.5 = 8×10⁻³ 波（λ/125），溫度項 5×10⁻³ 波，RSS ≈ λ/100，不合格。搭配的 Glan–Taylor 稜鏡消光比 10⁵:1，與 0.3° 的旋轉角控制合併後隔離度 ≈ 44 dB。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Compound zero-order quartz quarter-wave plate exercise at 633 nm: Δn = 0.0091, zero-order thickness difference d = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm, built from two quartz plates of about 700 µm with crossed axes. A λ/300 retardance tolerance corresponds to a thickness-difference tolerance of 633/(300×0.0091) ≈ 0.23 µm; at a polish rate of 0.1 µm/min the tolerance window lasts about 2 minutes, so the stop is driven by Sénarmont feedback, whose 0.05° readout gives λ/3600 measurement uncertainty. Operating terms: wavelength ±0.5 nm with zero-order sensitivity 4×10⁻⁴ waves/nm → 2×10⁻⁴ waves; temperature ±5 K at 2.4×10⁻⁵ waves/K → 1.2×10⁻⁴ waves; incidence ±2° → 2.5×10⁻⁴ relative → 6×10⁻⁵ waves; mounting stress held below 36 kPa → λ/1000 = 1×10⁻³ waves. Total RSS ≈ √(3.3² + 0.2² + 0.12² + 0.06² + 1²)×10⁻³ ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ waves ≈ λ/290, meeting a λ/250 system requirement. A single 10th-order plate instead would have a wavelength term alone of 0.016 waves/nm × 0.5 = 8×10⁻³ waves (λ/125) and a temperature term of 5×10⁻³ waves, RSS ≈ λ/100, failing. The matching Glan–Taylor prism at 10⁵:1 combined with 0.3° rotation control gives isolation ≈ 44 dB. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.

title: 繞射光學元件製作
summary: 本課從 2π 相位摺疊與 M 階量化的 sinc² 效率出發，說明設計波長失諧與深度誤差如何把能量漏到零級與高階，再走過二元微影的光罩數與最小線寬、反應離子蝕刻與灰階直寫、奈米壓印複製，用輪廓儀與零級洩漏量測建立效率誤差預算，最後以混合折射繞射消色差透鏡的整合與規格交接收尾。
summaryEn: Starting from 2π phase wrapping and the sinc² efficiency of M-level quantisation, the course shows how design-wavelength detuning and depth error leak energy into the zero and higher orders, walks through mask count and minimum feature in binary lithography, reactive-ion etching, grayscale direct writing and nanoimprint replication, builds an efficiency error budget from profilometry and zero-order leakage measurement, and closes with hybrid refractive-diffractive achromat integration and specification handoff.

workedExample.text: 8 階繞射透鏡製作練習：熔融石英（n = 1.457）、λ₀ = 633 nm、f = 50 mm、D = 10 mm。閃耀深度 d = 633/0.457 ≈ 1385 nm，8 階的階高 ≈ 173 nm，三道光罩蝕刻 693、346、173 nm；NA ≈ 0.1，最外環帶週期 λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm，環帶數 r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395，最細線寬 ≈ 0.8 µm。效率預算：量化 sinc²(1/8) = 0.950；蝕刻速率 100 nm/min、終點偵測後階高誤差 2 nm（ε ≈ 0.15%，因子 ≈ 1.000）；第三道光罩套準 0.1 µm 的純量模型因子 0.907/0.950 ≈ 0.954；階面粗糙度與側壁 0.98；雙面增透膜後 Fresnel 因子 0.994；預測 η₁ ≈ 0.950 × 1.000 × 0.954 × 0.98 × 0.994 ≈ 0.883。驗收量測：入射 10.00 mW，第一級 8.80 mW → η₁ = 88.0%，零級 0.010 mW → η₀ = 0.10% → ε ≈ 3.3%（約 45 nm），與輪廓儀量到的總深度 1340 nm（−3.2%）一致，表示蝕刻校正應上修 3%。若改用 532 nm 使用，ε = 0.19，η₁ 再乘 0.887 只剩約 78%。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: 8-level diffractive-lens exercise: fused silica (n = 1.457), λ₀ = 633 nm, f = 50 mm, D = 10 mm. Blaze depth d = 633/0.457 ≈ 1385 nm, 8-level step ≈ 173 nm, three masks etched 693, 346 and 173 nm; NA ≈ 0.1, outermost period λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm, zone count r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395, finest feature ≈ 0.8 µm. Efficiency budget: quantisation sinc²(1/8) = 0.950; etch rate 100 nm/min with endpoint detection leaves 2 nm step error (ε ≈ 0.15%, factor ≈ 1.000); 0.1 µm overlay on the third mask gives a scalar-model factor 0.907/0.950 ≈ 0.954; step roughness and sidewalls 0.98; Fresnel factor 0.994 after double-sided antireflection; predicted η₁ ≈ 0.950 × 1.000 × 0.954 × 0.98 × 0.994 ≈ 0.883. Acceptance measurement: incident 10.00 mW, first order 8.80 mW → η₁ = 88.0%, zero order 0.010 mW → η₀ = 0.10% → ε ≈ 3.3% (about 45 nm), consistent with a profiler total depth of 1340 nm (−3.2%), so the etch calibration should be raised by 3%. Used at 532 nm instead, ε = 0.19 and η₁ is multiplied by 0.887 to about 78%. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.

summary: 以 532 nm、NA 0.8 的 TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎透鏡為主線，從廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣出發，解釋奈米柱如何在 600 nm 高度內覆蓋 2π 相位，再比較電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機的解析度與產能，最後把蝕刻側壁、關鍵尺寸均勻性、色差與拼接誤差整合成可量測的聚焦效率與 Strehl 預算。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：λ = 532 nm、直徑 D = 2 mm、f = 0.75 mm 的 TiO₂ 超穎透鏡，NA = sin(atan(1/0.75)) = 0.8。菲涅耳圈數 N = (√(R² + f²) − f)/λ = (1.25 − 0.75) mm/0.532 µm ≈ 940 圈；最外圈寬 λ/NA = 665 nm，以 250 nm 格點取樣得每圈 2.66 個超穎原子，純量估計邊緣局部效率 sinc²(1/2.66) ≈ 0.61。柱子總數 π(1000 µm)²/(0.25 µm)² ≈ 5.0×10⁷ 根。EBL 以 1000 µC/cm²、1 nA、填充率 35% 寫入需 t = 1.1×10⁻² cm² × 10⁻³ C/cm² / 10⁻⁹ A ≈ 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h。景深 λ/NA² ≈ 0.83 µm，焦點移動一個景深對應 Δλ ≈ 0.59 nm，故只適合窄線寬雷射。CD 標準差 3 nm 經 0.052 rad/nm 換算得 σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad，Strehl ≈ 0.976。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a TiO₂ metalens with λ = 532 nm, diameter D = 2 mm and f = 0.75 mm has NA = sin(atan(1/0.75)) = 0.8. The number of Fresnel zones is N = (√(R² + f²) − f)/λ = (1.25 − 0.75) mm/0.532 µm ≈ 940; the outermost zone is λ/NA = 665 nm wide, sampled by 2.66 meta-atoms on a 250 nm lattice, giving a scalar local rim efficiency of sinc²(1/2.66) ≈ 0.61. The pillar count is π(1000 µm)²/(0.25 µm)² ≈ 5.0×10⁷. EBL at 1000 µC/cm², 1 nA and 35% fill takes t = 1.1×10⁻² cm² × 10⁻³ C/cm² / 10⁻⁹ A ≈ 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h. The depth of focus λ/NA² ≈ 0.83 µm, so moving the focus by one depth of focus needs only Δλ ≈ 0.59 nm, which restricts use to narrow-linewidth lasers. A 3 nm CD standard deviation through 0.052 rad/nm gives σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad and Strehl ≈ 0.976. All values are teaching assumptions.

title: 全像光學元件製作
summary: 以 1200 線/mm、16 µm 厚光聚合物的穿透式體相位光柵與同厚度的反射式全像為兩條主線，從厚光柵 Q 參數與 Kogelnik 的 sin² 與 tanh² 效率式出發，推導角度與波長選擇性，再處理記錄材料收縮、干涉條紋穩定性、搖擺曲線擬合與抬頭顯示器或波導耦合器的幾何，形成可交接的全像光學元件工程紀錄。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：在 16 µm 厚、n₀ = 1.5 的自顯影光聚合物上記錄 1200 線/mm 的穿透式體相位光柵，記錄與重建波長皆為 532 nm。條紋週期 Λ = 833 nm；空氣中記錄半角 θ = asin(532/1666) = 18.6°；層內布拉格角 θ_B = asin(532/(2×1.5×833)) = 12.3°，cosθ_B = 0.977。厚光柵參數 Q = 2π×0.532×16/(1.5×0.833²) ≈ 51，屬布拉格域。達 100% 效率需 n₁ = λcosθ_B/(2d) = 532×0.977/(2×16000) ≈ 0.0163。角度頻寬 Λ/d ≈ 3.0°（層內），波長頻寬 ≈ 127 nm。若實測峰值效率 0.90，反推 n₁ ≈ 0.0129，表示曝光量不足約 20%。同材料的反射式全像：Λ = 177 nm，n₁ = 0.02 時 ν = π×0.02×16/0.532 ≈ 1.89，η = tanh²(1.89) ≈ 0.91，頻寬約 5.9 nm；1% 收縮使布拉格波長藍移 5.3 nm。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: record a 1200 line/mm transmission volume phase grating in a 16 µm self-developing photopolymer with n₀ = 1.5, recording and replaying at 532 nm. The fringe period is Λ = 833 nm; the recording half-angle in air is θ = asin(532/1666) = 18.6°; the internal Bragg angle is θ_B = asin(532/(2×1.5×833)) = 12.3° with cosθ_B = 0.977. The thick-grating parameter Q = 2π×0.532×16/(1.5×0.833²) ≈ 51 places it in the Bragg regime. Full efficiency needs n₁ = λcosθ_B/(2d) = 532×0.977/(2×16000) ≈ 0.0163. The angular bandwidth is Λ/d ≈ 3.0° inside the layer and the spectral bandwidth about 127 nm. A measured peak efficiency of 0.90 inverts to n₁ ≈ 0.0129, meaning the dose was about 20% short. A reflection hologram in the same material has Λ = 177 nm; with n₁ = 0.02, ν = π×0.02×16/0.532 ≈ 1.89, η = tanh²(1.89) ≈ 0.91 and a bandwidth near 5.9 nm; 1% shrinkage blue-shifts the Bragg wavelength by 5.3 nm. Values are teaching assumptions.

title: 液晶空間光調制器
summary: 以 8 µm 像素、1920×1200 的反射式 LCOS 相位調制器為對象，從向列型液晶的雙折射推導 2π 相位行程與單元間隙的關係，計算像素化閃耀光柵的繞射效率與最大偏折角，再把液晶響應時間、相位閃爍、溫度漂移與背板平整度整合成查找表校正與波前修正流程，最後以傅立葉光學系統的驗收指標完成交接。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為 532 nm 與 1064 nm 兩用的反射式 LCOS 相位調制器選單元間隙。材料 Δn = 0.20、可用 Δn_eff = 0.15。行程 φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ：d = 3 µm 在 532 nm 給 2π×(2×0.15×3/0.532) = 1.69×2π，在 1064 nm 只有 0.85×2π，不合格；改 d = 4 µm 則 1064 nm 得 1.13×2π，532 nm 得 2.26×2π，兩波長皆可包裹到 2π。代價是響應：τ_off = γ₁d²/(π²K) = 0.1×16×10⁻¹²/(9.87×10⁻¹¹) ≈ 16 ms，比 3 µm 的 9 ms 慢 1.8 倍。顯示 8 像素週期（p = 8 µm）閃耀光柵，532 nm 的偏折角 sinθ = 0.532/64 = 0.0083（0.48°），f = 300 mm 時焦點移動 2.5 mm；理論效率 sinc²(1/8) = 95%，乘上反射率 0.90 與填充因子 0.956 得 81.7%。查找表若把 2π 對應到灰階 200，每級 0.0314 rad，可忽略量化損失。相位閃爍 σ = 0.15 rad 時 Strehl ≈ exp(−0.0225) ≈ 0.978。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: choose the cell gap of a reflective LCOS phase modulator meant for both 532 nm and 1064 nm. The material has Δn = 0.20 with usable Δn_eff = 0.15. The stroke φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ: d = 3 µm gives 2π×(2×0.15×3/0.532) = 1.69×2π at 532 nm but only 0.85×2π at 1064 nm, a fail; d = 4 µm gives 1.13×2π at 1064 nm and 2.26×2π at 532 nm, so both wavelengths wrap to 2π. The price is response: τ_off = γ₁d²/(π²K) = 0.1×16×10⁻¹²/(9.87×10⁻¹¹) ≈ 16 ms, 1.8 times slower than the 9 ms of a 3 µm cell. Displaying an 8-pixel-period blaze (p = 8 µm) at 532 nm steers by sinθ = 0.532/64 = 0.0083 (0.48°), moving the focus 2.5 mm for f = 300 mm; the theoretical efficiency sinc²(1/8) = 95% times reflectance 0.90 and fill factor 0.956 gives 81.7%. If the lookup table maps 2π to grey level 200, each level is 0.0314 rad and quantization loss is negligible. With phase flicker σ = 0.15 rad, Strehl ≈ exp(−0.0225) ≈ 0.978. Values are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：以 0.65 吋 1080p、7.56 µm、±12° 的 DMD 建一台 405 nm 光固化列印引擎。f/# = 1/(2·sin12°) ≈ 2.4，物方 NA = 0.208。有效面積 14.5×8.16 ≈ 118 mm²，光展量 G = 118×π×sin²12° ≈ 16.0 mm²·sr；2×2 mm 朗伯 LED 的 12.6 mm²·sr 可完整耦合。積分柱出口 3.6×2.0 mm，放大 4.0 倍，柱內玻璃中錐角 33.7°，20 mm 長每軸反射 ≈ 3.7 次。亮度鏈：1500 lm × 0.70 × 0.90 × 0.90 × 0.95 × 0.92 × 0.88 × 0.86 × 0.90 ≈ 506 lm。像面像素 50 µm 需 M = 6.6，像方 NA 0.0315，繞射光斑 15.7 µm，景深 ±204 µm，像面寬 96 mm。熱：吸收 0.8 W 加電功率 1.5 W，熱阻 9.2 K/W，溫升 21 K。固化深度 C_d = D_p·ln(E/E_c)，D_p = 100 µm、E = 4E_c 得 139 µm，照度 +10% 多固化 9.5 µm，故均勻度規格取 ±5%。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: build a 405 nm photopolymer printing engine on a 0.65-inch 1080p DMD with 7.56 µm pitch and ±12° tilt. f/# = 1/(2·sin12°) ≈ 2.4, object-side NA = 0.208. Active area 14.5×8.16 ≈ 118 mm² gives étendue G = 118×π×sin²12° ≈ 16.0 mm²·sr; a 2×2 mm Lambertian LED with 12.6 mm²·sr couples in full. The integrator rod exit is 3.6×2.0 mm, magnified 4.0 times, with a 33.7° cone inside the glass and ≈ 3.7 reflections per axis over 20 mm. Flux chain: 1500 lm × 0.70 × 0.90 × 0.90 × 0.95 × 0.92 × 0.88 × 0.86 × 0.90 ≈ 506 lm. A 50 µm image pixel needs M = 6.6, image-side NA 0.0315, a 15.7 µm diffraction spot, ±204 µm depth of field and a 96 mm wide field. Thermal: 0.8 W absorbed plus 1.5 W electrical through 9.2 K/W gives a 21 K rise. Cure depth C_d = D_p·ln(E/E_c) with D_p = 100 µm and E = 4E_c is 139 µm, and +10% irradiance over-cures by 9.5 µm, so the uniformity specification is set at ±5%. Values are teaching assumptions.

title: 相位式計算全像
summary: 以 1920×1080、8 µm 像素的相位型 SLM 與 300 mm 傅立葉透鏡為基準系統，說明重建面取樣與視窗大小的關係、Gerchberg–Saxton 演算法的收斂與計算成本、相位量化與像素包絡的效率損失，再以相機閉環校正、散斑與零階的誤差預算，以及近眼全像顯示的視角與眼盒限制，完成相位全像的設計到驗收流程。

workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: generate a 10×10 optical-tweezer spot array with 0.5 mm spacing using a 1920×1080, p = 8 µm phase-only SLM at λ = 532 nm with f = 300 mm. The window is λf/p ≈ 19.95 mm wide with 10.4 µm cells; the outer spots 2.5 mm off-centre correspond to 15.7 mm⁻¹, an 8-pixel-period grating. The envelope of a 7.6 µm pixel aperture at 2.5 mm is sinc²(0.119) ≈ 0.95, so the outer targets are pre-scaled by 1/0.95. Each GS iteration with two 2.07 Mpixel FFTs costs ≈ 4.4×10⁸ flop, 50 iterations ≈ 2.2×10¹⁰ flop, about 22 ms on a GPU. The 8-bit quantization efficiency of 99.995% is negligible. Weighted GS predicts 0.90 efficiency and 0.99 uniformity; measured 0.85 and 0.96 both pass. Power: 160 mW × 0.85 × 0.50 ≈ 68 mW, 0.68 mW per trap. A 0.5 nm laser drift moves the outer spots by 2.5 mm × 0.094% ≈ 2.4 µm, under one cell and acceptable; a 2 nm drift moves them 9.4 µm and demands temperature stabilization. Values are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.text: 多視角校正練習：假設一台 15.6 吋、45 視點、40° 視角錐的斜向柱狀透鏡顯示器，透鏡節距 0.40 mm、面寬 345 mm。角間距 Δθ = 0.0155 rad，清晰深度約 s/Δθ = 26 mm。初次拍到 3 條摩爾條紋，ε = 3×0.40/345 ≈ 3.5×10⁻³；相移擬合後殘餘 0.008 條條紋，ε = 0.008×0.40/345 ≈ 9.3×10⁻⁶，邊緣錯位 431×9.3×10⁻⁶×45 ≈ 0.18 視點。基材 Δα = 5.8 ppm/K，若內建溫度感測器誤差 1 K，溫度補償後殘差 172.5×5.8×10⁻⁶×1/0.40×45 ≈ 0.11 視點；兩者均方根 √(0.18² + 0.11²) ≈ 0.21 視點，低於 0.25 允收。透鏡焦點調到 r = 0.95，總串擾 9.3%、角亮度漣波 14.9%，兩者都合格。深度靶 z = 30 mm 量得視差 3.25 mm，反推 28.6 mm，誤差 −4.8%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Multiview calibration exercise: assume a 15.6-inch slanted-lenticular display with 45 views over a 40° cone, a 0.40 mm lens pitch and a 345 mm width. The angular pitch is Δθ = 0.0155 rad and the sharp depth range is about s/Δθ = 26 mm. The first capture shows 3 moiré fringes, ε = 3×0.40/345 ≈ 3.5×10⁻³; after phase-shift fitting 0.008 fringe remains, ε = 0.008×0.40/345 ≈ 9.3×10⁻⁶, and the edge misplacement is 431×9.3×10⁻⁶×45 ≈ 0.18 views. The substrate mismatch is Δα = 5.8 ppm/K; with a built-in temperature sensor good to 1 K, the residual after compensation is 172.5×5.8×10⁻⁶×1/0.40×45 ≈ 0.11 views, and the root-sum-square √(0.18² + 0.11²) ≈ 0.21 views is below the 0.25 allowance. With the lens focus set to r = 0.95, total crosstalk is 9.3% and angular luminance ripple 14.9%, both passing. A depth target at z = 30 mm shows 3.25 mm of parallax, inverting to 28.6 mm, a −4.8% error. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 散斑預算練習：綠光 532 nm RGB 雷射投影機，F/2.4、f = 30 mm 鏡頭出瞳 12.5 mm，投射與觀看距離皆 3 m，觀察者瞳孔 3 mm，去偏振體擴散屏的路徑差展開 0.5 mm。R_角 = 12.5/3 ≈ 4.17，所需 N_角 = 4.17² ≈ 17；半徑 0.3 mm、300 Hz 圓周擴散片每圈可提供約 94 個圖樣，足以填滿。R_偏 = √2。多發射體光源頻寬 6 nm、去相關波長 λ²/0.5 mm ≈ 0.566 nm，N_λ ≈ 10.6，R_λ ≈ 3.26。總 R = 4.17×1.41×3.26 ≈ 19.2，C ≈ 5.2%；加上提供 2 個獨立圖樣的振動屏幕，C ≈ 3.7%，達到 4% 目標。等效人眼相機的量測底（散粒 0.71%、PRNU 0.5%、照明 1.0%）合計 1.32%，預期讀值 √(3.7² + 1.32²) ≈ 3.9%。1 ms 工業相機下振動屏幕失效，預期 5.2%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Speckle-budget exercise: a 532 nm green channel of an RGB laser projector with an F/2.4, f = 30 mm lens (12.5 mm exit pupil), throw and viewing distance both 3 m, a 3 mm observer pupil and a depolarizing volume-diffusing screen with 0.5 mm path spread. R_angle = 12.5/3 ≈ 4.17, needing N_angle = 4.17² ≈ 17 patterns; a circular diffuser of 0.3 mm radius at 300 Hz offers about 94 per cycle, enough to fill it. R_pol = √2. A multi-emitter source with 6 nm spread and a decorrelation wavelength of λ²/0.5 mm ≈ 0.566 nm gives N_λ ≈ 10.6 and R_λ ≈ 3.26. Total R = 4.17×1.41×3.26 ≈ 19.2 and C ≈ 5.2%; a vibrating screen contributing 2 independent patterns brings C to ≈ 3.7%, meeting the 4% target. The eye-equivalent camera floor (shot 0.71%, PRNU 0.5%, illumination 1.0%) totals 1.32%, so the expected reading is √(3.7² + 1.32²) ≈ 3.9%. With a 1 ms industrial camera the vibrating screen is ineffective and 5.2% is expected. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：λ = 532 nm、像素 3.45 µm、40×/0.65 物鏡。物光頻寬半寬 f_max = 0.65/(40×0.532 µm) ≈ 30.5 lp/mm，選 3 像素條紋 Λ = 10.35 µm 得 f_c = 96.6 lp/mm，滿足 f_c ≥ 3·f_max = 92 lp/mm 與 f_c + f_max = 127 lp/mm ≤ 145 lp/mm，參考光角度 θ = asin(0.532×0.0966) ≈ 2.95°。反射式量一個 400 nm 台階：Δφ = 4π×0.400/0.532 = 9.45 rad，包裹後為 9.45 − 12.57 = −3.12 rad，若不展開會讀成 −132 nm。加入 561 nm 第二波長，合成波長 Λ = 532×561/29 ≈ 10.29 µm，合成相位 4π×0.400/10.29 ≈ 0.489 rad 不會包裹，反算高度 0.489×10.29/(4π) = 0.400 µm。但合成波長把相位雜訊放大 Λ/λ ≈ 19 倍：σ_φ = 10 mrad 時單波長 σ_h ≈ 0.42 nm，合成波長 σ_h ≈ 8.2 nm，所以用合成波長決定 2π 級數、再用單波長取得細節。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: λ = 532 nm, 3.45 µm pixels, 40×/0.65 objective. The object half-bandwidth is f_max = 0.65/(40×0.532 µm) ≈ 30.5 lp/mm; choosing 3-pixel fringes Λ = 10.35 µm gives f_c = 96.6 lp/mm, satisfying f_c ≥ 3·f_max = 92 lp/mm and f_c + f_max = 127 lp/mm ≤ 145 lp/mm, with reference angle θ = asin(0.532×0.0966) ≈ 2.95°. Measuring a 400 nm step in reflection: Δφ = 4π×0.400/0.532 = 9.45 rad, which wraps to 9.45 − 12.57 = −3.12 rad and reads as −132 nm if not unwrapped. Adding a 561 nm second wavelength gives Λ = 532×561/29 ≈ 10.29 µm; the synthetic phase 4π×0.400/10.29 ≈ 0.489 rad does not wrap and returns 0.489×10.29/(4π) = 0.400 µm. The synthetic wavelength amplifies phase noise by Λ/λ ≈ 19, so with σ_φ = 10 mrad the single-wavelength σ_h ≈ 0.42 nm becomes about 8.2 nm; use the synthetic wavelength to fix the 2π order and the single wavelength for detail. Values are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：光譜域 OCT，λ₀ = 1050 nm、光源 Δλ = 100 nm、2048 像素光譜儀覆蓋 110 nm、A 掃描 100 kHz、樣品臂功率 1.5 mW。軸向解析度 δz = 0.441×1.05²/0.100 ≈ 4.9 µm（空氣），組織內 n = 1.38 約 3.5 µm。每像素 δλ = 110/2048 = 0.0537 nm，深度範圍 z_max = 1.05²/(4×0.0537×10⁻³) µm ≈ 5.1 mm（空氣），每像素深度 5.1 mm/1024 ≈ 5.0 µm，δz 約占 1 像素，屬於臨界取樣。光子能量 1.89×10⁻¹⁹ J，曝光 10 µs 內光子數 1.5×10⁻³×10⁻⁵/1.89×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 7.9×10¹⁰，取 η = 0.7 得散粒雜訊極限 ≈ 5.6×10¹⁰ → 107 dB；在半深度 2.5 mm 處以 w = 1.5 估計衰減 −5.3 dB，可用靈敏度約 102 dB。若實測只有 95 dB，7 dB 差距要依序檢查耦合器分光比、光譜儀效率與參考光強度是否落在散粒雜訊主導區。眼睛約 24 mm 的水色散必須以參考臂水槽或數值補償匹配，否則視網膜處的 δz 會明顯寬於 4.9 µm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: spectral-domain OCT with λ₀ = 1050 nm, source Δλ = 100 nm, a 2048-pixel spectrometer spanning 110 nm, 100 kHz A-scan rate and 1.5 mW in the sample arm. Axial resolution δz = 0.441×1.05²/0.100 ≈ 4.9 µm in air, about 3.5 µm inside tissue with n = 1.38. Per-pixel δλ = 110/2048 = 0.0537 nm, depth range z_max = 1.05²/(4×0.0537×10⁻³) µm ≈ 5.1 mm in air, depth per pixel 5.1 mm/1024 ≈ 5.0 µm, so δz spans about one pixel, which is critical sampling. The photon energy is 1.89×10⁻¹⁹ J; in a 10 µs exposure the photon count is 1.5×10⁻³×10⁻⁵/1.89×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 7.9×10¹⁰, and with η = 0.7 the shot-noise limit is about 5.6×10¹⁰, i.e. 107 dB; at half depth, 2.5 mm, the roll-off estimated with w = 1.5 is −5.3 dB, leaving about 102 dB usable. If only 95 dB is measured, the 7 dB gap is traced through the coupler split ratio, spectrometer efficiency and whether the reference power sits in the shot-noise-dominated regime. The roughly 24 mm of water in an eye must be matched by a reference-arm water cell or numerical compensation, otherwise δz at the retina is clearly wider than 4.9 µm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 取樣與針孔練習：63×/1.4 油鏡、λ_exc = 488 nm、λ_em = 520 nm、n = 1.518。1 AU = 1.22×0.52/1.4 = 0.453 µm，在 63× 中間像面為 28.6 µm 的針孔直徑。橫向半高寬 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm，1 AU 軸向半高寬 ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm；奈奎斯特像素 ≤ 0.089 µm、z 步進 ≤ 0.43 µm，1024 像素對應 92 µm 視場，20 µm 厚的細胞需 47 層。艾里斑第一暗環內含 84% 的能量、第二暗環內含 91%，所以針孔從 1 AU 開到 2 AU 只多收 8% 的焦內訊號，卻把軸向半高寬從 0.85 µm 拉到 1.47 µm，並讓離焦光通過面積增為 4 倍；縮到 0.5 AU 時只剩約 59% 的焦內能量，訊號損失 30% 而解析度僅小幅改善。因此 1 AU 是訊號與切片的常用折衷。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Sampling and pinhole exercise: 63×/1.4 oil objective, λ_exc = 488 nm, λ_em = 520 nm, n = 1.518. 1 AU = 1.22×0.52/1.4 = 0.453 µm, which is a 28.6 µm pinhole at the 63× intermediate image. Lateral FWHM 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm and axial FWHM at 1 AU ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm; Nyquist pixel ≤ 0.089 µm and z-step ≤ 0.43 µm, so 1024 pixels span a 92 µm field and a 20 µm thick cell needs 47 slices. The first dark ring of the Airy pattern encloses 84% of the energy and the second 91%, so opening the pinhole from 1 to 2 AU gains only 8% in-focus signal while stretching the axial FWHM from 0.85 to 1.47 µm and quadrupling the area open to out-of-focus light; closing to 0.5 AU keeps only about 59% of the in-focus energy, a 30% signal loss for a small resolution gain. Hence 1 AU is the usual compromise between signal and sectioning. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.text: 深度與色散練習：920 nm、80 MHz、樣品面 15 mW、NA 1.0 水鏡、δ = 30 GM。由單元一的公式，10 mW 時 n_a ≈ 0.14，15 mW 時按 P² 放大為 0.14×2.25 ≈ 0.31 光子對/分子/脈衝。若顯微鏡 5000 fs² 的色散未補償，脈衝從 100 fs 展寬到 171 fs，n_a 降為 0.31×100/171 ≈ 0.18。在 400 µm 深處、l_s = 200 µm，到達焦點的彈道功率只有 15×e⁻² ≈ 2.0 mW，n_a 再乘 (2.0/15)² ≈ 0.018 變成 0.0033，訊號幾乎消失。要在 400 µm 回到 0.31，需先做預補償，再把表面功率提高到 15×e² ≈ 111 mW，依每 100 mW 約 1.8 K 估計溫升約 2 K；若改用 1300 nm、l_s = 350 µm，所需功率為 15×e^(400/350) ≈ 47 mW，溫升不到 1 K，但水的吸收較高且可用螢光蛋白受限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Depth and dispersion exercise: 920 nm, 80 MHz, 15 mW at the sample, NA 1.0 water objective, δ = 30 GM. From the unit-one formula n_a ≈ 0.14 at 10 mW, so at 15 mW it scales with P² to 0.14×2.25 ≈ 0.31 photon pairs per molecule per pulse. If the microscope's 5000 fs² of dispersion is uncompensated the pulse stretches from 100 to 171 fs and n_a falls to 0.31×100/171 ≈ 0.18. At 400 µm depth with l_s = 200 µm only 15×e⁻² ≈ 2.0 mW of ballistic power reaches the focus, so n_a is multiplied by (2.0/15)² ≈ 0.018 and becomes 0.0033, nearly no signal. To recover 0.31 at 400 µm, first precompensate, then raise the surface power to 15×e² ≈ 111 mW, with a heating estimate of about 2 K at 1.8 K per 100 mW; switching to 1300 nm with l_s = 350 µm needs only 15×e^(400/350) ≈ 47 mW and under 1 K of heating, but water absorption is higher and fewer fluorescent proteins are usable. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.text: 光片設計練習：以 40×/0.8 水浸偵測物鏡為斑馬魚胚胎成像，視野 333 µm、λ = 488 nm。靜態高斯光片要涵蓋全視野需 z_R = 166 µm，w0 = √(166×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.4 µm，光片 FWHM ≈ 5.2 µm，等效軸向 FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/5.2²) ≈ 2.0 µm，光片厚度約為 1.08 µm 景深的 4.8 倍，焦外背景高。改用 w0 = 2 µm 的軸向掃描光片：快門狹縫 211 列，最大光片 FWHM 2.63 µm，等效軸向 ≤ 1.67 µm，厚度／景深比降到 2.4。每幀 50 ms、2 µm 步距取 200 層，每疊 10 s，可容納 30 s 間隔；每疊資料 200×8.39 MB ≈ 1.68 GB，24 小時 2880 疊約 4.8 TB。若 24 小時後要保留一半訊號，每疊漂白須 ≤ 0.024%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Light-sheet design exercise: imaging a zebrafish embryo with a 40×/0.8 water-immersion detection objective over a 333 µm field at λ = 488 nm. A static Gaussian sheet covering the field needs z_R = 166 µm, w0 = √(166×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.4 µm and a sheet FWHM ≈ 5.2 µm, giving an effective axial FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/5.2²) ≈ 2.0 µm with a sheet 4.8 times the 1.08 µm depth of field and heavy out-of-focus background. An axially swept sheet with w0 = 2 µm uses a 211-row shutter slit, a maximum sheet FWHM of 2.63 µm and an effective axial FWHM ≤ 1.67 µm, cutting the thickness-to-depth-of-field ratio to 2.4. At 50 ms per frame and a 2 µm step, 200 planes take 10 s per stack, fitting a 30 s interval; each stack holds 200×8.39 MB ≈ 1.68 GB and 2880 stacks in 24 hours about 4.8 TB. Keeping half the signal after 24 hours requires bleaching ≤ 0.024% per stack. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.text: dSTORM 預算練習：λ = 670 nm、NA = 1.49，PSF 標準差 s ≈ 0.21λ/NA ≈ 94 nm，樣品端像素 100 nm，每次閃爍 N = 1000 光子。TIRF 背景 b = 3 時 Thompson 精度 σ ≈ 3.4 nm，EMCCD 過量雜訊乘 √2 得 4.8 nm。取 20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s，23 nm/min 的漂移累積 77 nm，以金粒子校正後殘差 1.5 nm。一抗加二抗連結 8 nm、雙色配準 3 nm，總 σ ≈ 9.9 nm，FWHM ≈ 23 nm。此解析度需標記 ≥ 7.3×10³ 個/µm²，每個 0.0625 µm² 繞射面積約 456 個標記，佔空比須 ≤ 2.2×10⁻³；染料佔空比 10⁻³ 時約 3000 幀可讓 95% 標記至少亮一次。若改用 STED 達到同樣 23 nm，需 I/I_sat = (229/23)² − 1 ≈ 98。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: dSTORM budget exercise: λ = 670 nm and NA = 1.49 give a PSF standard deviation s ≈ 0.21λ/NA ≈ 94 nm, with 100 nm sample-side pixels and N = 1000 photons per blink. With TIRF background b = 3 the Thompson precision is σ ≈ 3.4 nm, and EMCCD excess noise multiplies it by √2 to 4.8 nm. Acquiring 20 000 frames × 10 ms = 200 s, a drift of 23 nm/min accumulates 77 nm, corrected with gold fiducials to a 1.5 nm residual. With 8 nm primary-plus-secondary linkage and 3 nm two-colour registration the total σ ≈ 9.9 nm and FWHM ≈ 23 nm. That resolution needs ≥ 7.3×10³ labels/µm², about 456 labels per 0.0625 µm² diffraction area, so the duty cycle must be ≤ 2.2×10⁻³; with a dye duty cycle of 10⁻³ about 3000 frames let 95% of labels light at least once. Reaching the same 23 nm with STED would need I/I_sat = (229/23)² − 1 ≈ 98. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.text: 應變矽量測練習：以 532.000 nm 雷射、1800 gr/mm 光柵（0.52 cm⁻¹/像素）量測應變矽通道。無應力參考片在 1 mW（升溫僅約 3 K，忽略）量得 520.70 cm⁻¹ 作為零點。樣品在 10 mW 下的峰值擬合在 547.125 nm，Δν̃ = 18 796.99 − 1/(547.125×10⁻⁷ cm) = 18 796.99 − 18 277.36 ≈ 519.63 cm⁻¹。10 mW 造成約 30 K 升溫、峰位 −0.66 cm⁻¹，修正後 520.29 cm⁻¹，Δω = −0.41 cm⁻¹，以 σ ≈ −500 MPa × Δω 得單軸拉伸應力約 +205 MPa；若忘記加熱修正，Δω = −1.07 cm⁻¹ 會被報成 +535 MPa，高估 2.6 倍。峰位擬合精度 ±0.05 cm⁻¹（約 1/10 像素）對應 ±25 MPa；若雷射漂移 0.01 nm 而未以參考片重校，再多出 0.35 cm⁻¹ ≈ 177 MPa 的誤差。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Strained-silicon exercise: a strained silicon channel is measured with a 532.000 nm laser and a 1800 gr/mm grating (0.52 cm⁻¹ per pixel). An unstressed reference measured at 1 mW (heating only about 3 K, neglected) reads 520.70 cm⁻¹ and sets the zero. The sample at 10 mW fits to a peak at 547.125 nm, so Δν̃ = 18 796.99 − 1/(547.125×10⁻⁷ cm) = 18 796.99 − 18 277.36 ≈ 519.63 cm⁻¹. The 10 mW beam heats by about 30 K and shifts the band −0.66 cm⁻¹, so the corrected value is 520.29 cm⁻¹, Δω = −0.41 cm⁻¹, and σ ≈ −500 MPa × Δω gives about +205 MPa uniaxial tension; forgetting the heating correction reports Δω = −1.07 cm⁻¹ as +535 MPa, a 2.6-fold overestimate. A fit precision of ±0.05 cm⁻¹ (about one tenth of a pixel) corresponds to ±25 MPa, and an uncorrected 0.01 nm laser drift adds 0.35 cm⁻¹ ≈ 177 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.text: 量測規劃練習：目標解析度 2 cm⁻¹、範圍 4000–400 cm⁻¹、KBr/Ge 分光鏡、DTGS 偵測器。最大光程差 Δ_max = 1/2 = 0.5 cm，動鏡行程 2.5 mm；取樣間隔 632.8 nm（每隔一個零交越）給奈奎斯特 7899 cm⁻¹，單邊點數 N = 0.5/632.8×10⁻⁷ ≈ 7900，雙邊約 15800 點，補零到 32768 點做 FFT。光程差速度 0.6329 cm/s 時一次雙邊掃描 2×0.5/0.6329 ≈ 1.58 s，64 次掃描約 101 s。雅基諾光闌：R = 4000/2 = 2000，Ω = 2π/2000 = 3.14×10⁻³ sr，θ = √(Ω/π) = 0.0316 rad，焦距 100 mm 下光闌直徑 6.3 mm；光闌引起的刻度偏移 −θ²/4 = −2.5×10⁻⁴，在 2849.5 cm⁻¹ 為 −0.71 cm⁻¹，由有效雷射波數校正吸收。雜訊：若 32 次掃描的 100% 線均方根為 1×10⁻⁴，64 次約 7.1×10⁻⁵，吸光度雜訊 ≈ 0.434×7.1×10⁻⁵ ≈ 3.1×10⁻⁵ AU，三倍偵測極限約 9×10⁻⁵ AU。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何機型規格。
workedExample.textEn: Measurement-planning exercise: target resolution 2 cm⁻¹, range 4000–400 cm⁻¹, KBr/Ge beamsplitter, DTGS detector. The maximum path difference is Δ_max = 1/2 = 0.5 cm, mirror travel 2.5 mm; a 632.8 nm sampling interval (every second zero crossing) gives a 7899 cm⁻¹ Nyquist limit, N = 0.5/632.8×10⁻⁷ ≈ 7900 points per side, about 15800 double-sided, zero-filled to 32768 for the FFT. At a path-difference velocity of 0.6329 cm/s one double-sided scan takes 2×0.5/0.6329 ≈ 1.58 s and 64 scans about 101 s. Jacquinot stop: R = 4000/2 = 2000, Ω = 2π/2000 = 3.14×10⁻³ sr, θ = √(Ω/π) = 0.0316 rad, stop diameter 6.3 mm at 100 mm focal length; the aperture-induced scale shift is −θ²/4 = −2.5×10⁻⁴, i.e. −0.71 cm⁻¹ at 2849.5 cm⁻¹, absorbed by the effective-laser-wavenumber calibration. Noise: if the 32-scan 100% line RMS is 1×10⁻⁴, 64 scans give about 7.1×10⁻⁵, an absorbance noise of ≈ 0.434×7.1×10⁻⁵ ≈ 3.1×10⁻⁵ AU and a three-sigma detection limit near 9×10⁻⁵ AU. workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: SiO₂/Si 建置驗證練習：取 n_SiO₂ = 1.457、n_Si = 3.882 − 0.019i、λ = 632.8 nm、φ = 70°，厚度 d = 100 nm。相位厚度 β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ) = 2π×(100/632.8)×1.1135 = 1.106 rad；以艾里公式分別算 p、s 反射係數並取比值，得 Ψ = 41.06°、Δ = 79.79°。若用旋轉檢偏鏡、P = 45°，預期的傅立葉係數為 α = (tan²Ψ − 1)/(tan²Ψ + 1) = −0.137、β = 2tanΨ·cosΔ/(tan²Ψ + 1) = 0.176；反解 tanΨ = √((1 + α)/(1 − α)) = 0.871、cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²) = 0.177，回到 41.06° 與 79.79°。靈敏度：dΨ/dd = 0.55°/nm，Ψ 解析度 0.01° 對應 0.02 nm；入射角誤差 0.1° 使 Δ 偏 −0.38° 而 Ψ 幾乎不動，擬合 MSE 升高即為警訊。厚度週期 284 nm 表示 100 nm 與 384 nm 在單波長下無法區分，需光譜或多角度。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何儀器規格。
workedExample.textEn: SiO₂/Si construction-check exercise: take n_SiO₂ = 1.457, n_Si = 3.882 − 0.019i, λ = 632.8 nm, φ = 70° and thickness d = 100 nm. The phase thickness is β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ) = 2π×(100/632.8)×1.1135 = 1.106 rad; evaluating the Airy formula for p and s and ratioing gives Ψ = 41.06° and Δ = 79.79°. With a rotating analyzer and P = 45° the expected Fourier coefficients are α = (tan²Ψ − 1)/(tan²Ψ + 1) = −0.137 and β = 2tanΨ·cosΔ/(tan²Ψ + 1) = 0.176; inverting, tanΨ = √((1 + α)/(1 − α)) = 0.871 and cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²) = 0.177, returning 41.06° and 79.79°. Sensitivity: dΨ/dd = 0.55°/nm, so 0.01° in Ψ resolves 0.02 nm; a 0.1° angle error shifts Δ by −0.38° while Ψ barely moves, and the rising fit MSE is the warning sign. The 284 nm thickness period means 100 nm and 384 nm are indistinguishable at one wavelength, so spectroscopic or multi-angle data are required. All values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: LED 總光通量量測練習：直徑 200 mm 的燒結 PTFE 球，ρ = 0.98、有效開口比 f = 0.03，M = 0.98/(1 − 0.98×0.97) = 19.8；球內表面積 A_s = 0.1257 m²。待測白光 LED 輻射通量約 1 W 時壁面輻照度 E = 1×19.8/0.1257 = 157.9 W/m²，輻射亮度 L = 50.3 W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹，1 mm² 矽偵測器收到 0.158 mW、光電流約 52 µA。替代法：標準燈 1000 lm 讀 2.000 V，LED 讀 1.500 V，輔助燈在標準燈與 LED 在位時分別讀 1.040 V 與 1.000 V，自吸收修正 α = 1.040；光譜失配修正 F* = 1.015。Φ_DUT = 1000×(1.500/2.000)×1.040×1.015 = 792 lm。不確定度：u_c = 0.76%（k = 1），U = 1.5%（k = 2），即 792 ± 12 lm。若球壁因污染使 ρ 降到 0.97 而標準燈未在同一天重量，M 由 19.8 降到 16.4，所有結果會偏低 17%——這就是每次量測都要重做替代法的原因。所有數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: LED total-luminous-flux exercise: a 200 mm sintered-PTFE sphere with ρ = 0.98 and effective port fraction f = 0.03 has M = 0.98/(1 − 0.98×0.97) = 19.8 and interior area A_s = 0.1257 m². For a white LED emitting about 1 W of radiant flux the wall irradiance is E = 1×19.8/0.1257 = 157.9 W/m², the radiance L = 50.3 W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹, and a 1 mm² silicon detector receives 0.158 mW, about 52 µA of photocurrent. Substitution: the 1000 lm standard lamp reads 2.000 V, the LED reads 1.500 V, the auxiliary lamp reads 1.040 V and 1.000 V with the standard lamp and the LED in place, so the self-absorption correction is α = 1.040; the spectral mismatch factor is F* = 1.015. Φ_DUT = 1000×(1.500/2.000)×1.040×1.015 = 792 lm. Uncertainty: u_c = 0.76% (k = 1), U = 1.5% (k = 2), i.e. 792 ± 12 lm. If contamination lowered ρ to 0.97 and the standard lamp were not remeasured the same day, M would fall from 19.8 to 16.4 and every result would read 17% low, which is why substitution is repeated at every measurement. All values are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 頻率梳設計核對：摻鉺光纖梳 f_rep = 250 MHz，f_ceo 鎖在 20 MHz。1550 nm（193.41 THz）的梳齒序數 n = 773,658；一支 1550 nm 連續波雷射與該梳齒拍頻 35.000 MHz，把 f_rep 提高 1.000 Hz 後拍頻變為 34.226 MHz（移動 773.66 kHz），證明 f_cw 高於梳齒且 n 正確。射頻參考：氫邁射 1 s 穩定度 1×10⁻¹³ 使光頻不確定度 = 193.41 THz×10⁻¹³ = 19.3 Hz；改用 1×10⁻¹⁵ 的腔穩頻雷射作光學參考則為 0.19 Hz。致動器：10 µm 壓電行程在 1.2 m 光程上給 ±1042 Hz 的 f_rep 範圍，對應梳齒 ±0.81 GHz；熱漂移 1850 Hz/K 表示溫度變化 0.56 K 就耗盡壓電，故外殼溫控 ±0.1 K（±185 Hz）並用步進平台卸載。鎖定品質：殘餘相位雜訊 σ_φ = 0.3 rad → 相干載波 exp(−0.09) = 91%；每秒一次週期滑脫等於 1 Hz = 5.2×10⁻¹⁵，遠高於雙梳比對的 2×10⁻¹⁶（1 s）基準，因此需要雙計數器滑脫偵測。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Comb design check: an erbium fibre comb with f_rep = 250 MHz and f_ceo locked at 20 MHz. The tooth at 1550 nm (193.41 THz) has mode number n = 773,658; a 1550 nm cw laser beats with it at 35.000 MHz, and after raising f_rep by 1.000 Hz the beat becomes 34.226 MHz (a 773.66 kHz shift), proving that f_cw lies above the tooth and that n is right. RF reference: a hydrogen maser at 1×10⁻¹³ in 1 s gives an optical uncertainty of 193.41 THz×10⁻¹³ = 19.3 Hz; a 1×10⁻¹⁵ cavity-stabilised laser as optical reference gives 0.19 Hz. Actuators: a 10 µm piezo stroke on 1.2 m of optical path gives ±1042 Hz of f_rep range, ±0.81 GHz at the tooth; thermal drift of 1850 Hz/K means a 0.56 K change exhausts the piezo, so the housing is held to ±0.1 K (±185 Hz) and a stepper stage offloads. Lock quality: residual phase noise σ_φ = 0.3 rad → coherent carrier exp(−0.09) = 91%; one cycle slip per second equals 1 Hz = 5.2×10⁻¹⁵, far above the 2×10⁻¹⁶ (1 s) comb-versus-comb floor, hence dual-counter slip detection. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 鍶晶格鐘設計核對：鐘躍遷 ν = 429.228 THz，探測線寬 1 Hz（Q = 4.3×10¹⁴），N = 1000 個原子（SNR = 31.6），週期 T_c = 1.5 s：量子投影雜訊極限 σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷；若鐘雷射與迪克效應把 1 s 穩定度限制在 2×10⁻¹⁶，平均到 1×10⁻¹⁸ 需 (2×10⁻¹⁶/10⁻¹⁸)² = 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 小時。真空：烘烤後放氣 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/(s·cm²)×3000 cm² = 3×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s，抽速 50 L/s 給 6×10⁻¹¹ mbar，晶格壽命約 80 s。鐘雷射腔：L = 100 mm、F = 3×10⁵，FSR 1.50 GHz、線寬 5.0 kHz，1×10⁻¹⁶ 的穩定度對應腔長 10 am。黑體輻射：300 K 位移 −5×10⁻¹⁵，要把不確定度壓到 5×10⁻¹⁹ 需腔溫知道到 7.5 mK。系統預算合成 9.3×10⁻¹⁹。光纖：10 m、1 K 的漂移在 100 s 內給 3.3×10⁻¹⁵，光纖雜訊消除為必要。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何實驗室的實際評估。
workedExample.textEn: Strontium lattice-clock design check: clock transition ν = 429.228 THz, probe linewidth 1 Hz (Q = 4.3×10¹⁴), N = 1000 atoms (SNR = 31.6), cycle T_c = 1.5 s: the quantum-projection limit is σ_y(1 s) ≈ √1.5/(π×4.3×10¹⁴×31.6) ≈ 2.9×10⁻¹⁷; if clock-laser noise and the Dick effect limit the 1 s stability to 2×10⁻¹⁶, averaging to 1×10⁻¹⁸ takes (2×10⁻¹⁶/10⁻¹⁸)² = 4×10⁴ s ≈ 11 hours. Vacuum: baked outgassing 1×10⁻¹² mbar·L/(s·cm²)×3000 cm² = 3×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s with 50 L/s pumping gives 6×10⁻¹¹ mbar and a lattice lifetime near 80 s. Clock-laser cavity: L = 100 mm, F = 3×10⁵, FSR 1.50 GHz, linewidth 5.0 kHz, and 1×10⁻¹⁶ stability corresponds to 10 am of cavity length. Vibration: ground noise of 10⁻⁶ m/s²/√Hz over a 5 Hz bandwidth gives 0.36 rad, reduced 30-fold by hybrid correction to 12 mrad ≈ 7.5 µGal. workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 導航級光纖陀螺設計核對：L = 1000 m、D = 0.1 m、λ = 1550 nm，比例因子 S = 2πLD/(λc) = 1.352 rad per rad/s；地球自轉 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s 給 98.6 µrad，1°/h 給 6.56 µrad。線圈傳播時間 τ = nL/c = 4.90 µs，本徵頻率 f_p = 102.1 kHz。光源 30 nm ASE：相干長度 54.6 µm，RIN ≈ 1/3.74 THz = 2.67×10⁻¹³/Hz。雜訊：I = 18 µA 的散粒雜訊相位 1.33×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz → ARW_shot = 3.4×10⁻⁴ °/√h；RIN 相位 5.17×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz → 1.31×10⁻³ °/√h；合成 ARW ≈ 1.36×10⁻³ °/√h。熱：端對端 0.01 K/min 的不對稱升溫速率給舒佩相位 5.5 µrad = 0.84°/h，四極繞法壓到約 0.008°/h。閉迴路：100°/s 時相位斜坡 76.7 kHz，動態範圍 3.6×10⁹。艾倫偏差預測：σ(1 s) = 0.081°/h，與 0.005°/h 零偏不穩定性的平坦區（0.0033°/h）交於 τ ≈ 600 s，符合導航級門檻。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Navigation-grade FOG design check: L = 1000 m, D = 0.1 m, λ = 1550 nm, scale factor S = 2πLD/(λc) = 1.352 rad per rad/s; Earth's rotation of 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s gives 98.6 µrad and 1°/h gives 6.56 µrad. Coil transit time τ = nL/c = 4.90 µs, proper frequency f_p = 102.1 kHz. A 30 nm ASE source has a coherence length of 54.6 µm and RIN ≈ 1/3.74 THz = 2.67×10⁻¹³/Hz. Noise: shot-noise phase at I = 18 µA is 1.33×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz → ARW_shot = 3.4×10⁻⁴ °/√h; RIN phase 5.17×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz → 1.31×10⁻³ °/√h; combined ARW ≈ 1.36×10⁻³ °/√h. Thermal: an end-to-end asymmetric heating rate of 0.01 K/min gives a Shupe phase of 5.5 µrad = 0.84°/h, reduced to about 0.008°/h by quadrupole winding. Closed loop: at 100°/s the phase ramp runs at 76.7 kHz and the dynamic range is 3.6×10⁹. Allan prediction: σ(1 s) = 0.081°/h, meeting the 0.0033°/h floor of a 0.005°/h bias instability at τ ≈ 600 s, within the navigation-grade threshold. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.text: 環形雷射陀螺儀設計練習：正三角形環、邊長 0.10 m，L = 0.30 m，A = (√3/4)×0.01 = 4.33×10⁻³ m²，λ = 632.8 nm。比例因子 S = 4A/(λL) = 0.01732/(1.898×10⁻⁷) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s)，每條紋 2.26 arcsec。在北緯 25° 水平放置，地球自轉拍頻 = 9.12×10⁴×7.292×10⁻⁵×0.4226 ≈ 2.81 Hz。取背向散射 r_s = 1×10⁻⁶：f_L = c·r_s/(2πL) ≈ 159 Hz，鎖定門檻 Ω_L = 159/9.12×10⁴ ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s，比地球自轉大 24 倍，所以不抖動就讀不到地球自轉。加入 400 Hz、100 arcsec 峰值的抖動：Ω_d ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s，殘餘 ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h。若零偏不穩定度 0.01 °/h，10 min 陀螺羅經對準的航向誤差 ≈ √(2.5² + 4.3²) arcmin ≈ 5 arcmin（ARW 0.007 °/√h 的 10 min 殘餘為 0.017 °/h → 4.3 arcmin）。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Ring-laser gyro design exercise: equilateral triangle of side 0.10 m, L = 0.30 m, A = (√3/4)×0.01 = 4.33×10⁻³ m², λ = 632.8 nm. Scale factor S = 4A/(λL) = 0.01732/(1.898×10⁻⁷) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s), 2.26 arcsec per fringe. Placed horizontally at 25° N, the Earth-rate beat is 9.12×10⁴×7.292×10⁻⁵×0.4226 ≈ 2.81 Hz. With backscatter r_s = 1×10⁻⁶: f_L = c·r_s/(2πL) ≈ 159 Hz and the lock-in threshold Ω_L = 159/9.12×10⁴ ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s, 24 times Earth rate, so without dither Earth rotation is unreadable. Adding 400 Hz dither at 100 arcsec peak: Ω_d ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s and residual ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h. With 0.01 °/h bias instability, a 10 min gyrocompass alignment gives heading error ≈ √(2.5² + 4.3²) arcmin ≈ 5 arcmin (the 10 min residual of 0.007 °/√h is 0.017 °/h → 4.3 arcmin). All values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.text: 位移量測預算練習：平面鏡外差干涉儀量 500 mm 平台，λ_vac = 632.99 nm，空氣 n = 1.000271，λ_air = 632.82 nm，條紋週期 λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm，全行程 3.16×10⁶ 個條紋，1024 細分給 0.154 nm 解析度。環境感測器不確定度 0.1 K、0.1 hPa、2 %RH，折射率不確定度 √(0.093² + 0.027² + 0.017²) ≈ 0.098 ppm，對 500 mm 為 49 nm；死程 50 mm 在 0.3 ppm 變化下 15 nm；Abbe 偏距 20 mm、俯仰 5 arcsec（24.2 µrad）給 485 nm；餘弦角 0.3 mrad 給 0.5×(0.3×10⁻³)²/2 = 22.5 nm；波長 1×10⁻⁸ 給 5 nm；非線性 0.8 nm。RSS ≈ 488 nm，k = 2 約 0.98 µm。若把 Abbe 偏距改到 2 mm，該項降為 48.5 nm，RSS 降到 ≈ 74 nm，k = 2 ≈ 0.15 µm，改善超過 6 倍，而干涉儀本身一項都沒變。數值為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Displacement-budget exercise: a plane-mirror heterodyne interferometer on a 500 mm stage, λ_vac = 632.99 nm, air n = 1.000271, λ_air = 632.82 nm, fringe period λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm, 3.16×10⁶ fringes over full travel, 1024 subdivisions giving 0.154 nm resolution. Sensor uncertainties of 0.1 K, 0.1 hPa and 2 %RH give an index uncertainty √(0.093² + 0.027² + 0.017²) ≈ 0.098 ppm, 49 nm over 500 mm; a 50 mm dead path under 0.3 ppm change gives 15 nm; a 20 mm Abbe offset with 5 arcsec (24.2 µrad) pitch gives 485 nm; a 0.3 mrad cosine angle gives 0.5×(0.3×10⁻³)²/2 = 22.5 nm; wavelength at 1×10⁻⁸ gives 5 nm; non-linearity 0.8 nm. RSS ≈ 488 nm, k = 2 about 0.98 µm. Reducing the Abbe offset to 2 mm drops that term to 48.5 nm, the RSS to ≈ 74 nm and k = 2 to ≈ 0.15 µm, a better than sixfold improvement without touching the interferometer itself. title: 白光干涉表面輪廓儀

workedExample.text: MEMS 台階量測練習：以 50× Mirau 物鏡（NA 0.55）、λ₀ = 570 nm、Δλ = 100 nm 量一個標稱 2.5 µm 的矽台階。相干長度 l_c = 570²/100 ≈ 3.25 µm，包絡高度寬度 ≈ 1.6 µm，台階 2.5 µm 大於 1.6 µm，所以上下兩面包絡分離、不會有蝙蝠翼。掃描範圍 20 µm、步距 λ₀/8 = 71 nm → 281 幀，100 幀/秒需 2.8 s。橫向解析度 0.61×570/0.55 ≈ 0.63 µm，視場 133 µm。光子雜訊：N = 10⁴、V = 0.5 → 單幀 0.9 nm，包絡內 40 幀平均 ≈ 0.14 nm。不確定度：放大係數 0.2%×2.5 µm = 5 nm、參考面殘餘 2 nm、標準片證書 2 nm、雜訊 0.14 nm、取樣區 1 nm，RSS ≈ 5.8 nm，k = 2 ≈ 12 nm，相對 0.5%。若改用 10× 物鏡，橫向解析度退到 1.16 µm，台階邊緣的過渡區加寬，但高度不確定度幾乎不變。數值為教學假設，不代表任何儀器規格。
workedExample.textEn: MEMS step exercise: measure a nominal 2.5 µm silicon step with a 50× Mirau objective (NA 0.55), λ₀ = 570 nm, Δλ = 100 nm. Coherence length l_c = 570²/100 ≈ 3.25 µm, envelope height width ≈ 1.6 µm; the 2.5 µm step exceeds 1.6 µm, so the upper and lower envelopes separate and no batwings occur. Scan range 20 µm at a step of λ₀/8 = 71 nm → 281 frames, 2.8 s at 100 frames per second. Lateral resolution 0.61×570/0.55 ≈ 0.63 µm, field 133 µm. Photon noise: N = 10⁴, V = 0.5 → 0.9 nm per frame, ≈ 0.14 nm after averaging 40 frames inside the envelope. Uncertainty: amplification 0.2%×2.5 µm = 5 nm, reference residual 2 nm, standard certificate 2 nm, noise 0.14 nm, sampling region 1 nm, RSS ≈ 5.8 nm, k = 2 ≈ 12 nm, relative 0.5%. Switching to a 10× objective degrades lateral resolution to 1.16 µm and widens the edge transition but leaves the height uncertainty almost unchanged. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 成像條件設計練習：在碳膜上拍 20 nm 金顆粒，Schottky 源、5 kV、I_p = 50 pA、α = 5 mrad、C_s = C_c = 2 mm、ΔE = 0.7 eV、β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹。λ = 17.3 pm；d_g = (2/(π×0.005))×√(5×10⁻¹¹/2×10¹¹) = 2.0 nm；d_d = 0.61×17.3 pm/0.005 = 2.1 nm；d_s = 0.5×2 mm×(0.005)³ = 0.13 nm；d_c = 2 mm×(0.7/5000)×0.005 = 1.4 nm；d_p = √(2.0² + 2.1² + 0.13² + 1.4²) ≈ 3.2 nm，對 20 nm 顆粒足夠。像素取 1.5 nm → 1024 像素掃描寬 1.54 µm。對比 C = 10%、δ = 0.3、收集效率 0.5：每像素需 2500 個偵測電子，停留 53 µs，單幀 56 s。若漂移 1 nm/min，拖影 0.93 nm；改成 8 幀各 7 s 對齊疊加，單幀拖影 0.12 nm。要用 EDS 確認顆粒是金，20 kV 的 Au Mα 激發體積約 1 µm，顆粒訊號被稀釋百倍以上，所以改用 5 kV 的 Au Mα（2.12 keV，過電壓比 2.4）並接受更長的計數時間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何儀器規格。
workedExample.textEn: Imaging-condition exercise: image 20 nm gold particles on carbon with a Schottky source at 5 kV, I_p = 50 pA, α = 5 mrad, C_s = C_c = 2 mm, ΔE = 0.7 eV, β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹. λ = 17.3 pm; d_g = (2/(π×0.005))×√(5×10⁻¹¹/2×10¹¹) = 2.0 nm; d_d = 0.61×17.3 pm/0.005 = 2.1 nm; d_s = 0.5×2 mm×(0.005)³ = 0.13 nm; d_c = 2 mm×(0.7/5000)×0.005 = 1.4 nm; d_p = √(2.0² + 2.1² + 0.13² + 1.4²) ≈ 3.2 nm, adequate for 20 nm particles. Choose 1.5 nm pixels → 1024 pixels span 1.54 µm. With contrast C = 10%, δ = 0.3 and collection efficiency 0.5, each pixel needs 2500 detected electrons, a 53 µs dwell and a 56 s frame. With 1 nm/min drift the smear is 0.93 nm; switching to 8 aligned frames of 7 s each cuts the per-frame smear to 0.12 nm. To confirm the particles are gold by EDS, the Au Mα excitation volume at 20 kV is about 1 µm and the particle signal is diluted more than a hundredfold, so use Au Mα at 5 kV (2.12 keV, overvoltage ratio 2.4) and accept longer counting. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 300 kV 解析度預算練習：λ = 1.97 pm。未校正、C_s = 0.6 mm：Scherzer 解析度 d_S = 0.66×(0.6×10⁻³×(1.97×10⁻¹²)³)^¼ ≈ 0.17 nm，Scherzer 離焦 −1.2×√(0.6×10⁻³×1.97×10⁻¹²) ≈ −41 nm，最佳光圈半角 (4λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10.7 mrad；矽 [110] 的 0.136 nm 啞鈴無法分開。裝上六極校正器把 C_s 壓到 µm 等級後，光圈由 C₅ = 5 mm 限制在 (λ/C₅)^⅙ ≈ 27 mrad，解析度改由資訊極限決定：C_c = 1.4 mm、Schottky ΔE = 0.7 eV、ΔV/V = 1 ppm、ΔI/I = 0.5 ppm 給焦距散佈 Δ ≈ 4.5 nm、d_info = √(πλΔ/2) ≈ 0.12 nm，啞鈴勉強可分；加單色器到 ΔE = 0.2 eV 後 Δ ≈ 2.3 nm、d_info ≈ 0.084 nm，啞鈴清楚分開。若樣品是石墨烯，300 kV 的最大傳遞能量 71 eV 遠超 17 eV 的位移閾值，必須降到 80 kV（15.8 eV），此時 λ = 4.18 pm，同樣的 Δ 給 d_info ≈ 0.12 nm，仍足以分辨 0.213 nm 的碳六員環間距。數值為教學假設，不代表任何儀器規格。
workedExample.textEn: 300 kV resolution-budget exercise: λ = 1.97 pm. Uncorrected with C_s = 0.6 mm: Scherzer resolution d_S = 0.66×(0.6×10⁻³×(1.97×10⁻¹²)³)^¼ ≈ 0.17 nm, Scherzer defocus −1.2×√(0.6×10⁻³×1.97×10⁻¹²) ≈ −41 nm, optimum semi-angle (4λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10.7 mrad; the 0.136 nm silicon [110] dumbbells cannot be separated. With a hexapole corrector bringing C_s to the micrometre level, the aperture is limited by C₅ = 5 mm at (λ/C₅)^⅙ ≈ 27 mrad and resolution passes to the information limit: C_c = 1.4 mm, Schottky ΔE = 0.7 eV, ΔV/V = 1 ppm and ΔI/I = 0.5 ppm give a focal spread Δ ≈ 4.5 nm and d_info = √(πλΔ/2) ≈ 0.12 nm, barely resolving the dumbbells; a monochromator at ΔE = 0.2 eV gives Δ ≈ 2.3 nm and d_info ≈ 0.084 nm, resolving them clearly. For graphene the 71 eV maximum transfer at 300 kV far exceeds the 17 eV displacement threshold, so the voltage must drop to 80 kV (15.8 eV), where λ = 4.18 pm and the same Δ gives d_info ≈ 0.12 nm, still enough for the 0.213 nm carbon-ring spacing. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 單顆粒資料集規劃練習：目標是直徑 100 Å、約 300 kDa 的蛋白質做到 3 Å，300 kV、λ = 0.0197 Å。像素取 0.9 Å（Nyquist 1.8 Å，留 1.7 倍餘裕）；離焦範圍 0.8 到 2.0 µm，1.5 µm 時第一零點 17.2 Å、3 Å 前有 33 個零點，離焦容差 11 nm 靠逐張 CTF 擬合達成。總劑量 40 e⁻/Å² 分 40 幀，前 11 e⁻/Å² 承載 3 Å 資訊，其餘以劑量加權壓低；偵測器劑量率 40×0.9²/8 ≈ 4 e⁻/像素/s。Ewald 極限 √(0.0197×100) ≈ 1.4 Å，3 Å 不需修正。顆粒數：以 B = 100 Å² 與 4 Å 需 2 萬顆推算，3 Å 需 2 萬×11.4 ≈ 23 萬顆；每部電影 150 顆 → 1520 部；每部 12 s → 約 5 小時；原始資料 1520×1.34 GB ≈ 2 TB。冰厚 100 nm 時 22% 電子非彈性散射，若能做到 50 nm 則 12%，顆粒對比提升約 1.5 倍、所需顆粒數可降一半。數值為教學假設，不代表任何儀器或設施規格。
workedExample.textEn: Single-particle dataset planning exercise: target 3 Å for a 100 Å, roughly 300 kDa protein at 300 kV with λ = 0.0197 Å. Pixel 0.9 Å (Nyquist 1.8 Å, 1.7-fold margin); defocus range 0.8 to 2.0 µm, where at 1.5 µm the first zero is 17.2 Å with 33 zeros before 3 Å and the 11 nm defocus tolerance is met by per-image CTF fitting. Total dose 40 e⁻/Å² in 40 frames, the first 11 e⁻/Å² carrying the 3 Å information and the rest down-weighted; detector dose rate 40×0.9²/8 ≈ 4 e⁻/pixel/s. Ewald limit √(0.0197×100) ≈ 1.4 Å, so no correction at 3 Å. Particle count: with B = 100 Å² and 20,000 particles needed for 4 Å, 3 Å needs 20,000×11.4 ≈ 230,000; at 150 per movie → 1520 movies; at 12 s each → about 5 hours; raw data 1520×1.34 GB ≈ 2 TB. With 100 nm ice 22% of electrons scatter inelastically; at 50 nm only 12%, raising particle contrast about 1.5-fold and roughly halving the particles needed. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's or facility's specification.

workedExample.text: TEM 薄片製程預算練習（矽，0.275 µm³/nC）：兩側粗切溝槽各 15 × 8 × 6 µm，共 1440 µm³，需 1440/0.275 ≈ 5240 nC，以 9 nA 約 9.7 分鐘；把 2 µm 厚的薄片在 15 × 6 µm 範圍減薄到 0.5 µm，移除 135 µm³ 需 491 nC，以 1 nA 約 8.2 分鐘；最後在 10 × 5 µm 視窗由 0.5 µm 減到 0.1 µm，移除 20 µm³ 需 72.7 nC，以 0.1 nA 約 12 分鐘，30 kV 切削合計約 30 分鐘。若只以 30 kV 收尾到 60 nm，每側 22 nm 非晶層讓結晶核心只剩 16 nm；加做 5 kV 與 2 kV 清潔後每側約 2.5 nm，核心 55 nm（92%）。若精修光闌實際束流比標示低 8% 而未校正，最後一步只移除 18.4 µm³，薄片停在約 0.13 µm，需要額外 1 分鐘補切。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: TEM-lamella process budget for silicon at 0.275 µm³/nC: two rough trenches of 15 × 8 × 6 µm total 1440 µm³ and need 1440/0.275 ≈ 5240 nC, about 9.7 minutes at 9 nA; thinning the 2 µm lamella over 15 × 6 µm to 0.5 µm removes 135 µm³ with 491 nC, about 8.2 minutes at 1 nA; finally thinning a 10 × 5 µm window from 0.5 to 0.1 µm removes 20 µm³ with 72.7 nC, about 12 minutes at 0.1 nA, for about 30 minutes of 30 kV milling in all. Finishing at 30 kV only to 60 nm leaves 22 nm of amorphous material per face and a crystalline core of just 16 nm; adding 5 kV and 2 kV cleaning brings each face to about 2.5 nm and the core to 55 nm (92%). If the polishing aperture delivers 8% less than its label without correction, the last step removes only 18.4 µm³ and the lamella stops near 0.13 µm, needing about one more minute of milling. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 雜訊預算練習：假設 κ = 1.02 Å⁻¹、前置放大器 R_f = 1 GΩ 在 300 K、頻寬 1 kHz、設定電流 100 pA。Johnson 雜訊 0.13 pA、散粒雜訊 0.18 pA，合成 0.22 pA rms，相對 0.22%，等效間隙雜訊 0.0022/(2×1.02) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³ Å = 0.11 pm；加上隔振後殘餘振動 0.06 pm，總 z 雜訊 √(0.11² + 0.06²) ≈ 0.13 pm，對 HOPG 約 20 pm 的原子起伏信噪比約 150。若把設定電流降到 10 pA，散粒雜訊降為 0.057 pA，但 Johnson 雜訊仍為 0.13 pA，合成 0.14 pA 相對 1.4%，等效間隙雜訊升到 0.0014/2.04 ≈ 0.7 pm，信噪比掉到約 28，說明低電流成像必須同時縮小頻寬或改用更大的回授電阻。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-budget exercise: assume κ = 1.02 Å⁻¹, a 1 GΩ preamplifier at 300 K, 1 kHz bandwidth and a 100 pA set point. Johnson noise is 0.13 pA and shot noise 0.18 pA, combining to 0.22 pA rms, or 0.22%, which converts to an equivalent gap noise of 0.0022/(2×1.02) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³ Å = 0.11 pm; adding the 0.06 pm residual vibration after isolation gives a total z noise of √(0.11² + 0.06²) ≈ 0.13 pm, a signal-to-noise ratio near 150 against the 20 pm atomic corrugation of HOPG. Lowering the set point to 10 pA reduces shot noise to 0.057 pA while Johnson noise stays at 0.13 pA, so the combined 0.14 pA is now 1.4% and the equivalent gap noise rises to 0.0014/2.04 ≈ 0.7 pm, dropping the signal-to-noise ratio to about 28; low-current imaging therefore needs a narrower bandwidth or a larger feedback resistor. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.text: 校正與雜訊練習：在 300 K 以光槓桿量得某懸臂的熱振動 rms 為 0.130 nm，k = 0.817×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.130×10⁻⁹)² ≈ 0.20 N/m；力曲線的接觸段斜率給 InvOLS = 28 nm/V。設定偏折 0.05 V 相當於 1.4 nm，作用力 F = 0.20×1.4 = 0.28 nN。該懸臂 f₀ = 15 kHz、Q = 50，熱雜訊密度 √(4×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.20×9.4×10⁴×50)) ≈ 130 fm/√Hz，加上偵測器 20 fm/√Hz 得 132 fm/√Hz；若影像頻寬 1 kHz，高度雜訊約 4.2 pm rms，對 0.34 nm 的石墨烯台階信噪比約 80；把頻寬降到 100 Hz，雜訊降為 1.3 pm，但每像素需 10 ms，512×512 影像需 44 分鐘，漂移 1.2 nm/min 會累積 53 nm，必須用漂移補償。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Calibration and noise exercise: at 300 K an optical lever records a thermal rms of 0.130 nm for a cantilever, so k = 0.817×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.130×10⁻⁹)² ≈ 0.20 N/m, and the contact slope of a force curve gives InvOLS = 28 nm/V. A deflection set point of 0.05 V equals 1.4 nm and a force F = 0.20×1.4 = 0.28 nN. With f₀ = 15 kHz and Q = 50 the thermal noise density is √(4×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.20×9.4×10⁴×50)) ≈ 130 fm/√Hz, and with 20 fm/√Hz of detector noise the total is 132 fm/√Hz; at a 1 kHz imaging bandwidth the height noise is about 4.2 pm rms, a signal-to-noise ratio near 80 on a 0.34 nm graphene step; narrowing the bandwidth to 100 Hz lowers the noise to 1.3 pm but needs 10 ms per pixel, so a 512×512 frame takes 44 minutes and 1.2 nm/min of drift accumulates 53 nm, which demands drift compensation.
