workedExample.text: 氧化層厚度與定量練習：在 θ = 0° 量得矽晶圓的 Si 2p 氧化峰與元素峰面積比 I_ox/I_Si = 0.50，取 λ_ox = 3.4 nm、R₀ = 0.9，厚度 d = 3.4×ln(1 + 0.50/0.9) = 3.4×0.442 ≈ 1.5 nm。把樣品轉到 θ = 45°（cosθ = 0.707），模型預測比值為 0.9×(exp(1.5/(3.4×0.707)) − 1) = 0.9×(exp(0.624) − 1) ≈ 0.78；若實測為 0.76，兩角度反推的厚度分別為 1.50 nm 與 1.47 nm，一致性在 ±0.1 nm 內，支持均勻薄膜假設。再以 Scofield 截面定量同一表面：O 1s 面積 12 000 ÷ 2.93 = 4 096，Si 2p 面積 2 000 ÷ 0.82 = 2 439，經 λ ∝ E_k^0.75 修正後 O/Si ≈ 2.2，與 1.5 nm 的 SiO₂ 加上部分基材 Si 的訊號相符。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Oxide-thickness and quantification exercise: at θ = 0° the Si 2p oxide-to-element area ratio on a silicon wafer is I_ox/I_Si = 0.50; with λ_ox = 3.4 nm and R₀ = 0.9 the thickness is d = 3.4×ln(1 + 0.50/0.9) = 3.4×0.442 ≈ 1.5 nm. Tilting to θ = 45° (cosθ = 0.707) the model predicts a ratio of 0.9×(exp(1.5/(3.4×0.707)) − 1) = 0.9×(exp(0.624) − 1) ≈ 0.78; if 0.76 is measured, the two angles return 1.50 nm and 1.47 nm, consistent within ±0.1 nm and supporting the uniform-film assumption. Quantifying the same surface with Scofield cross-sections: O 1s area 12 000 ÷ 2.93 = 4 096 and Si 2p area 2 000 ÷ 0.82 = 2 439, and after the λ ∝ E_k^0.75 correction O/Si ≈ 2.2, consistent with 1.5 nm of SiO₂ plus some substrate Si signal. workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: RSF 與偵測極限練習：硼植入矽標準片劑量 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻²，以 1 keV O₂⁺、0.5 nm/s 剖析到 600 nm，積分得 Σ(I_B/I_Si)·Δz = 2.0×10⁻⁷ cm，RSF = 1×10¹⁵/2.0×10⁻⁷ = 5×10²¹ cm⁻³。未知晶圓同配方量得 I_B/I_Si = 1.0×10⁻⁴，濃度 = 5×10¹⁷ cm⁻³（約 10 ppm）。該配方下 1 ppm 硼給 56 cps，此樣品約 560 cps；背景 0.5 cps、停留 1 s，偵測極限 = 3√0.5/56 ≈ 0.038 ppm ≈ 1.9×10¹⁵ cm⁻³，即此樣品的訊號高於偵測極限約 260 倍。若坑深量測誤差 ±10 nm，深度尺度誤差 ±1.7%，RSF 因積分深度步長同步改變而誤差 ±1.7%；若一次束流漂移 −20% 而未重量 RSF，矩陣離子與痕量離子同步下降，比值不變，濃度仍正確，但濺射速率下降 20%，深度尺度若沿用舊值會偏深 25%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: RSF and detection-limit exercise: a boron-implanted silicon standard with dose 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻² is profiled with 1 keV O₂⁺ at 0.5 nm/s to 600 nm, and the integral Σ(I_B/I_Si)·Δz = 2.0×10⁻⁷ cm gives RSF = 1×10¹⁵/2.0×10⁻⁷ = 5×10²¹ cm⁻³. An unknown wafer under the same recipe shows I_B/I_Si = 1.0×10⁻⁴, a concentration of 5×10¹⁷ cm⁻³ (about 10 ppm). Since 1 ppm of boron gives 56 cps in this recipe, the sample yields about 560 cps; with 0.5 cps background and 1 s dwell the detection limit is 3√0.5/56 ≈ 0.038 ppm ≈ 1.9×10¹⁵ cm⁻³, so the signal sits about 260 times above it. A ±10 nm crater-depth error gives ±1.7% on the depth scale and the same ±1.7% on the RSF through the depth step; a −20% primary-current drift without re-measuring the RSF leaves the trace-to-matrix ratio and the concentration correct, but the sputter rate falls 20% and a depth scale carried over from the old rate reads 25% too deep. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 反射式飛行時間質量量測練習：有效飛行長度 1.6 m、U = 20 kV，k = 0.8144 µs/√Da、t₀ = 0.150 µs，m/z 1000 的到達時間 t = 0.150 + 0.8144×√1000 ≈ 25.905 µs。總計時展寬 0.62 ns 時 R = 25 755/(2×0.62) ≈ 20 800，FWHM ≈ 0.048 Da。未知峰由 2500 個離子組成，質心不確定度 0.048/(2.355×√2500) ≈ 0.41 mDa ≈ 0.41 ppm。量測期間飛行管升溫 0.3 K：鋁管 23 ppm/K 會讓質量偏 2×23×0.3 ≈ +13.8 ppm，低膨脹合金 1.2 ppm/K 只偏 +0.72 ppm；高壓同時上漂 2 ppm 再貢獻 −2 ppm。以鎖定質量即時修正後總誤差約 √(0.41² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.65 ppm（0.5 ppm 為鎖定修正殘差的假設值）。若該峰在 TDC 中每次推送平均 μ = 0.5 個離子而未做泊松修正，強度低估 21% 且質心偏早，必須降低離子流或啟用修正。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Reflectron TOF mass-measurement exercise: with an effective flight length of 1.6 m and U = 20 kV, k = 0.8144 µs/√Da and t₀ = 0.150 µs, so m/z 1000 arrives at t = 0.150 + 0.8144×√1000 ≈ 25.905 µs. A total timing spread of 0.62 ns gives R = 25 755/(2×0.62) ≈ 20 800 and a FWHM of about 0.048 Da. An unknown peak built from 2500 ions has a centroid uncertainty of 0.048/(2.355×√2500) ≈ 0.41 mDa ≈ 0.41 ppm. During the measurement the flight tube warms 0.3 K: an aluminium tube at 23 ppm/K would shift the mass by 2×23×0.3 ≈ +13.8 ppm, a 1.2 ppm/K low-expansion alloy only +0.72 ppm, and a simultaneous 2 ppm high-voltage rise adds −2 ppm. After real-time lock-mass correction the total error is about √(0.41² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.65 ppm, taking 0.5 ppm as the assumed lock-mass residual. If the peak averages μ = 0.5 ions per push in the TDC without Poisson correction, its intensity is 21% low and its centroid early, so the ion flux must be reduced or correction enabled. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 定量 NMR 純度練習（600.13 MHz、DMSO-d₆）：秤取阿斯匹靈樣品 20.00 mg（M = 180.16 g/mol，乙醯基 CH₃ 3H 單峰約 2.2 ppm）與馬來酸內標 10.00 mg（M = 116.07 g/mol，烯基 2H 單峰約 6.3 ppm，純度 99.9%）。積分比 I_x/I_std = 1.906，純度 P = (I_x/I_std)(N_std/N_x)(M_x/M_std)(m_std/m_x)P_std = 1.906×(2/3)×(180.16/116.07)×(10.00/20.00)×0.999 ≈ 98.5%。假設 T₁(CH₃) = 1.5 s、T₁(內標) = 4 s：若每 5 s 重複 90° 脈衝，回復分別為 0.964 與 0.713，積分比被放大 1.35 倍，算出不合理的 133%；重複時間 20 s（內標的 5T₁）時偏差 +0.68%；28 s（7T₁）時只剩 +0.09%。16 次掃描需 16 × 28 s ≈ 7.5 分鐘。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Quantitative NMR purity exercise at 600.13 MHz in DMSO-d₆: weigh 20.00 mg of an aspirin sample (M = 180.16 g/mol, acetyl CH₃ 3H singlet near 2.2 ppm) and 10.00 mg of maleic acid internal standard (M = 116.07 g/mol, olefinic 2H singlet near 6.3 ppm, purity 99.9%). With an integral ratio I_x/I_std = 1.906 the purity is P = (I_x/I_std)(N_std/N_x)(M_x/M_std)(m_std/m_x)P_std = 1.906×(2/3)×(180.16/116.07)×(10.00/20.00)×0.999 ≈ 98.5%. Assuming T₁(CH₃) = 1.5 s and T₁(standard) = 4 s, repeating 90° pulses every 5 s recovers 0.964 and 0.713, inflating the integral ratio 1.35-fold to an impossible 133%; a 20 s repetition (5T₁ of the standard) leaves a +0.68% bias and 28 s (7T₁) only +0.09%. Sixteen scans then take 16 × 28 s ≈ 7.5 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 傳導冷卻設計練習：把同一個 8 T、L = 20 H、I = 100 A 的 NbTi 線圈改由 RDK-415D2 等級冷頭（1.5 W @ 4.2 K、35 W @ 50 K）傳導冷卻。二級靜態負載：輻射 21 mW + G-10 支撐 16 mW + HTS 引線 2×25 mW + 儀表導線 10 mW = 97 mW；升流時再加開關加熱器 30 mW 與交流損耗 0.2 W，共 0.33 W。假設冷頭負載線為 T = 2.8 K + 0.93 K/W×P、冷頭到線圈的熱鏈為 1 W/K，靜態線圈溫度 2.8 + 0.09 + 0.10 ≈ 2.99 K，升流時 2.8 + 0.31 + 0.33 ≈ 3.43 K，距 T_cs = 4.66 K 尚有 1.23 K。若 50→4.2 K 段仍用銅引線，二級負載 1.56 + 0.10 = 1.66 W，冷頭升到約 4.35 K、線圈約 6.0 K，已高於 T_cs，磁體無法到場。一級：銅引線 9.3 W + 屏蔽 3 W + 支撐與導線約 1 W ≈ 13.3 W，低於 35 W。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Conduction-cooling exercise: the same 8 T NbTi coil with L = 20 H and I = 100 A is cooled by a cold head of the RDK-415D2 class (1.5 W at 4.2 K, 35 W at 50 K). Second-stage static load: radiation 21 mW + G-10 supports 16 mW + HTS leads 2×25 mW + instrumentation wiring 10 mW = 97 mW; during a ramp the switch heater adds 30 mW and AC loss 0.2 W, for 0.33 W. Assuming a cold-head load line T = 2.8 K + 0.93 K/W×P and a 1 W/K thermal link to the coil, the static coil temperature is 2.8 + 0.09 + 0.10 ≈ 2.99 K and the ramping value 2.8 + 0.31 + 0.33 ≈ 3.43 K, still 1.23 K below T_cs = 4.66 K. Keeping copper leads from 50 to 4.2 K raises the second-stage load to 1.56 + 0.10 = 1.66 W, the head to about 4.35 K and the coil to about 6.0 K, above T_cs, so the magnet cannot reach field. First stage: copper leads 9.3 W + shield 3 W + supports and wiring about 1 W ≈ 13.3 W, below 35 W. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 冷卻力與基礎溫度練習：假設 ³He 循環率 ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s，理想冷卻力 Q̇ = 84·ṅ₃·T² = 0.042·T² W；考慮熱交換器效率 70%，有效係數為 0.0294 W/K²。混合腔寄生負載預算：50 條同軸線傳導 0.12 µW、衰減器耗散 0.01 µW、脈衝管振動加熱 1.0 µW、殘餘氣體 0.5 µW、屏蔽開孔輻射 0.07 µW，合計 1.7 µW。無實驗負載時基礎溫度 T = √(1.7×10⁻⁶/0.0294) = √(5.8×10⁻⁵) ≈ 7.6 mK。加上一個耗散 10 µW 的實驗，總負載 11.7 µW，T = √(11.7×10⁻⁶/0.0294) = √(3.98×10⁻⁴) ≈ 20 mK；若實驗只能容忍 15 mK，可用的有效冷卻力為 0.0294×(0.015)² = 6.6 µW，必須把實驗耗散壓到 5 µW 以下或提高循環率。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Cooling-power and base-temperature exercise: assume a ³He circulation rate ṅ₃ = 500 µmol/s, ideal cooling power Q̇ = 84·ṅ₃·T² = 0.042·T² W, and a 70% heat-exchanger efficiency giving an effective coefficient of 0.0294 W/K². Parasitic-load budget at the mixing chamber: conduction through 50 coaxial lines 0.12 µW, attenuator dissipation 0.01 µW, pulse-tube vibration heating 1.0 µW, residual gas 0.5 µW, radiation through shield openings 0.07 µW, total 1.7 µW. With no experiment the base temperature is T = √(1.7×10⁻⁶/0.0294) = √(5.8×10⁻⁵) ≈ 7.6 mK. Adding an experiment that dissipates 10 µW makes the total 11.7 µW and T = √(11.7×10⁻⁶/0.0294) = √(3.98×10⁻⁴) ≈ 20 mK; if the experiment can only tolerate 15 mK, the available effective cooling is 0.0294×(0.015)² = 6.6 µW, so the experiment's dissipation must be cut below 5 µW or the circulation rate raised. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 極限壓力鏈練習：腔體 V = 100 L、內表面 A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm²，渦輪泵 300 L/s 經 DN100、30 cm 管子接入，C ≈ 12.1×1000/30 ≈ 403 L/s，S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s。漏氣：20 個 CF 法蘭各 ≤ 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar·L/s，合計 2×10⁻¹⁰，壓力貢獻 1.2×10⁻¹² mbar。未烘烤抽 10 小時：q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/(s·cm²)，Q = 1×10⁻⁵ mbar·L/s，p = 1×10⁻⁵/172 ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁸ mbar。150 °C 烘烤 48 小時後：q_H₂ = 2×10⁻¹³，Q = 2×10⁻⁹，p = 2×10⁻⁹/172 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ mbar。再並聯離子泵（對氫 250 L/s）與 NEG 匣 400 L/s：S_total = 172 + 250 + 400 = 822 L/s，p = 2×10⁻⁹/822 ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹² mbar。真空計讀值：氫的相對靈敏度 0.46，BA 計顯示約 0.46×2.4×10⁻¹² ≈ 1.1×10⁻¹² mbar 的氮當量，已低於其 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar 的 X 光極限，顯示會停在 10⁻¹¹ 附近，必須改用引出式真空計才能證明達標。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Ultimate-pressure chain exercise: chamber V = 100 L with internal surface A = 1 m² = 10⁴ cm², a 300 L/s turbopump connected through a DN100 tube 30 cm long, C ≈ 12.1×1000/30 ≈ 403 L/s and S_eff = 1/(1/300 + 1/403) ≈ 172 L/s. Leaks: 20 CF flanges at ≤ 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar·L/s each, 2×10⁻¹⁰ in total, contributing 1.2×10⁻¹² mbar. Unbaked after 10 hours: q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/(s·cm²), Q = 1×10⁻⁵ mbar·L/s and p = 1×10⁻⁵/172 ≈ 5.8×10⁻⁸ mbar. After a 48-hour bake at 150 °C: q_H₂ = 2×10⁻¹³, Q = 2×10⁻⁹ and p = 2×10⁻⁹/172 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ mbar. Adding an ion pump (250 L/s for hydrogen) and a 400 L/s NEG cartridge in parallel: S_total = 172 + 250 + 400 = 822 L/s and p = 2×10⁻⁹/822 ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹² mbar. Gauge reading: with a relative sensitivity of 0.46 for hydrogen the BA gauge displays about 0.46×2.4×10⁻¹² ≈ 1.1×10⁻¹² mbar nitrogen equivalent, below its 1×10⁻¹¹ mbar X-ray limit, so the display sticks near 10⁻¹¹ and an extractor gauge is needed to prove the target. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 泵站選型練習：一台 50 L 的分析腔（例如飛行時間質譜儀）有樣品進氣負載 Q = 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s，另加出氣 2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s，目標工作壓力 1×10⁻⁶ mbar。所需有效抽速 S_eff = 1×10⁻⁴/1×10⁻⁶ = 100 L/s。泵接在 DN100、20 cm 的管上，C ≈ 12.1×1000/20 ≈ 605 L/s，所需泵抽速 1/S_pump = 1/100 − 1/605 ≈ 0.00835，S_pump ≈ 120 L/s；選一台 260 L/s 的 DN100 泵留餘裕：S_eff = 1/(1/260 + 1/605) ≈ 182 L/s，工作壓力 p ≈ 1.02×10⁻⁴/182 ≈ 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar，達標且有近兩倍餘裕。前級：流量 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s 在 1×10⁻² mbar 的前級壓力下只需 0.01 L/s 的前級抽速，小型隔膜泵綽綽有餘；氫回流 10⁻⁵/10⁵ = 10⁻¹⁰ mbar 可忽略。真空計：Pirani 在 10⁻³ mbar 切換到 BA 計，BA 計靈敏度 20 mbar⁻¹、發射 1 mA，在 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar 的離子電流為 20×10⁻³×5.6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.1×10⁻⁸ A = 11 nA，遠高於 X 光極限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Pump-station sizing exercise: a 50 L analytical chamber (for example a time-of-flight mass spectrometer) has a sample-inlet load Q = 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s plus 2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s of outgassing and a target working pressure of 1×10⁻⁶ mbar. The required effective speed is S_eff = 1×10⁻⁴/1×10⁻⁶ = 100 L/s. With the pump on a DN100 tube 20 cm long, C ≈ 12.1×1000/20 ≈ 605 L/s, the required pump speed follows from 1/S_pump = 1/100 − 1/605 ≈ 0.00835, S_pump ≈ 120 L/s; choosing a 260 L/s DN100 pump for margin gives S_eff = 1/(1/260 + 1/605) ≈ 182 L/s and a working pressure p ≈ 1.02×10⁻⁴/182 ≈ 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar, meeting the target with nearly a factor of two in hand. Backing: a throughput of 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s at a foreline pressure of 1×10⁻² mbar needs only 0.01 L/s of backing speed, so a small diaphragm pump is ample, and the hydrogen backflow 10⁻⁵/10⁵ = 10⁻¹⁰ mbar is negligible. Gauges: the Pirani hands over to the BA gauge at 10⁻³ mbar, and with a sensitivity of 20 mbar⁻¹ and 1 mA emission the ion current at 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar is 20×10⁻³×5.6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.1×10⁻⁸ A = 11 nA, far above the X-ray limit. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.text: 干涉儀穩定度練習：一台 Michelson 干涉儀放在 1000 kg 蜂巢桌上，兩臂長度差 0.5 m，要求 10 分鐘內相對光程漂移小於 20 nm；樓板為 VC-C，隔振器 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1。振動項：8 Hz 頻帶桌面絕對運動 13.2 nm，加速度 a = (2π×8)²×13.2 nm ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁵ m/s²，經 270 Hz 第一彎曲模態轉成的差模 δ ≈ a/ω₁² ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ m，可忽略。未加罩時 10 分鐘溫度變化 0.1 K：鋼 600 nm、空氣 47 nm、70 dB 聲壓激起鏡架共振 19 nm，RSS ≈ 602 nm，超出 30 倍。改善：加隔熱隔音罩使 ΔT 降到 0.01 K、聲壓降 20 dB，並把臂長差縮到 0.05 m：鋼 12×10⁻⁶×0.05×0.01 = 6 nm、空氣 0.47 nm、聲學 1.9 nm，RSS ≈ 6.3 nm，達標。結論：隔振之後，預算由熱與聲學主導。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Interferometer stability exercise: a Michelson interferometer sits on a 1000 kg honeycomb table with an arm-length difference of 0.5 m and must hold relative path drift below 20 nm over 10 minutes; the floor is VC-C and the isolators have f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1. Vibration term: the 8 Hz band moves the top 13.2 nm absolutely, an acceleration a = (2π×8)²×13.2 nm ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁵ m/s², which the 270 Hz first bending mode converts to a differential δ ≈ a/ω1² ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹¹ m, negligible. Without an enclosure a 0.1 K change in 10 minutes gives steel 600 nm, air 47 nm and a 70 dB tone exciting a mount resonance 19 nm, an RSS of about 602 nm, thirty times over. Fix: a thermal and acoustic enclosure cuts ΔT to 0.01 K and sound by 20 dB, and the arm difference is reduced to 0.05 m, giving steel 12×10⁻⁶×0.05×0.01 = 6 nm, air 0.47 nm and acoustics 1.9 nm, an RSS of about 6.3 nm, within budget. Conclusion: once isolated, the budget is dominated by thermal and acoustic terms. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 晶格升級練習：同一條 528 m、3 GeV 的隧道，比較 24 晶胞 DBA（48 片彎轉磁鐵，每片 1.4 m）與 20 晶胞 7BA（140 片，總彎轉長度 104.8 m）。DBA：ρ = 48×1.4/(2π) ≈ 10.7 m、B ≈ 0.94 T、U₀ = 88.5×81/10.7 ≈ 670 keV、εc ≈ 5.6 keV、τ_x = 2E·T₀/U₀ ≈ 15.8 ms，TME 極限 637 pm。7BA：ρ = 16.7 m、B = 0.6 T、U₀ ≈ 430 keV、εc ≈ 3.59 keV、τ_x ≈ 24.6 ms，TME 極限 25.7 pm。500 mA 下彎轉磁鐵輻射功率從 335 kW 降到 215 kW，射頻負擔減輕，但阻尼變慢、εc 變低，硬 X 光改由插件磁鐵提供。若兩者實際發射度都約為 TME 的 4 倍（2.55 nm 對 103 pm），垂直發射度相同，則加上 1 Å 光子的 8 pm 後，水平有效光源發射度從 2.56 nm 降到 111 pm，波盪器亮度約提高 23 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際設施規格。
workedExample.textEn: Lattice upgrade exercise: in the same 528 m, 3 GeV tunnel compare a 24-cell DBA (48 dipoles of 1.4 m) with a 20-cell 7BA (140 dipoles, 104.8 m of total bending length). DBA: ρ = 48×1.4/(2π) ≈ 10.7 m, B ≈ 0.94 T, U0 = 88.5×81/10.7 ≈ 670 keV, εc ≈ 5.6 keV, τ_x = 2E·T0/U0 ≈ 15.8 ms and a TME limit of 637 pm. 7BA: ρ = 16.7 m, B = 0.6 T, U0 ≈ 430 keV, εc ≈ 3.59 keV, τ_x ≈ 24.6 ms and a TME limit of 25.7 pm. At 500 mA the dipole radiation power falls from 335 kW to 215 kW, easing the RF load, but damping slows and εc drops, so hard X-rays must come from insertion devices. If both lattices reach about 4 times their TME limit (2.55 nm versus 103 pm) with equal vertical emittance, adding the 8 pm photon term at 1 Å gives a horizontal effective source emittance falling from 2.56 nm to 111 pm, raising undulator brightness about 23-fold. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 精簡型硬 X 光 FEL 加速器練習：目標 0.1 nm（12.4 keV），λu = 15 mm、K = 1.2，需 E ≈ 5.8 GeV。電子槍：200 pC、Cs₂Te QE 1%，266 nm 雷射約 93 nJ；高斯束團 σ_t = 3 ps，峰值 I₀ = Q/(√(2π)σ_t) ≈ 26.6 A。要達 3 kA 需總壓縮 C ≈ 113，分配為 300 MeV 處第一級 C₁ = 10、約 2 GeV 處第二級 C₂ ≈ 11.3。雷射加熱器加入 15 keV 切片能量散佈，壓縮後放大為 15 keV×113 ≈ 1.7 MeV，在 5.8 GeV 為 2.9×10⁻⁴，仍小於 ρ ≈ 4.9×10⁻⁴，但餘量只有 1.7 倍；加熱器若設到 30 keV 就會超過 ρ。主加速：扣掉注入器 300 MeV 並補回 X 波段減速 17.6 MeV，以 28 MV/m 計約需 (5800 − 300 + 17.6)/28 ≈ 197 m 結構。飽和脈衝能量約 0.57 mJ（2.9×10¹¹ 個光子）；若最終能量抖動 2×10⁻⁴，光子能量逐發偏移約 5 eV。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際設施規格。
workedExample.textEn: Compact hard X-ray FEL accelerator exercise: target 0.1 nm (12.4 keV) with λu = 15 mm and K = 1.2, requiring E ≈ 5.8 GeV. Gun: 200 pC from Cs2Te at 1% QE needs about 93 nJ of 266 nm laser; a Gaussian bunch with σ_t = 3 ps has peak I0 = Q/(√(2π)σ_t) ≈ 26.6 A. Reaching 3 kA needs total compression C ≈ 113, split as C1 = 10 at 300 MeV and C2 ≈ 11.3 near 2 GeV. A laser heater adding 15 keV of slice energy spread is magnified by compression to 15 keV×113 ≈ 1.7 MeV, which at 5.8 GeV is 2.9×10⁻⁴, still below ρ ≈ 4.9×10⁻⁴ but with only 1.7 times margin; a 30 keV heater setting would exceed ρ. Main linac: after the 300 MeV injector and making up 17.6 MeV of X-band deceleration, about (5800 − 300 + 17.6)/28 ≈ 197 m of structure at 28 MV/m. Saturation pulse energy is about 0.57 mJ (2.9×10¹¹ photons); a final energy jitter of 2×10⁻⁴ shifts photon energy by about 5 eV shot to shot. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise for a 500 MHz normal-conducting storage-ring cavity: the TM010 radius is R = 2.405c/(2πf) = 2.405×2.998×10⁸/(2π×5×10⁸) ≈ 0.2295 m. Assuming R/Q = 145 Ω and Q0 = 3.5×10⁴, R_sh = 5.08 MΩ, and a cavity voltage V = 0.55 MV costs P_c = V²/R_sh ≈ 59.6 kW. A beam of I0 = 0.3 A losing 0.20 MV per cavity takes P_b = 60 kW, so β_opt = 1 + 60/59.6 ≈ 2.01, Q_L = 3.5×10⁴/3.01 ≈ 11 600 and the half bandwidth is about 21.5 kHz. With cosφs = 0.20/0.55 = 0.364 and sinφs = 0.932, tanψ = 0.3×5.08×10⁶×0.932/(3.01×0.55×10⁶) ≈ 0.86 and the detuning is Δf ≈ 0.86×5×10⁸/(2×11 600) ≈ 18.4 kHz; the generator must supply P_g ≈ 119.6 kW, about 150 kW with 25% control and waveguide margin. Without beam Γ = 1.01/3.01 ≈ 0.33, so about 11% of the power is reflected. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.

workedExample.text: Q₀ 與製冷電力練習：1.3 GHz 九腔在 2.0 K，用 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω 得 R_BCS ≈ 11 nΩ；假設 R_res = 4 nΩ，R_s = 15 nΩ，Q₀ = G/R_s = 270/15×10⁻⁹ = 1.8×10¹⁰。在 E_acc = 16 MV/m、L = 1.038 m 下 V = 16.6 MV，P_diss = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×1.8×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/1.86×10¹³ ≈ 14.8 W。一個 8 腔模組動態負載 118 W，加靜態 10 W 為 128 W；以每瓦 2 K 需 700 W 電力估計，製冷電力約 90 kW。若殘餘電阻因磁通捕獲升到 14 nΩ，R_s = 25 nΩ，Q₀ 降到 1.08×10¹⁰，模組電力升到約 146 kW。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Q₀ and refrigeration exercise: a 1.3 GHz nine-cell at 2.0 K has R_BCS ≈ 11 nΩ from R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω; assuming R_res = 4 nΩ, R_s = 15 nΩ and Q₀ = G/R_s = 270/15×10⁻⁹ = 1.8×10¹⁰. At E_acc = 16 MV/m and L = 1.038 m, V = 16.6 MV and P_diss = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×1.8×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/1.86×10¹³ ≈ 14.8 W. An 8-cavity module then has 118 W dynamic plus 10 W static load, 128 W; at an assumed 700 W of electricity per watt at 2 K the refrigeration draws about 90 kW. If trapped flux raises the residual resistance to 14 nΩ, R_s = 25 nΩ, Q₀ falls to 1.08×10¹⁰ and the module's electrical demand rises to about 146 kW. workedExample.text: 鈕扣 BPM 靈敏度與解析度練習：圓管半徑 R = 20 mm，四鈕扣在 ±45°，k_x = R/√2 = 14.1 mm。束流偏移 50 µm 時 Δ/Σ = 50 µm/14.1 mm ≈ 3.5×10⁻³。每電極 500 MHz 訊號為 −1.7 dBm，經 1 MHz 帶通濾波後熱雜訊 −114 dBm 加 3 dB 雜訊指數為 −111 dBm，功率訊雜比 109.3 dB，振幅相對雜訊 10^(−109.3/20) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶，σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶/2 = 1.7×10⁻⁶，σ_x ≈ 14.1 mm×1.7×10⁻⁶ ≈ 24 nm（理論熱雜訊極限）；實務上 ADC 與電子學雜訊讓逐圈解析度落在約 0.5 µm。若一路電纜增益偏 0.5%，假偏移為 14.1 mm×(0.005/4) ≈ 18 µm，是熱雜訊極限的數百倍，說明增益校正比低雜訊放大器更關鍵。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Button-BPM sensitivity and resolution exercise: pipe radius R = 20 mm, four buttons at ±45°, k_x = R/√2 = 14.1 mm. A 50 µm beam offset gives Δ/Σ = 50 µm/14.1 mm ≈ 3.5×10⁻³. Each electrode delivers −1.7 dBm at 500 MHz; after a 1 MHz band-pass the thermal noise −114 dBm plus a 3 dB noise figure is −111 dBm, the power SNR is 109.3 dB, the relative amplitude noise is 10^(−109.3/20) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶, σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶/2 = 1.7×10⁻⁶ and σ_x ≈ 14.1 mm×1.7×10⁻⁶ ≈ 24 nm as the thermal-noise limit; in practice ADC and electronics noise put turn-by-turn resolution near 0.5 µm. If one cable's gain is off by 0.5%, the false offset is 14.1 mm×(0.005/4) ≈ 18 µm, hundreds of times the thermal limit, showing that gain calibration matters more than a lower-noise amplifier. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: Si(111) 雙晶單色器 10 keV 練習：λ = 12.398/10 = 1.2398 Å，sinθ = 1.2398/6.2712 = 0.1977，θ = 11.40°，tanθ = 0.2017。Darwin 寬度 ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad；入射垂直發散 23 µrad FWHM、液氮冷卻後熱斜率 7.7 µrad，合成角寬 √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7²) ≈ 36.2 µrad，ΔE/E ≈ 36.2×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.79×10⁻⁴，ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV。若晶體改為室溫水冷、熱斜率 350 µrad，角寬變成約 352 µrad，ΔE ≈ 17 eV 且反射率崩潰，XANES 無法進行。固定出口 H = 20 mm 時 D = 20/(2×cos11.40°) = 10.20 mm；編碼器 0.1 µrad 對應 δE ≈ 5 meV。Cu K 邊若量到 8976 eV 而非 8979 eV，零點修正 Δθ ≈ (3/8979)×tan12.72° ≈ 75 µrad。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Si(111) double-crystal exercise at 10 keV: λ = 12.398/10 = 1.2398 Å, sinθ = 1.2398/6.2712 = 0.1977, θ = 11.40°, tanθ = 0.2017. Darwin width ω_D ≈ 1.33×10⁻⁴×0.2017 ≈ 26.8 µrad; with 23 µrad FWHM incident vertical divergence and a 7.7 µrad thermal slope after nitrogen cooling, the combined angular width is √(26.8² + 23² + 7.7²) ≈ 36.2 µrad, ΔE/E ≈ 36.2×10⁻⁶/0.2017 ≈ 1.79×10⁻⁴ and ΔE ≈ 1.8 eV. With a room-temperature water-cooled crystal and a 350 µrad thermal slope the width becomes about 352 µrad, ΔE ≈ 17 eV and the reflectivity collapses, making XANES impossible. For a fixed exit H = 20 mm, D = 20/(2×cos11.40°) = 10.20 mm; a 0.1 µrad encoder step corresponds to δE ≈ 5 meV. If the Cu K edge reads 8976 eV instead of 8979 eV, the zero correction is Δθ ≈ (3/8979)×tan12.72° ≈ 75 µrad. Values are teaching assumptions, not any beamline's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: KB 奈米聚焦預算練習：E = 15 keV（λ ≈ 0.827 Å），垂直 KB 鏡長 L = 0.12 m、掠射角 θ = 3.5 mrad（低於 Rh 在 15 keV 的臨界角約 4.5 mrad），p = 50 m、q = 0.12 m。孔徑 A = L·θ = 0.42 mm，NA = A/(2q) = 1.75×10⁻³，繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) ≈ 20.8 nm；光源垂直 FWHM 12 µm 乘以 M = q/p = 2.4×10⁻³ 得 28.8 nm；斜率誤差 50 nrad rms 貢獻 2.355×2×50×10⁻⁹×0.12 ≈ 28.3 nm；鏡面俯仰振動 10 nrad rms 貢獻約 5.7 nm。平方和 √(20.8² + 28.8² + 28.3² + 5.7²) ≈ 45.7 nm FWHM。兩面 Rh 鏡各以反射率 0.85 計，傳輸約 72%。若斜率誤差放寬到 0.1 µrad，該項變為 56.5 nm，總光斑約 67 nm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際光束線規格。
workedExample.textEn: KB nanofocus budget exercise: E = 15 keV (λ ≈ 0.827 Å), vertical KB mirror length L = 0.12 m, grazing angle θ = 3.5 mrad (below the Rh critical angle of about 4.5 mrad at 15 keV), p = 50 m and q = 0.12 m. The aperture is A = L·θ = 0.42 mm, NA = A/(2q) = 1.75×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) ≈ 20.8 nm; a 12 µm FWHM vertical source times M = q/p = 2.4×10⁻³ gives 28.8 nm; 50 nrad rms slope error contributes 2.355×2×50×10⁻⁹×0.12 ≈ 28.3 nm; 10 nrad rms pitch vibration adds about 5.7 nm. The quadrature sum √(20.8² + 28.8² + 28.3² + 5.7²) ≈ 45.7 nm FWHM. Taking reflectivity 0.85 for each of the two Rh mirrors, transmission is about 72%. Relaxing slope error to 0.1 µrad makes that term 56.5 nm and the total spot about 67 nm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real beamline specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 冷中子飛行時間能譜練習：入射波長 λi = 4 Å，vi = 3956/4 = 989 m/s，Ei = 81.81/16 ≈ 5.11 meV。樣品到偵測器 L2 = 3.0 m，彈性中子飛行時間 t2 = 3.0/989 ≈ 3.033 ms。若中子在樣品激發 ħω = 1.0 meV 的激發，Ef ≈ 4.11 meV，λf = √(81.81/4.11) ≈ 4.46 Å，vf ≈ 887 m/s，t2 ≈ 3.382 ms，比彈性晚約 0.349 ms。彈性能量解析度 ΔE/E ≈ 2Δt/t2，取等效時間不確定 Δt = 15 µs，ΔE/E ≈ 0.99%，ΔE ≈ 51 µeV。若源頻率 60 Hz、源到偵測器總路徑 23 m，4 Å 中子總飛行 23.26 ms 已超過 16.67 ms 框架，帶寬斬波器必須把波長範圍限制在約 3956/(60×23) ≈ 2.87 Å 以內。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際儀器規格。
workedExample.textEn: Cold-neutron time-of-flight exercise: incident wavelength λi = 4 Å gives vi = 3956/4 = 989 m/s and Ei = 81.81/16 ≈ 5.11 meV. With sample-to-detector distance L2 = 3.0 m the elastic flight time is t2 = 3.0/989 ≈ 3.033 ms. If the neutron creates a ħω = 1.0 meV excitation in the sample, Ef ≈ 4.11 meV, λf = √(81.81/4.11) ≈ 4.46 Å, vf ≈ 887 m/s and t2 ≈ 3.382 ms, arriving about 0.349 ms after the elastic line. The elastic energy resolution is ΔE/E ≈ 2Δt/t2; taking an effective timing uncertainty Δt = 15 µs gives ΔE/E ≈ 0.99% and ΔE ≈ 51 µeV. At a 60 Hz source with a 23 m total source-to-detector path, a 4 Å neutron takes 23.26 ms, longer than the 16.67 ms frame, so the bandwidth choppers must restrict the band to about 3956/(60×23) ≈ 2.87 Å. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: NaI(Tl) 伽瑪能譜儀練習：76 mm 晶體在 ¹³⁷Cs 662 keV 光電峰產生 38×662 ≈ 25 160 個光子。假設光收集 0.65、PMT 量子效率 0.28，N_pe = 25 160×0.65×0.28 ≈ 4580；超額雜訊因子 1.2 時統計項 2.355×√(1.2/4580) ≈ 3.8%。再假設晶體非比例性與不均勻性合計 5.5%，總解析度 √(3.8² + 5.5²) ≈ 6.7% FWHM，即約 44 keV。康普頓邊緣 E_C = E/(1 + m_ec²/2E) = 662/(1 + 511/1324) ≈ 478 keV，背散射峰約 662 − 478 ≈ 184 keV。若把 PMT 換成 PDE 0.40 的 SiPM 陣列且光收集不變，N_pe ≈ 6540，統計項降到約 3.2%，總解析度只改善到約 6.4%，顯示本質項主導。數值為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: NaI(Tl) gamma-spectrometer exercise: a 76 mm crystal produces 38×662 ≈ 25 160 photons in the ¹³⁷Cs 662 keV photopeak. Assuming light collection 0.65 and PMT quantum efficiency 0.28, N_pe = 25 160×0.65×0.28 ≈ 4580; with an excess noise factor of 1.2 the statistical term is 2.355×√(1.2/4580) ≈ 3.8%. Assuming crystal non-proportionality and non-uniformity together contribute 5.5%, the total resolution is √(3.8² + 5.5²) ≈ 6.7% FWHM, about 44 keV. The Compton edge is E_C = E/(1 + m_ec²/2E) = 662/(1 + 511/1324) ≈ 478 keV and the backscatter peak lies near 662 − 478 ≈ 184 keV. Replacing the PMT with a SiPM array of PDE 0.40 at unchanged light collection gives N_pe ≈ 6540, lowering the statistical term to about 3.2% but the total only to about 6.4%, showing that the intrinsic term dominates. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

workedExample.text: 內層模組設計練習：假設高亮度型內層採 50×50 µm² 像素、150 µm 厚感測器與 400×384 像素的讀出晶片。薄感測器取最可能值 72 e⁻/µm，訊號 MPV ≈ 72 × 150 = 10,800 e⁻；門檻 1,000 e⁻ 為 MPV 的 9.3%，雜訊 80 e⁻ 時門檻與雜訊比為 12.5。二元解析度 50/√12 ≈ 14.4 µm；感測器物質量 150/93,700 ≈ 0.16% X₀。未照射時 3 kΩ·cm 基材的空乏電壓按 d² 縮放為 95 × (150/285)² ≈ 26 V；照射到 Φ_eq = 2×10¹⁵ cm⁻² 後 N_eff ≈ 3×10¹³ cm⁻³，空乏電壓約 510 V。每像素體積 3.75×10⁻⁷ cm³，20 °C 漏電流 = 4×10⁻¹⁷ × 2×10¹⁵ × 3.75×10⁻⁷ = 30 nA，冷到 −15 °C 乘以 0.030 得 0.90 nA；整顆晶片 153,600 像素約 0.14 mA，500 V 偏壓下約 0.07 W。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實驗的規格。
workedExample.textEn: Inner-module design exercise: assume a high-luminosity inner layer with 50×50 µm² pixels, a 150 µm sensor and a 400×384-pixel readout chip. Taking a most probable 72 e⁻/µm for thin sensors, the signal MPV ≈ 72 × 150 = 10,800 e⁻; a 1,000 e⁻ threshold is 9.3% of the MPV, and with 80 e⁻ noise the threshold-to-noise ratio is 12.5. Binary resolution is 50/√12 ≈ 14.4 µm and sensor material is 150/93,700 ≈ 0.16% X₀. Unirradiated 3 kΩ·cm bulk depletes at 95 × (150/285)² ≈ 26 V by d² scaling; after Φ_eq = 2×10¹⁵ cm⁻², N_eff ≈ 3×10¹³ cm⁻³ and the depletion voltage is about 510 V. Each pixel has a volume of 3.75×10⁻⁷ cm³, so leakage at 20 °C is 4×10⁻¹⁷ × 2×10¹⁵ × 3.75×10⁻⁷ = 30 nA, and cooling to −15 °C multiplies by 0.030 to give 0.90 nA; the 153,600-pixel chip draws about 0.14 mA, about 0.07 W at 500 V. Values are teaching assumptions, not any experiment's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 漂移與定位練習：假設 ALICE TPC 以 400 V/cm、v_d = 2.58 cm/µs 運作，一條軌跡在距讀出面 200 cm 處產生叢集。到達時間 t = 200/2.58 ≈ 77.5 µs，以 5 MHz 取樣為 388 個時間格。取 D'_T = 220 µm/√cm，橫向擴散 σ_T = 220×√200 ≈ 3.1 mm；一列 7.5 mm 墊片約收集 30 個初級電子，重心的統計極限為 3.1/√30 ≈ 0.57 mm，再與墊片響應加雜訊項（假設 0.5 mm）平方相加得約 0.76 mm，接近實測的 0.8 mm 等級。若氣體溫度上升讓漂移速度加快 0.3%，未校正的 z 偏差為 200 cm × 0.003 = 6 mm，已是位置解析度的 8 倍，這說明為何漂移速度必須連續監測。數值為教學假設，不代表實驗的正式規格。
workedExample.textEn: Drift-and-position exercise: assume the ALICE TPC runs at 400 V/cm with v_d = 2.58 cm/µs and a track produces a cluster 200 cm from the readout plane. Arrival time t = 200/2.58 ≈ 77.5 µs, i.e. 388 time bins at 5 MHz sampling. With D'_T = 220 µm/√cm the transverse diffusion is σ_T = 220×√200 ≈ 3.1 mm; a 7.5 mm pad row collects about 30 primary electrons, so the centroid statistical limit is 3.1/√30 ≈ 0.57 mm, and adding a pad-response-plus-noise term of 0.5 mm in quadrature gives about 0.76 mm, close to the measured 0.8 mm class. If a gas temperature rise speeds the drift by 0.3%, the uncorrected z error is 200 cm × 0.003 = 6 mm, eight times the position resolution, which is why drift velocity must be monitored continuously. Values are teaching assumptions, not the experiment's formal specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 雜訊預算練習：矽微條感測器 C_d = 20 pF，加上前端輸入電容 3 pF 與走線 2 pF，總 C = 25 pF；輸入電晶體 e_n = 1 nV/√Hz，漏電流 1 nA，回授電阻 100 MΩ，CR-RC 整形 τ = 1 µs。並聯雜訊電流 i_n = √(2qI + 4kT/R_f) = √(3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸) = 2.2×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz。串聯項 ENC_s = √(0.92×(10⁻⁹)²×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶)/q = 150 e⁻，並聯項 ENC_p = √(0.92×(2.2×10⁻¹⁴)²×10⁻⁶)/q = 132 e⁻，合計 200 e⁻。MIP 訊號 24,000 e⁻，訊噪比 120。若感測器受輻照後漏電流升到 100 nA，i_n 升到 1.8×10⁻¹³ A/√Hz，ENC_p = 1070 e⁻，總 ENC ≈ 1080 e⁻，訊噪比降到 22；把 τ 縮短到 0.2 µs 後 ENC_s = 335、ENC_p = 480，總 ENC ≈ 585 e⁻，訊噪比回到 41。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際晶片的規格。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-budget exercise: a silicon strip sensor with C_d = 20 pF plus 3 pF of front-end input capacitance and 2 pF of trace gives C = 25 pF; the input transistor has e_n = 1 nV/√Hz, leakage is 1 nA, the feedback resistor 100 MΩ, with CR-RC shaping at τ = 1 µs. Parallel noise current i_n = √(2qI + 4kT/R_f) = √(3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸) = 2.2×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz. Series term ENC_s = √(0.92×(10⁻⁹)²×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶)/q = 150 e⁻, parallel term ENC_p = √(0.92×(2.2×10⁻¹⁴)²×10⁻⁶)/q = 132 e⁻, total 200 e⁻. The MIP signal of 24,000 e⁻ gives a signal-to-noise ratio of 120. If irradiation raises leakage to 100 nA, i_n becomes 1.8×10⁻¹³ A/√Hz, ENC_p = 1070 e⁻, total ENC ≈ 1080 e⁻ and the ratio drops to 22; shortening τ to 0.2 µs gives ENC_s = 335 and ENC_p = 480, total ≈ 585 e⁻, restoring the ratio to 41. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real chip's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.textEn: Strehl-budget exercise: VLT 8.2 m, K band at 2.2 µm, seeing 0.7″ (r0 = 14.4 cm at 500 nm → 85 cm at K), wind 10 m/s, a 1170-actuator deformable secondary (projected pitch 0.21 m), a 1 kHz loop with f_3dB = 50 Hz and a bright on-axis NGS. Fitting: 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) = 0.028 rad²; temporal: f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 = 5.0 Hz, (5.0/50)^(5/3) = 0.022; measurement: 500 photons per subaperture per frame, π²/(2×500)×(0.7/2.2)² = 0.001; aliasing 0.008; NCPA 50 nm → (2π×50/2200)² = 0.020; other 0.010. Total σ² = 0.089 → exp(−0.089) = 0.915; jitter 10 mas → S_j = 0.86; Strehl ≈ 0.79. If the guide star fades to 10 photons per frame the measurement term rises to 0.05, σ² = 0.138 → 0.871×0.86 ≈ 0.75; if seeing worsens to 1.2″ the fitting and temporal terms each grow by 2.45, σ² ≈ 0.21 → Strehl ≈ 0.70. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real system's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 主動修正練習：假設一面 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄鏡位於天頂角 45°。鏡重 226 kN，軸向分量 226 × cos 45° ≈ 160 kN，150 支平均每支約 1,065 N，側向同為約 160 kN。夜間鏡體穿厚度溫差 0.4 K、α = 0.05 ppm/K：κ = 0.05×10⁻⁶ × 0.4/0.175 ≈ 1.14×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹，矢高 κa²/2 = 1.14×10⁻⁷ × 4.1²/2 ≈ 0.96 µm，交給副鏡以離焦修正。感測器量得像散係數 600 nm，主鏡迴路增益 0.3、每 45 s 修正一次，要降到 40 nm 需 n = ln(40/600)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.6，即 8 次、約 6 分鐘。殘差預算為拋光 30、印痕 15、主動 25、熱 20、風 15 nm，RSS ≈ 49 nm，在 1.0 µm 的 Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 49/1000)²] ≈ 0.91。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Active-correction exercise: assume an 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus at 45° zenith angle. The 226 kN weight has an axial component of 226 × cos 45° ≈ 160 kN, about 1,065 N on average for each of 150 actuators, and a lateral component of about 160 kN as well. At night a 0.4 K through-thickness difference with α = 0.05 ppm/K gives κ = 0.05×10⁻⁶ × 0.4/0.175 ≈ 1.14×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ and a sag of κa²/2 = 1.14×10⁻⁷ × 4.1²/2 ≈ 0.96 µm, which the secondary removes as defocus. The sensor reports 600 nm of astigmatism; with gain 0.3 and one correction every 45 s, reaching 40 nm needs n = ln(40/600)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.6, so 8 corrections or about 6 minutes. A residual budget of polishing 30, print-through 15, active 25, thermal 20 and wind 15 nm gives RSS ≈ 49 nm and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 49/1000)²] ≈ 0.91 at 1.0 µm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any telescope's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 共相預算練習：假設一面 36 片、對角 1.8 m 段鏡的主鏡要在 1.65 µm 維持 Strehl ≥ 0.95。允許的表面 piston σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.95) = 1650/12.57 × 0.2265 ≈ 29.7 nm。分配感測器雜訊 3 nm、漂移 15 nm、共相相機 10 nm、致動器 2 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS = √(9 + 225 + 100 + 4 + 225) ≈ 23.7 nm，低於 29.7 nm，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4π × 23.7/1650)²] ≈ 0.97。新段鏡安裝後誤差 12 µm：窄頻 0.85 µm 的唯一範圍只有 ±0.21 µm，雙波長 Λ = 13.6 µm 的 ±3.4 µm 也不夠，必須先以約 ±30 µm 捕獲範圍的寬頻方法定位。168 個感測器對 105 個可控自由度約 1.6 倍過定。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Phasing-budget exercise: a primary of 36 segments, each 1.8 m across corners, must hold Strehl ≥ 0.95 at 1.65 µm. The allowed surface piston is σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.95) = 1650/12.57 × 0.2265 ≈ 29.7 nm. Allocating 3 nm sensor noise, 15 nm drift, 10 nm phasing camera, 2 nm actuators and 15 nm wind gives RSS = √(9 + 225 + 100 + 4 + 225) ≈ 23.7 nm, inside 29.7 nm, with Strehl ≈ exp[−(4π × 23.7/1650)²] ≈ 0.97. A newly installed segment is off by 12 µm: the 0.85 µm narrowband range of ±0.21 µm and even the ±3.4 µm of a 13.6 µm synthetic wavelength are insufficient, so a broadband method with roughly ±30 µm capture must locate it first. The 168 sensors over-determine the 105 controllable degrees of freedom about 1.6 times. Values are teaching assumptions, not any telescope's specification.

title: 天文雷射導引星
summary: 以約 90 km 高的中氣層鈉層與 ESO VLT 4LGSF 的四道 22 W 鈉雷射為主軸，從 D2 線吸收截面推到每平方公尺每秒的回波光子數，再處理錐效應、無法由雷射量測的 tip-tilt、光點拉長、鈉層高度造成的假離焦與多雷射互擾，最後落到運轉協調與驗收紀錄。
summaryEn: Built around the mesospheric sodium layer near 90 km and the four 22 W sodium lasers of ESO's VLT 4LGSF, this course goes from the D2 absorption cross-section to returned photons per square metre per second, then handles the cone effect, the tip-tilt a laser cannot measure, spot elongation, false defocus from sodium altitude and multi-laser cross-talk, ending with operational coordination and acceptance records.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: LGS 光子與對焦練習：8.2 m 望遠鏡以單道 20 W 鈉雷射在天頂角 30° 觀測。距離 L = 90 km/cos 30° ≈ 104 km、氣團 1.155，單程透過率 0.85^1.155 ≈ 0.83；散射率 = 0.038 × 5.93×10¹⁹ × 0.83 ≈ 1.87×10¹⁸ s⁻¹；地面通量 = 1.87×10¹⁸/(4π × (1.04×10⁵ m)²) × 0.83 ≈ 1.1×10⁷ photons/(s·m²)，取一半為 5.7×10⁶。0.5 m 子孔徑、1 ms、效率 0.3：約 430 光子/幀，1.2″ 光點的質心雜訊 ≈ (1.2/2.355)/√430 ≈ 25 mas。LGS 感測器焦面位移 δ ≈ 120²/1.04×10⁵ m ≈ 139 mm。tip-tilt 由一顆 R = 17 星提供：1×10⁸ × 300 nm × 10^(−6.8) ≈ 4,750 photons/(s·m²)，乘 51.9 m²、效率 0.2、除以 200 Hz，約 250 光子/幀，0.8″ 光點的傾斜雜訊約 22 mas。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: LGS photon and focus exercise: an 8.2 m telescope uses one 20 W sodium laser at 30° zenith angle. Range L = 90 km/cos 30° ≈ 104 km, airmass 1.155 and one-way transmission 0.85^1.155 ≈ 0.83; scattering rate = 0.038 × 5.93×10¹⁹ × 0.83 ≈ 1.87×10¹⁸ s⁻¹; ground flux = 1.87×10¹⁸/(4π × (1.04×10⁵ m)²) × 0.83 ≈ 1.1×10⁷ photons/(s·m²), halved to 5.7×10⁶ for real losses. A 0.5 m subaperture with 1 ms frames and 0.3 efficiency collects about 430 photons per frame, and a 1.2″ spot gives centroid noise ≈ (1.2/2.355)/√430 ≈ 25 mas. The LGS sensor sits δ ≈ 120²/1.04×10⁵ m ≈ 139 mm behind the natural-star focus. Tip-tilt comes from an R = 17 star: 1×10⁸ × 300 nm × 10^(−6.8) ≈ 4,750 photons/(s·m²), times 51.9 m² and 0.2 efficiency, divided by 200 Hz, gives about 250 photons per frame and about 22 mas tilt noise for a 0.8″ spot. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

title: 天文高解析光譜儀
summary: 以 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 這類光纖饋入、真空溫控的階梯光柵光譜儀為對象，說明為何 1 m/s 的恆星速度只相當於偵測器上 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，再把階梯光柵與交叉色散、光展量與擾頻、環境穩定、ThAr／標準具／頻率梳校正、CCD 系統誤差與重心修正整合成可驗收的徑向速度量測鏈。
summaryEn: Using fibre-fed, vacuum-stabilised echelle spectrographs such as HARPS and ESPRESSO, show why a 1 m/s stellar velocity is only an 18.7 nm line shift on the detector, then integrate echelle and cross-dispersion, étendue and scrambling, environmental stability, ThAr, etalon and comb calibration, CCD systematics and barycentric correction into an acceptable radial-velocity measurement chain.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 徑向速度預算練習：設計 R = 140 000、λ = 550 nm，每解析元素取樣 4 個 10 µm 像素，每像素 535 m/s，1 m/s = 18.7 nm。8.2 m 望遠鏡、1″ 光纖、R4 光柵需要 d_col = 140 000×4.85×10⁻⁶×8.2/8 = 0.70 m 的準直光束。環境：0.1 m 鋁支架在 1 mK 漂移下貢獻 0.12 m/s，10⁻⁵ hPa 的穩定真空貢獻 0.8 mm/s 可忽略。光子雜訊：Q = 15 000、N_e = 4×10⁹，σ = 3×10⁸/(15 000×6.32×10⁴) = 0.32 m/s。加入校正 0.10、光纖 0.10、偵測器 0.10、熱機構 0.12 m/s，總 RSS = √(0.316² + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0144) = 0.38 m/s。要以 5σ 偵測半振幅 K = 0.09 m/s 的地球類行星，約需 N = 2×(5×0.38/0.09)² ≈ 890 次獨立量測，且尚未計入恆星活動。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Radial-velocity budget exercise: design for R = 140 000 at λ = 550 nm with four 10 µm pixels per resolution element, giving 535 m/s per pixel and 1 m/s = 18.7 nm. An 8.2 m telescope with a 1″ fibre and an R4 grating needs a collimated beam d_col = 140 000×4.85×10⁻⁶×8.2/8 = 0.70 m. Environment: a 0.1 m aluminium mount drifting 1 mK contributes 0.12 m/s, while a stable 10⁻⁵ hPa vacuum contributes a negligible 0.8 mm/s. Photon noise with Q = 15 000 and N_e = 4×10⁹ is σ = 3×10⁸/(15 000×6.32×10⁴) = 0.32 m/s. Adding calibration 0.10, fibre 0.10, detector 0.10 and thermo-mechanical 0.12 m/s gives a total RSS of √(0.316² + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0144) = 0.38 m/s. Detecting an Earth analogue with semi-amplitude K = 0.09 m/s at 5σ then needs about N = 2×(5×0.38/0.09)² ≈ 890 independent measurements, before stellar activity is considered. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

title: 天文干涉儀光程控制
summary: 以 ESO VLTI（GRAVITY，四台望遠鏡、K 波段）與 CHARA 陣列（六台 1 m 望遠鏡、331 m 基線）為對象，從相干長度與地球自轉造成的光程差變化出發，建立延遲線機構、雷射計量、條紋追蹤、可見度校正與天體測量誤差預算的完整工程鏈。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 光程控制練習：假設 VLTI 基線 B = 130 m、K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm、Δλ = 0.4 µm。相干長度 L_c = λ²/Δλ = 12.1 µm；地球自轉造成的最大延遲率 ω_E·B = 7.29e−5×130 = 9.5 mm/s，1 kHz 迴路每週期改變 9.5 µm。若 0.5 µm 的 τ₀ = 3 ms，K 波段 τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 = 17.8 ms；迴路延遲 3 ms 時 σ_φ² = (3/17.8)^(5/3) = 0.052 rad²，殘餘光程差 ≈ 0.23×2.2/(2π) µm ≈ 80 nm，條紋對比因子 exp(−0.026) ≈ 0.97。要達到 10 µas 天體測量，差分光程需量到 4.85e−11×130 m = 6.3 nm；若每秒雜訊 50 nm，1800 s 平均後 1.2 nm，統計上足夠，但基線誤差 1 mm 仍留下 7.7 µas 的系統下限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Path-control exercise: assume a VLTI baseline B = 130 m, K band λ = 2.2 µm, Δλ = 0.4 µm. Coherence length L_c = λ²/Δλ = 12.1 µm; the maximum Earth-rotation delay rate ω_E·B = 7.29e−5×130 = 9.5 mm/s, so a 1 kHz loop sees 9.5 µm per cycle. If τ₀ = 3 ms at 0.5 µm, the K-band τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 = 17.8 ms; with a 3 ms loop latency σ_φ² = (3/17.8)^(5/3) = 0.052 rad², the residual OPD ≈ 0.23×2.2/(2π) µm ≈ 80 nm and the contrast factor exp(−0.026) ≈ 0.97. For 10 µas astrometry the differential OPD must be measured to 4.85e−11×130 m = 6.3 nm; with 50 nm per-second noise, 1800 s of averaging gives 1.2 nm, statistically sufficient, but a 1 mm baseline error still leaves a 7.7 µas systematic floor. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 雜訊鏈練習：假設饋源與正交模轉換器在 15 K、損耗 0.3 dB（L = 1.072），第一級低溫 HEMT T₁ = 3 K、G₁ = 35 dB（3162），第二級室溫放大器 T₂ = 150 K。前端損耗貢獻 (L−1)×15 = 1.08 K，Friis 級聯 T_rx = 1.08 + 1.072×(3 + 150/3162) = 1.08 + 3.27 = 4.35 K。加上天空 5 K、地面溢出 3 K、宇宙微波背景 2.7 K，Tsys ≈ 15 K。對 GBT（A_eff ≈ 5500 m²）SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×15/5500 = 7.5e−26 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ = 7.5 Jy；以 B = 100 MHz、τ = 60 s 積分，流量靈敏度 ΔS = 7.5/√(1e8×60) = 97 µJy。若前端損耗增加到 1 dB（L = 1.259），T_rx 升到 3.9 + 1.259×3.05 = 7.7 K，Tsys 變成約 18 K，相同靈敏度需要的時間增加 (18/15)² = 1.44 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-chain exercise: assume the feed and orthomode transducer at 15 K with 0.3 dB loss (L = 1.072), a first-stage cryogenic HEMT with T₁ = 3 K and G₁ = 35 dB (3162), and a room-temperature second stage with T₂ = 150 K. The front-end loss contributes (L−1)×15 = 1.08 K and the Friis cascade gives T_rx = 1.08 + 1.072×(3 + 150/3162) = 1.08 + 3.27 = 4.35 K. Adding 5 K of sky, 3 K of ground spillover and 2.7 K of cosmic microwave background gives Tsys ≈ 15 K. For the GBT (A_eff ≈ 5500 m²) SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×15/5500 = 7.5e−26 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ = 7.5 Jy; integrating B = 100 MHz for τ = 60 s gives a flux sensitivity ΔS = 7.5/√(1e8×60) = 97 µJy. If the front-end loss grows to 1 dB (L = 1.259), T_rx rises to 3.9 + 1.259×3.05 = 7.7 K, Tsys becomes about 18 K and the time for the same sensitivity grows by (18/15)² = 1.44. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

title: 電波陣列相關器
summary: 以 ALMA 的 64 天線基線相關器與 VLA 的 WIDAR 相關器為參照，說明可見度如何由兩天線電壓的互相關產生、幾何延遲與條紋旋轉如何即時補償、3 位元量化與 FX 架構如何決定靈敏度與運算量，再把相位／頻帶校正、時脈分配與端到端驗收整理成可交接的工程紀錄。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 相關器預算練習：設 N = 64 台天線，基線數 64×63/2 = 2016。最長基線 16 km 的延遲變化率 ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16000/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s，230 GHz 的條紋頻率 ≈ 900 Hz；2 GHz 頻寬要把相干損失壓在 1% 以內，殘餘延遲需 ≤ 0.245/(π×2e9) = 39 ps，小於 250 ps 的取樣週期，所以要做分數延遲。3 位元量化效率 0.96。複數乘加速率 = 2016×4 極化×8 GHz = 6.5e13 次/s。影像靈敏度：43 台天線、SEFD 2600 Jy、7.5 GHz、1 小時，σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] ≈ 12 µJy；若改用 2 位元（η_q = 0.88），同樣靈敏度需要 (0.96/0.88)² = 1.19 倍的時間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Correlator budget exercise: take N = 64 antennas, giving 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines. On the 16 km longest baseline the delay rate is ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16000/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s and the fringe frequency at 230 GHz ≈ 900 Hz; keeping the coherence loss over 2 GHz below 1% needs a residual delay ≤ 0.245/(π×2e9) = 39 ps, smaller than the 250 ps sampling period, hence fractional delay. The 3-bit quantisation efficiency is 0.96. The complex multiply-accumulate rate is 2016×4 polarisations×8 GHz = 6.5e13 per second. Image sensitivity: with 43 antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, 7.5 GHz and 1 hour, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] ≈ 12 µJy; switching to 2 bits (η_q = 0.88) would need (0.96/0.88)² = 1.19 times longer for the same sensitivity. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

title: 重力波干涉儀懸吊
summary: 以 Advanced LIGO 的四級擺（40 kg 熔融石英測試質量、0.4 mm 石英纖維）與 Virgo 的超級衰減器為對象，從地面震動與 10⁻¹⁹ m 的位移目標出發，推導單擺 1/f² 與四級 1/f⁸ 的傳遞函數、擺動稀釋後的熱雜訊、葉片彈簧垂直隔振與致動層級，再整合局部阻尼、雜訊預算、真空安裝與鎖定取得，最後落到懸吊驗收與交接。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 懸吊熱雜訊與隔振練習：40 kg 測試質量由 4 根直徑 0.4 mm、長 0.6 m 的熔融石英纖維吊起。每根張力 98 N，截面 1.26×10⁻⁷ m²，應力 780 MPa。E = 72 GPa、I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴，稀釋因子 D ≈ √(EI/T)/l = 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³；取材料損耗 φ_mat = 10⁻⁷，φ_pend = 1.6×10⁻¹⁰。f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz，ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s。10 Hz 的熱雜訊 x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵) = 4×1.38×10⁻²³×293×16×1.6×10⁻¹⁰/(40×62.8⁵) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³⁹ m²/Hz，x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz，對 4 km 臂長 h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz。隔振：單級 10 Hz 衰減 (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³，四級理想 3×10⁻¹⁰；垂直路徑 (2.5/10)⁸×10⁻³ = 1.5×10⁻⁸ 反而主導，所以垂直隔振才是真正的瓶頸。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Suspension thermal-noise and isolation exercise: a 40 kg test mass hangs from 4 fused-silica fibres of 0.4 mm diameter and 0.6 m length. Each carries 98 N over 1.26×10⁻⁷ m², a stress of 780 MPa. With E = 72 GPa and I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴ the dilution factor D ≈ √(EI/T)/l = 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³; taking a material loss φ_mat = 10⁻⁷ gives φ_pend = 1.6×10⁻¹⁰. f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz, ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s. The thermal noise at 10 Hz, x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵) = 4×1.38×10⁻²³×293×16×1.6×10⁻¹⁰/(40×62.8⁵) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³⁹ m²/Hz, gives x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, or h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz over a 4 km arm. Isolation: one stage attenuates (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³ at 10 Hz and four ideal stages 3×10⁻¹⁰, but the vertical path (2.5/10)⁸×10⁻³ = 1.5×10⁻⁸ dominates, so vertical isolation is the real bottleneck. Values are teaching assumptions, not any detector's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 紅外陣列操作練習：長波 HgCdTe 陣列 x = 0.30 在 T = 40 K 的能隙 E_g = −0.302 + 0.579 + 0.0086 − 0.0729 + 0.0225 = 0.235 eV，λ_c = 1.24/0.235 = 5.27 µm。擴散暗電流 ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT)，從 77 K 降到 60 K 的比值 (60/77)³×e^(−10) ≈ 2×10⁻⁵，但 40 K 實測地板約 0.035 e⁻/s。讀出：單次讀取雜訊 11.2 e⁻，up-the-ramp N = 93 時 σ = 11.2×√[12×92/(93×94)] = 11.2×0.355 = 4.0 e⁻；若每次讀取有 0.5 e⁻ 輝光，93 次累積 46 e⁻、散粒雜訊 6.8 e⁻，已超過省下的讀出雜訊。背景極限：σ_read = 7 e⁻、背景 2 e⁻/s 時 t = 49/2 = 25 s。線束：100 條磷青銅線 6.6 mW，銅線 264 mW。前次 80,000 e⁻ 曝光留下 0.1% = 80 e⁻ 的潛影，在 1000 s 內為 0.08 e⁻/s，比暗電流還大。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Infrared-array operating exercise: a long-wave HgCdTe array with x = 0.30 at T = 40 K has E_g = −0.302 + 0.579 + 0.0086 − 0.0729 + 0.0225 = 0.235 eV and λ_c = 1.24/0.235 = 5.27 µm. Diffusion dark current ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT) falls by (60/77)³×e^(−10) ≈ 2×10⁻⁵ from 77 K to 60 K, yet the measured floor at 40 K is about 0.035 e⁻/s. Readout: single-read noise 11.2 e⁻; up-the-ramp with N = 93 gives σ = 11.2×√[12×92/(93×94)] = 11.2×0.355 = 4.0 e⁻; with 0.5 e⁻ of glow per read, 93 reads accumulate 46 e⁻ whose shot noise of 6.8 e⁻ exceeds the read noise saved. Background limit: with σ_read = 7 e⁻ and a 2 e⁻/s background, t = 49/2 = 25 s. Harness: 100 phosphor-bronze wires 6.6 mW, copper 264 mW. A previous 80,000 e⁻ exposure leaves 0.1% = 80 e⁻ of latent charge, 0.08 e⁻/s over 1000 s, larger than the dark current. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 單光子接收通道練習：1550 nm 光子 E = 0.80 eV。16 µm 方形曲折線長 1.28 mm、12 800 個方塊、L_k = 1.02 µH，接 50 Ω 得 τ = 20.5 ns，90% 恢復需 47 ns；在 10 Mcps 下約 37% 的光子落在恢復期內，因此實際應用把計數率限制在 1 Mcps（4.6%）或改用交錯式多像素。效率校正：12.8 fW（10⁵ 光子/s）入射得 93 000 cps，扣除 100 cps 暗計數後 SDE = 0.929 ± 0.015。雜訊：DCR = 10 cps 時 NEP = 1.28×10⁻¹⁹×√20/0.93 = 6.2×10⁻¹⁹ W/√Hz。時間：σ = √(7.5² + 3² + 1²) = 8.1 ps，FWHM 19.2 ps，對應光達距離解析度 1.2 mm。若晶片溫度由 2.5 K 漂到 2.6 K，固定偏置由 0.900 升到 0.906 Ic，暗計數約增 1.6 倍至 16 cps，NEP 增為 √1.6 ≈ 1.26 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Single-photon receiver channel exercise: a 1550 nm photon has E = 0.80 eV. A 16 µm square meander 1.28 mm long with 12 800 squares has L_k = 1.02 µH, and into 50 Ω gives τ = 20.5 ns with 90% recovery after 47 ns; at 10 Mcps about 37% of photons land in the recovery window, so the application either limits count rate to 1 Mcps (4.6%) or moves to an interleaved multi-pixel design. Efficiency calibration: 12.8 fW (10⁵ photons per second) yields 93 000 cps, and subtracting 100 cps dark gives SDE = 0.929 ± 0.015. Noise: at DCR = 10 cps, NEP = 1.28×10⁻¹⁹×√20/0.93 = 6.2×10⁻¹⁹ W/√Hz. Timing: σ = √(7.5² + 3² + 1²) = 8.1 ps, FWHM 19.2 ps, a lidar range resolution of 1.2 mm. If the chip drifts from 2.5 K to 2.6 K, the fixed bias moves from 0.900 to 0.906 Ic, dark counts grow about 1.6 times to 16 cps and NEP rises by √1.6 ≈ 1.26. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 暗弱源曝光規劃練習：窄頻濾鏡下目標每像素 0.02 e⁻/s、天光 0.05 e⁻/s，曝光 900 s，得 S = 18 e⁻、天光 45 e⁻。情境 A：−80 °C（暗電流 0.00013 e⁻/px/s，累積 0.12 e⁻）、50 kHz 讀出雜訊 2.9 e⁻，SNR = 18/√(18 + 45 + 0.12 + 8.41) = 18/8.46 = 2.13。情境 B：改用 1 MHz 讀出（7.0 e⁻），SNR = 18/√(112.1) = 1.70。情境 C：只冷到 −40 °C（約 0.0118 e⁻/px/s，累積 10.6 e⁻）、2.9 e⁻，SNR = 18/9.06 = 1.99。若在 A 條件下做晶片上 2×2 合併，SNR = 72/√(72 + 180 + 0.47 + 8.41) = 4.46，比軟體合併的 4.26 只多 5%，因為此時天光已主導雜訊。代價是 2048² 影像以 50 kHz 讀出需 84 s，1 MHz 只需 4.2 s。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Faint-source exposure-planning exercise: through a narrowband filter the target gives 0.02 e⁻/s per pixel and the sky 0.05 e⁻/s; a 900 s exposure yields S = 18 e⁻ and 45 e⁻ of sky. Case A: −80 °C (dark 0.00013 e⁻/px/s, 0.12 e⁻ accumulated) with 2.9 e⁻ read noise at 50 kHz gives SNR = 18/√(18 + 45 + 0.12 + 8.41) = 18/8.46 = 2.13. Case B: 1 MHz readout with 7.0 e⁻ gives SNR = 18/√(112.1) = 1.70. Case C: cooling only to −40 °C (about 0.0118 e⁻/px/s, 10.6 e⁻) with 2.9 e⁻ gives SNR = 18/9.06 = 1.99. Binning 2×2 on chip under case A gives SNR = 72/√(72 + 180 + 0.47 + 8.41) = 4.46, only 5% above the 4.26 of software binning because sky noise now dominates. The cost is readout time: a 2048² frame needs 84 s at 50 kHz but only 4.2 s at 1 MHz. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 低光螢光成像的 SNR 預算練習：假設曝光 5 ms，每像素收到 50 個光子。背照式 sCMOS（QE 0.95、讀出雜訊 1.0 e⁻、暗電流 0.7 e⁻/px/s）：訊號 S = 47.5 e⁻，暗電荷 0.7×0.005 = 0.0035 e⁻ 可忽略，SNR = 47.5/√(47.5 + 0.0035 + 1.0²) = 47.5/6.96 = 6.8。前照式感測器（QE 0.60、讀出雜訊 1.6 e⁻）：S = 30 e⁻，SNR = 30/√(30 + 2.56) = 30/5.71 = 5.3。若實驗要求 SNR ≥ 20，背照式需要平均 (20/6.8)² ≈ 8.6，即 9 張；前照式需要 (20/5.3)² ≈ 14.2，即 15 張。再檢查快門：2304 列、列時間 10 µs 的偏斜為 23 ms，大於 5 ms 的曝光，所以不存在所有列同時曝光的窗口，脈衝照明必須改用全域重置模式或連續照明。數值為教學假設，不代表任何特定相機的規格。
workedExample.textEn: SNR-budget exercise for low-light fluorescence: assume a 5 ms exposure with 50 photons per pixel. A back-illuminated sCMOS with QE 0.95, read noise 1.0 electron and dark current 0.7 electron per pixel per second gives S = 47.5 electrons, a negligible dark charge of 0.7×0.005 = 0.0035 electron, and SNR = 47.5/√(47.5 + 0.0035 + 1.0²) = 47.5/6.96 = 6.8. A front-illuminated sensor with QE 0.60 and read noise 1.6 electrons gives S = 30 electrons and SNR = 30/√(30 + 2.56) = 30/5.71 = 5.3. If the experiment needs SNR ≥ 20, the back-illuminated camera must average (20/6.8)² ≈ 8.6, so 9 frames, while the front-illuminated one needs (20/5.3)² ≈ 14.2, so 15 frames. Then check the shutter: 2304 rows at a 10 µs line time give a skew of 23 ms, longer than the 5 ms exposure, so no window exists in which all rows are exposed together and pulsed illumination must switch to a global-reset mode or continuous light. Values are teaching assumptions, not the specification of any particular camera.

workedExample.text: 亮度與事件率練習：取每團 N = 1.15×10¹¹ 個質子、n_b = 2808 團、f_rev = 11,245 Hz、γ = 7461、ε_n = 3.75 µm、β* = 0.55 m、交叉角因子 F = 0.84。對撞點束流尺寸 σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 1.66×10⁻⁵ m = 16.6 µm。亮度 L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F = 1.3225×10²²×2808×11245×7461/(2.59×10⁻⁵)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹。取非彈性截面 σ_inel = 80 mb = 8×10⁻²⁶ cm²，事件率 = L×σ = 8×10⁸ 次/秒；每秒交叉次數 = 2808×11,245 = 3.16×10⁷，所以每次交叉平均約 25 個事件（堆疊）。一小時的積分亮度 = 1.0×10³⁴×3600 = 3.6×10³⁷ cm⁻² = 36 pb⁻¹。束流儲存能量 = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7×10¹² eV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ = 362 MJ。數值為設計參數等級的教學假設，不代表任何特定運轉填充。
workedExample.textEn: Luminosity and event-rate exercise: take N = 1.15×10¹¹ protons per bunch, n_b = 2808 bunches, f_rev = 11,245 Hz, γ = 7461, ε_n = 3.75 µm, β* = 0.55 m and a crossing-angle factor F = 0.84. The beam size at the interaction point is σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 1.66×10⁻⁵ m = 16.6 µm. The luminosity L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F = 1.3225×10²²×2808×11245×7461/(2.59×10⁻⁵)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹. With an inelastic cross-section σ_inel = 80 mb = 8×10⁻²⁶ cm², the event rate is L×σ = 8×10⁸ per second; crossings per second are 2808×11,245 = 3.16×10⁷, so each crossing carries about 25 events on average (pile-up). One hour integrates 1.0×10³⁴×3600 = 3.6×10³⁷ cm⁻² = 36 pb⁻¹. The stored beam energy is 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7×10¹² eV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ = 362 MJ. Values are teaching assumptions at the level of design parameters, not any particular operating fill.

workedExample.text: Linac4 束流鏈練習：λ = c/352.2 MHz = 0.851 m。H⁻ 在 45 keV、3、50、160 MeV 的 β 為 0.00979、0.0797、0.314、0.520，單元長度 βλ 從 8.3 mm 增到 44.2 cm（π 模 22.1 cm）。40 mA 束流的廣義導流係數由 45 keV 的 2.7×10⁻³ 降到 3 MeV 的 5.0×10⁻⁶，說明 RFQ 為何必須放在最前面。飛行時間：50 MeV、5 m 路徑 53.13 ns，0.1 MeV 改變 49 ps 即 6.2°。PSB：β·γ² 從 50 MeV 的 0.348 增到 160 MeV 的 0.712，比值 2.04；迴轉頻率 0.992 MHz，每環注入 100 µs 約 99 圈、25 mA 給 1.56×10¹³ 個質子。損失：平均功率 4.0 MW × 400 µs × 0.83 Hz = 1328 W，每公尺損失比例須小於 7.5×10⁻⁴。可用率：20 座 RF 站各 99.5% 加離子源 99% 得 0.896。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Linac4 beam-chain exercise: λ = c/352.2 MHz = 0.851 m. H⁻ at 45 keV, 3, 50 and 160 MeV has β = 0.00979, 0.0797, 0.314 and 0.520, so cell length βλ grows from 8.3 mm to 44.2 cm, or 22.1 cm for a π-mode cell. The generalised perveance of a 40 mA beam falls from 2.7×10⁻³ at 45 keV to 5.0×10⁻⁶ at 3 MeV, which is why the RFQ must come first. Time of flight: at 50 MeV a 5 m path takes 53.13 ns and a 0.1 MeV change moves it by 49 ps, or 6.2°. PSB: β·γ² rises from 0.348 at 50 MeV to 0.712 at 160 MeV, a ratio of 2.04; the revolution frequency is 0.992 MHz, so a 100 µs injection per ring spans about 99 turns and 25 mA delivers 1.56×10¹³ protons. Losses: average power 4.0 MW × 400 µs × 0.83 Hz = 1328 W, so fractional loss must stay below 7.5×10⁻⁴ per metre. Availability: 20 RF stations at 99.5% each with a 99% source give 0.896. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.

workedExample.text: 斜坡設計練習：SPS 周長 6911.5 m、ρ = 741.3 m，從 26 GeV/c 加速到 450 GeV/c，Bρ 由 86.7 增到 1501 T·m，B 由 0.117 增到 2.02 T。假設平均斜率 Ḃ = 0.2 T/s：斜坡時間 = (2.025 − 0.117)/0.2 ≈ 9.5 s；每圈能量增益 ΔE = e·ρ·Ḃ·C = 741.3×0.2×6911.5 ≈ 1.02 MeV；f_rev = 43.38 kHz，斜坡約 9.5×43 380 ≈ 4.1×10⁵ 圈，4.1×10⁵×1.02 MeV ≈ 424 GeV，與 450 − 26 = 424 GeV/c 的動量增量一致。若可用射頻電壓為 7 MV（假設），同步相位 sin φs = 1.02/7 ≈ 0.146，φs ≈ 8.4°，仍保留足夠的桶面積；把 Ḃ 提高到 0.4 T/s 則 ΔE ≈ 2.05 MeV、sin φs ≈ 0.29，桶面積明顯縮小，大強度束流更易失捕。數值為教學假設，不代表實際運轉設定。
workedExample.textEn: Ramp-design exercise: with C = 6911.5 m and ρ = 741.3 m, accelerating from 26 GeV/c to 450 GeV/c raises Bρ from 86.7 to 1501 T·m and B from 0.117 to 2.02 T. Assuming an average Ḃ = 0.2 T/s, the ramp lasts (2.025 − 0.117)/0.2 ≈ 9.5 s; the energy gain per turn is ΔE = e·ρ·Ḃ·C = 741.3×0.2×6911.5 ≈ 1.02 MeV; at f_rev = 43.38 kHz the ramp spans about 9.5×43 380 ≈ 4.1×10⁵ turns, and 4.1×10⁵×1.02 MeV ≈ 424 GeV matches the 450 − 26 = 424 GeV/c momentum gain. With 7 MV of RF voltage (assumed) the synchronous phase is sin φs = 1.02/7 ≈ 0.146, φs ≈ 8.4°, leaving ample bucket area; raising Ḃ to 0.4 T/s gives ΔE ≈ 2.05 MeV and sin φs ≈ 0.29, visibly shrinking the bucket so high-intensity beam is more easily lost. Values are teaching assumptions, not operational settings.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 減速平台規劃練習：PS 送來的束團長 25 ns、全寬動量分散約 6%（教學假設）。縱向相空間面積守恆，束團旋轉把長度拉到 150 ns 時，理想 Δp/p = 25×6%/150 = 1%，實測約 1.5%，差額來自射頻非線性與絲化。隨機冷卻把 Δp/p 壓到約 0.07% 後才減速；若在 Δp 近似不變下直接從 3.57 減到 0.1 GeV/c，Δp/p 會放大 3.57/0.1 = 35.7 倍，由 0.07% 變成 2.5%，遠超出環的動量接受度，因此每個平台都要再冷卻。100 MeV/c 冷卻後 Δp/p ≈ 0.01%，非相對論近似 ΔT/T ≈ 2Δp/p，5.31 MeV 的動能分散約 2×10⁻⁴×5.31 MeV ≈ 1.1 keV；ELENA 在 100 keV 引出時 Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³，ΔT ≈ 2×2.5×10⁻³×100 keV = 0.5 keV。相較之下，以箔片把 5.3 MeV 直接降能時出口能譜寬達數百 keV，只有很小比例落在阱可捕捉的 keV 窗口。數值為教學假設，不代表實機設定。
workedExample.textEn: Deceleration-plateau exercise: bunches from the PS are 25 ns long with a full momentum spread of about 6% (teaching assumption). Longitudinal phase-space area is conserved, so rotating the bunch to 150 ns ideally gives Δp/p = 25×6%/150 = 1%, while about 1.5% is measured, the difference coming from RF nonlinearity and filamentation. Stochastic cooling brings Δp/p to about 0.07% before deceleration; decelerating straight from 3.57 to 0.1 GeV/c with Δp roughly constant would multiply Δp/p by 3.57/0.1 = 35.7, from 0.07% to 2.5%, far beyond the ring's momentum acceptance, which is why every plateau cools again. After cooling at 100 MeV/c, Δp/p ≈ 0.01%; non-relativistically ΔT/T ≈ 2Δp/p, so the 5.31 MeV kinetic-energy spread is about 2×10⁻⁴×5.31 MeV ≈ 1.1 keV; ELENA extracts at 100 keV with Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³, giving ΔT ≈ 2×2.5×10⁻³×100 keV = 0.5 keV. By contrast, degrading 5.3 MeV directly in a foil produces an exit spectrum hundreds of keV wide, of which only a small fraction lands in the trappable keV window. Values are teaching assumptions, not machine settings.

workedExample.text: 頂注與光學熱穩定練習：假設光束線第一面反射鏡在 500 mA 時吸收 200 W，熱致斜率靈敏度 0.05 µrad/W，鏡面到樣品 30 m，聚焦光點 5 µm。衰減模式下壽命 τ = 10 h，4 h 後電流 I = 500×e^(−0.4) ≈ 335 mA，吸收功率變化 200×0.33 ≈ 66 W，鏡面斜率變化 66×0.05 ≈ 3.3 µrad，反射光偏角加倍為 6.6 µrad，在 30 m 外光點移動 6.6×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 198 µm，是光點尺寸的 40 倍。頂注每 2 min 補注一次時電流起伏 ΔI/I ≈ 0.33%，功率變化 0.67 W，斜率 0.033 µrad，光點移動約 2 µm，小於光點的一半。補注所需電荷 ΔQ = 1.67 mA×1.729 µs ≈ 2.9 nC。數值為教學假設，不代表 TPS 實際光束線規格。
workedExample.textEn: Top-up and optics thermal-stability exercise: assume the first beamline mirror absorbs 200 W at 500 mA, has a thermal slope sensitivity of 0.05 µrad/W, sits 30 m from the sample and focuses to a 5 µm spot. In decay mode with τ = 10 h, after 4 h the current is I = 500×e^(−0.4) ≈ 335 mA, the absorbed power changes by 200×0.33 ≈ 66 W, the mirror slope by 66×0.05 ≈ 3.3 µrad and the reflected beam by twice that, 6.6 µrad, moving the spot 6.6×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 198 µm at 30 m, forty times the spot size. With top-up every 2 min the current ripple is ΔI/I ≈ 0.33%, the power change 0.67 W, the slope change 0.033 µrad and the spot motion about 2 µm, less than half the spot. Each top-up needs ΔQ = 1.67 mA×1.729 µs ≈ 2.9 nC. Values are teaching assumptions, not TPS beamline specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 能量提升練習：TLS 由 1.3 GeV 提升到 1.5 GeV（ρ = 3.495 m 不變）。B 由 1.24 T 升到 1.43 T；E_c = 2.218E³/ρ 由 1.39 keV 升到 2.14 keV；U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ 由 72 keV 升到 128 keV，300 mA 時偶極輻射功率由 21.7 kW 升到 38.4 kW。8 keV 光子的偶極通量 dN/dθ = 2.457×10¹³·E·I·G₁(y)（photons/s/mrad/0.1%BW），y = 8/E_c：1.3 GeV 時 y = 5.74、G₁ ≈ 0.0108，通量 ≈ 1.0×10¹¹；1.5 GeV 時 y = 3.74、G₁ ≈ 0.0670，通量 ≈ 7.4×10¹¹，能量只提高 15%，8 keV 通量卻提高約 7.2 倍。代價是發射度按 E² 由 19.2 增為 25.6 nm·rad，而水平阻尼時間 τ_x = 2ET₀/U₀ 由 14.4 ms 縮短為 9.4 ms。數值依公開參數與教學假設計算，不代表實際運轉紀錄。
workedExample.textEn: Energy-upgrade exercise: TLS goes from 1.3 GeV to 1.5 GeV with ρ = 3.495 m unchanged. B rises from 1.24 T to 1.43 T; E_c = 2.218E³/ρ from 1.39 keV to 2.14 keV; U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ from 72 keV to 128 keV, so dipole radiation at 300 mA grows from 21.7 kW to 38.4 kW. Bending-magnet flux at 8 keV is dN/dθ = 2.457×10¹³·E·I·G₁(y) photons/s/mrad/0.1%BW with y = 8/E_c: at 1.3 GeV, y = 5.74, G₁ ≈ 0.0108 and the flux ≈ 1.0×10¹¹; at 1.5 GeV, y = 3.74, G₁ ≈ 0.0670 and the flux ≈ 7.4×10¹¹, so a 15% energy increase raises 8 keV flux about 7.2 times. The price is emittance growing as E² from 19.2 to 25.6 nm·rad, while the horizontal damping time τ_x = 2ET₀/U₀ shortens from 14.4 ms to 9.4 ms. Numbers follow public parameters and teaching assumptions, not operating records.

title: 歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF
summary: 從 6 GeV 電子在 844 m 儲存環中輻射的臨界能量與功率出發，理解 ESRF-EBS 為何以每單元 7 個彎轉磁鐵的混合多彎消色散（HMBA）晶格把水平發射度從約 4 nm·rad 壓到約 130 pm·rad，再把磁鐵、真空、束流位置監測、亮度計算與軌道回授整合成可驗收的光源工程紀錄。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 亮度練習：假設 ESRF-EBS 直線段 β_x = 6.9 m、β_y = 2.7 m，發射度 130 pm×10 pm；電子束 σ_x = 30 µm、σ_x' = 4.3 µrad、σ_y = 5.2 µm、σ_y' = 1.9 µrad。2 m 波盪器、λ_u = 18 mm、K = 1：λ₁ = 0.98 Å（12.7 keV），繞射項 σ_r = √(2λL)/4π ≈ 1.6 µm、σ_r' = √(λ/2L) ≈ 4.9 µrad。合成 Σx = √(30²+1.6²) ≈ 30 µm、Σy = √(5.2²+1.6²) ≈ 5.4 µm、Σx' = √(4.3²+4.9²) ≈ 6.6 µrad、Σy' = √(1.9²+4.9²) ≈ 5.3 µrad。通量 F ≈ 1.43×10¹⁴×111×0.55×0.2 ≈ 1.75×10¹⁵ ph/s/0.1%BW，亮度 B = F/(4π²ΣxΣyΣx'Σy') ≈ 1.75×10¹⁵/(39.5×0.030×0.0054×0.0066×0.0053) ≈ 7.8×10²¹ ph/s/mm²/mrad²/0.1%BW。若換成舊 4 nm 晶格（σ_x ≈ 166 µm、σ_x' ≈ 24 µrad），同一波盪器只得約 3.8×10²⁰，相差約 20 倍，差距全部來自水平相空間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Brilliance exercise: assume an ESRF-EBS straight with β_x = 6.9 m and β_y = 2.7 m and emittances 130 pm by 10 pm, so the electron beam has σ_x = 30 µm, σ_x' = 4.3 µrad, σ_y = 5.2 µm and σ_y' = 1.9 µrad. A 2 m undulator with λ_u = 18 mm and K = 1 gives λ₁ = 0.98 Å (12.7 keV), with diffraction terms σ_r = √(2λL)/4π ≈ 1.6 µm and σ_r' = √(λ/2L) ≈ 4.9 µrad. Combined: Σx = √(30²+1.6²) ≈ 30 µm, Σy = √(5.2²+1.6²) ≈ 5.4 µm, Σx' = √(4.3²+4.9²) ≈ 6.6 µrad, Σy' = √(1.9²+4.9²) ≈ 5.3 µrad. Flux F ≈ 1.43×10¹⁴×111×0.55×0.2 ≈ 1.75×10¹⁵ ph/s/0.1%BW, so brilliance B = F/(4π²ΣxΣyΣx'Σy') ≈ 1.75×10¹⁵/(39.5×0.030×0.0054×0.0066×0.0053) ≈ 7.8×10²¹ ph/s/mm²/mrad²/0.1%BW. On the old 4 nm lattice (σ_x ≈ 166 µm, σ_x' ≈ 24 µrad) the same undulator would give about 3.8×10²⁰, a factor of about 20 that comes entirely from the horizontal phase space. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

title: Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施
summary: 以 Diamond 的 3 GeV、561.6 m、24 單元雙彎消色散儲存環為對象，從 499.68 MHz 射頻與 936 個束團桶出發，理解中能量光源如何靠真空內波盪器的高次諧波取得硬 X 光、如何管理前端熱負載，再推導 Diamond-II 把能量提高到 3.5 GeV 並換成 DTBA 晶格後，發射度、光子能量與光束線必須同步調整的工程邏輯。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 波盪器升級練習：Diamond 一支 2 m、λ_u = 23 mm（N = 87）的真空內波盪器，以經驗式 B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)] 在 g = 6 mm 得 B₀ ≈ 0.90 T，K = 0.934×0.90×2.3 ≈ 1.94。3 GeV 時 γ² = 3.45×10⁷，基頻 λ₁ = 0.023×(1+1.94²/2)/(2×3.45×10⁷) ≈ 9.6 Å（1.29 keV），第 5 諧波約 6.5 keV，第 7 諧波約 9.0 keV。升到 3.5 GeV 後 γ² = 4.69×10⁷，同一間隙的所有諧波乘以 1.36：第 5 諧波變 8.8 keV、第 7 諧波變 12.3 keV。總功率 P = 0.633×E²×B₀²×L×I：3 GeV、0.3 A 時 0.633×9×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 2.8 kW；3.5 GeV 時 0.633×12.25×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 3.8 kW，前端吸收器與單色器冷卻必須按 3.8 kW 重新核算。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Undulator upgrade exercise: a Diamond 2 m in-vacuum undulator with λ_u = 23 mm (N = 87) gives, from the fit B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)], B₀ ≈ 0.90 T at g = 6 mm and K = 0.934×0.90×2.3 ≈ 1.94. At 3 GeV, γ² = 3.45×10⁷ and the fundamental is λ₁ = 0.023×(1+1.94²/2)/(2×3.45×10⁷) ≈ 9.6 Å (1.29 keV), with the 5th harmonic near 6.5 keV and the 7th near 9.0 keV. At 3.5 GeV, γ² = 4.69×10⁷ and every harmonic at the same gap is multiplied by 1.36: the 5th moves to 8.8 keV and the 7th to 12.3 keV. Total power P = 0.633×E²×B₀²×L×I is 0.633×9×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 2.8 kW at 3 GeV and 0.3 A, and 0.633×12.25×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 3.8 kW at 3.5 GeV, so front-end absorbers and monochromator cooling must be re-rated for 3.8 kW. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 降能換週期練習：SPring-8 一支 λ_u = 32 mm、K = 2.2 的真空內波盪器在 8 GeV（γ² = 2.45×10⁸）的基頻 λ₁ = 0.032×(1+2.42)/(2×2.45×10⁸) ≈ 2.23 Å，即 5.55 keV。SPring-8-II 降到 6 GeV（γ² = 1.38×10⁸），同一波盪器基頻變成 5.55×(6/8)² ≈ 3.12 keV。要維持 5.55 keV，可（a）維持 K = 2.2 而把週期縮到 λ_u = 32×0.5625 ≈ 18 mm，或（b）維持 32 mm 而把 (1+K²/2) 降到 3.42×0.5625 ≈ 1.92，即 K ≈ 1.36。同調分率在 1 Å（ε_r = 8 pm）：現行 ε_x = 2400 pm、ε_y = 10 pm → F_c ≈ (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.15%；升級後 ε_x = 50 pm → (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 6.1%，提高約 40 倍，再乘上電流 100→200 mA 的 2 倍，同調通量約提高 80 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Lower-energy period-swap exercise: a SPring-8 in-vacuum undulator with λ_u = 32 mm and K = 2.2 at 8 GeV (γ² = 2.45×10⁸) has fundamental λ₁ = 0.032×(1+2.42)/(2×2.45×10⁸) ≈ 2.23 Å, that is 5.55 keV. After SPring-8-II lowers the energy to 6 GeV (γ² = 1.38×10⁸) the same device gives 5.55×(6/8)² ≈ 3.12 keV. To keep 5.55 keV, either (a) keep K = 2.2 and shorten the period to λ_u = 32×0.5625 ≈ 18 mm, or (b) keep 32 mm and reduce (1+K²/2) to 3.42×0.5625 ≈ 1.92, that is K ≈ 1.36. Coherent fraction at 1 Å (ε_r = 8 pm): present ε_x = 2400 pm and ε_y = 10 pm give F_c ≈ (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.15%; after the upgrade ε_x = 50 pm gives (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 6.1%, about 40 times higher, and the current step from 100 to 200 mA doubles it again, so coherent flux rises about 80-fold. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

title: SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
summary: 以 SLAC 的 LCLS 為對象：常溫銅直線加速器以 120 Hz 提供 13.6 GeV 電子，在 112 m 波盪器中以自放大自發輻射（SASE）產生 1.5 Å 的飛秒 X 光脈衝；本課推導 Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和功率，拆解光陰極注入、束流壓縮與雷射加熱器，再把單發診斷、脈衝統計與 LCLS-II 的 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器（最高 1 MHz）整合成可驗收的工程邏輯。
summaryEn: Taking SLAC's LCLS: a normal-conducting copper linac delivers 13.6 GeV electrons at 120 Hz, and a 112 m undulator produces femtosecond 1.5 Å X-ray pulses by self-amplified spontaneous emission (SASE). The course derives the Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation power, works through the photoinjector, bunch compression and laser heater, then integrates single-shot diagnostics, pulse statistics and the LCLS-II 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac (up to 1 MHz) into an acceptable engineering logic.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: SASE 增益練習：取 LCLS 硬 X 光模式 E = 13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、峰值電流 I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm。共振波長 λ = 0.030×(1+6.125)/(2×7.08×10⁸) ≈ 1.51×10⁻¹⁰ m，即 8.2 keV。Pierce 參數 ρ = [(1/16)(3000/17 045)(3.5²×0.74²)/(26 615³×(30×10⁻⁶)²×209²)]^(1/3) ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。增益長度 L_g = 0.030/(4π×1.732×4.6×10⁻⁴) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m，112 m 的波盪器留有餘裕。飽和功率 P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6×10⁹×3000 ≈ 1.9×10¹⁰ W，30 fs 脈衝能量約 0.57 mJ；頻寬 ≈ ρ×8.2 keV ≈ 3.8 eV；70 fs 全寬脈衝的模式數 M ≈ ρωT/2π ≈ 64，逐發能量抖動約 12%。若歸一化發射度 0.4 µm，幾何發射度 0.4×10⁻⁶/26 615 ≈ 15 pm，略大於 λ/4π ≈ 12 pm，接近繞射極限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: SASE gain exercise: take the LCLS hard X-ray mode with E = 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), peak current I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm. The resonant wavelength is λ = 0.030×(1+6.125)/(2×7.08×10⁸) ≈ 1.51×10⁻¹⁰ m, that is 8.2 keV. The Pierce parameter ρ = [(1/16)(3000/17 045)(3.5²×0.74²)/(26 615³×(30×10⁻⁶)²×209²)]^(1/3) ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. Gain length L_g = 0.030/(4π×1.732×4.6×10⁻⁴) ≈ 3.0 m, saturation after about 20L_g ≈ 60 m, so the 112 m undulator has margin. Saturated power P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6×10⁹×3000 ≈ 1.9×10¹⁰ W, about 0.57 mJ in a 30 fs pulse; bandwidth ≈ ρ×8.2 keV ≈ 3.8 eV; a 70 fs full-width pulse holds M ≈ ρωT/2π ≈ 64 modes with about 12% shot-to-shot energy fluctuation. With a normalised emittance of 0.4 µm the geometric emittance is 0.4×10⁻⁶/26 615 ≈ 15 pm, slightly above λ/4π ≈ 12 pm, close to the diffraction limit. workedExample.text: 操作點練習：使用者要求 SASE1 在 9.0 keV，電子能量 14 GeV（γ ≈ 27,397），λu = 40 mm。λ = 1.2398/9.0 ≈ 0.1378 nm；1 + K²/2 = λ·2γ²/λu ≈ 5.17，所以 K ≈ 2.89，對應峰值磁場 B = K/(0.934×4) ≈ 0.77 T。段間 1.1 m 漂移的落後量為 1.1/(0.040×5.17) ≈ 5.32λ，移相器需補約 0.68λ ≈ 0.094 nm。若電子能量抖動 0.05%，光子能量抖動約 0.1%，即 9 eV。AGIPD 若以每 4 個束團取 1 發（約 889 ns、1.125 MHz）記錄，352 個記憶格涵蓋 352 × 0.889 µs ≈ 313 µs，大約是 600 µs 脈衝列的一半。數值為教學假設，不代表設施的實際設定。
workedExample.textEn: Operating-point exercise: a user asks for 9.0 keV from SASE1 at 14 GeV (γ ≈ 27,397) with λu = 40 mm. λ = 1.2398/9.0 ≈ 0.1378 nm; 1 + K²/2 = λ·2γ²/λu ≈ 5.17, so K ≈ 2.89, a peak field B = K/(0.934×4) ≈ 0.77 T. If AGIPD records every fourth bunch (about 889 ns, 1.125 MHz), its 352 memory cells span 352 × 0.889 µs ≈ 313 µs, roughly half of the 600 µs train. workedExample.text: UT4 自適應光學 K 波段練習：假設 500 nm 的 r₀ = 0.15 m，換算到 2.2 µm 為 r₀ = 0.15 × (2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 0.89 m。擬合誤差以投影間距 0.205 m 計 σ_fit² ≈ 0.28 × (0.205/0.89)^5/3 ≈ 0.024 rad²；風速 15 m/s 時 Greenwood 頻率 f_G = 0.427v/r₀ ≈ 7.2 Hz，假設修正頻寬 60 Hz，時間誤差 σ_t² = (7.2/60)^5/3 ≈ 0.029 rad²；另給雜訊與混疊 0.03 rad²。總和 0.084 rad²，Strehl ≈ exp(−0.084) ≈ 0.92。修正後影像寬約 λ/D ≈ 55 mas，而 K 波段未修正視寧度約 0.50″，相差約 9 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表 VLT 的實際規格。
workedExample.textEn: UT4 adaptive-optics exercise in K band: assume r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm, which scales to r₀ = 0.15 × (2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 0.89 m at 2.2 µm. With a projected pitch of 0.205 m the fitting error is σ_fit² ≈ 0.28 × (0.205/0.89)^5/3 ≈ 0.024 rad²; for a 15 m/s wind the Greenwood frequency is f_G = 0.427v/r₀ ≈ 7.2 Hz, and with an assumed 60 Hz correction bandwidth the temporal error is σ_t² = (7.2/60)^5/3 ≈ 0.029 rad²; allow 0.03 rad² for noise and aliasing. The total is 0.084 rad² and Strehl ≈ exp(−0.084) ≈ 0.92. The corrected image is about λ/D ≈ 55 mas wide, against about 0.50″ of uncorrected K-band seeing, a factor of about 9. workedExample.text: K 波段影像品質預算練習：假設鏡段活塞的波前誤差 20 nm RMS、鏡段面形殘差 20 nm RMS、自適應光學殘差 150 nm RMS，平方和開根號為 √(20² + 20² + 150²) ≈ 153 nm；Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×153/2200)²] = exp(−0.191) ≈ 0.83。再乘上影像移動 2.1 mas 造成的 0.86，總 Strehl ≈ 0.71。若活塞誤差惡化到 80 nm，總和變為 √(80² + 20² + 150²) ≈ 171 nm，Strehl 降到約 0.79 × 0.86 ≈ 0.68；在 1.2 µm 同一組誤差給出 exp[−(2π×171/1200)²] ≈ 0.45（尚未計入抖動），說明短波長對共相更敏感。數值為教學假設，不代表 ELT 規格。
workedExample.textEn: K-band image-quality budget exercise: assume 20 nm RMS wavefront from segment piston, 20 nm RMS segment figure residual and 150 nm RMS adaptive-optics residual. The root-sum-square is √(20² + 20² + 150²) ≈ 153 nm, and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×153/2200)²] = exp(−0.191) ≈ 0.83. Multiplying by 0.86 from 2.1 mas of image motion gives a total Strehl ≈ 0.71. workedExample.text: Band 7 相干性與靈敏度練習（教學假設）：天線面形 ε = 25 µm，在 λ = 0.87 mm 的 Ruze 效率 η_s = exp[−(4π×0.025/0.87)²] = exp(−0.130) = 0.878。WVR 修正後殘餘路徑 15 µm，相位 RMS σ_φ = 2π×0.015/0.87 = 0.108 rad，相干因子 exp(−0.108²/2) = 0.994，總效率 0.878×0.994 = 0.873。若 WVR 失效、殘餘路徑 100 µm，σ_φ = 0.722 rad，相干因子 exp(−0.261) = 0.770，總效率降為 0.878×0.770 = 0.676。以第 7 單元的 0.104 mJy 熱雜訊為基準，等效靈敏度分別為 0.104/0.873 ≈ 0.119 mJy 與 0.104/0.676 ≈ 0.154 mJy，即失去 WVR 修正使偵測同一源所需的整合時間增加 (0.154/0.119)² ≈ 1.7 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表陣列實際規格。
workedExample.textEn: Band 7 coherence and sensitivity exercise (teaching assumptions): with surface error ε = 25 µm the Ruze efficiency at λ = 0.87 mm is η_s = exp[−(4π×0.025/0.87)²] = exp(−0.130) = 0.878. A 15 µm residual path after WVR correction gives phase RMS σ_φ = 2π×0.015/0.87 = 0.108 rad and a coherence factor exp(−0.108²/2) = 0.994, so the total efficiency is 0.878×0.994 = 0.873. If the WVR fails and 100 µm of path remains, σ_φ = 0.722 rad, the coherence factor is exp(−0.261) = 0.770 and the total efficiency falls to 0.878×0.770 = 0.676. Referenced to the 0.104 mJy thermal noise of unit 7, the effective sensitivities are 0.104/0.873 ≈ 0.119 mJy and 0.104/0.676 ≈ 0.154 mJy, so losing the WVR correction multiplies the integration time needed for the same detection by (0.154/0.119)² ≈ 1.7. workedExample.textEn: Image-quality budget exercise (teaching assumptions): atmospheric seeing 0.65″, optical residual 0.20″, tracking jitter 0.08″ RMS (equivalent FWHM 2.355×0.08 = 0.19″), dome seeing 0.10″, and mirror seeing 0.38×0.5^1.2 = 0.38×0.435 = 0.165″ for a mirror ΔT = 0.5 K warmer than the air. Telescope term RSS = √(0.20² + 0.19² + 0.165² + 0.10²) = √0.113 = 0.335″; combined with the atmosphere, FWHM = (0.65^(5/3) + 0.335^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.488 + 0.162)^(0.6) = 0.77″. If daytime temperature control fails and ΔT = 2 K, mirror seeing rises to 0.38×2.30 = 0.87″, the telescope RSS becomes √(0.04 + 0.035 + 0.76 + 0.01) = 0.92″ and the combined FWHM = (0.488 + 0.870)^(0.6) = 1.20″. A 1.5 K mirror temperature excess therefore damages the image far more than polishing the optical residual from 0.20″ to 0.10″ could ever recover. Values are teaching assumptions, not telescope specifications.

workedExample.text: Ks 波段深度練習（教學假設）：零點 24.6 等（1 e⁻/s），天空 13.0 等/arcsec²，像素 0.339″，一顆 Ks = 18.0 的星每秒給 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 18.0)) ≈ 437 e⁻；天空每像素 ≈ 5000 e⁻/s。測光孔徑直徑 2″（面積 3.14 arcsec²，27.3 像素），60 s 總曝光（6 幀各 10 s，讀出雜訊 20 e⁻）：訊號 437×60 = 26200 e⁻；天空 27.3×5000×60 = 8.2×10⁶ e⁻；讀出雜訊變異數 27.3×6×20² ≈ 6.6×10⁴ e⁻²。SNR = 26200/√(26200 + 8.2×10⁶ + 6.6×10⁴) = 26200/2880 ≈ 9.1。5σ 極限星等 ≈ 18.0 + 2.5·log₁₀(9.1/5) ≈ 18.65 等。讀出雜訊只占總變異數的 0.8%，證實為背景極限；要再深 1 等需要 6.3 倍的曝光時間。數值為教學假設，不代表望遠鏡實際規格。
workedExample.textEn: Ks-band depth exercise (teaching assumptions): zero point 24.6 mag for 1 e⁻/s, sky 13.0 mag/arcsec², pixel 0.339″, so a Ks = 18.0 star gives 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 18.0)) ≈ 437 e⁻/s and the sky ≈ 5000 e⁻/s per pixel. For a 2″ photometric aperture (3.14 arcsec², 27.3 pixels) and 60 s total exposure (6 frames of 10 s, read noise 20 e⁻): signal 437×60 = 26200 e⁻; sky 27.3×5000×60 = 8.2×10⁶ e⁻; read-noise variance 27.3×6×20² ≈ 6.6×10⁴ e⁻². SNR = 26200/√(26200 + 8.2×10⁶ + 6.6×10⁴) = 26200/2880 ≈ 9.1. The 5σ limiting magnitude ≈ 18.0 + 2.5·log₁₀(9.1/5) ≈ 18.65 mag. Read noise is only 0.8% of the total variance, confirming the background limit; going 1 magnitude deeper needs 6.3 times the exposure. Values are teaching assumptions, not telescope specifications.

workedExample.text: 100 Hz 雜訊預算練習（教學假設）：量子雜訊以第 5 單元的 3.7×10⁻²⁴/√Hz 為起點，3 dB 壓縮後為 2.6×10⁻²⁴；鍍膜布朗雜訊 3.2×10⁻²⁴；懸吊熱雜訊 0.5×10⁻²⁴；技術雜訊（雷射、控制、散射光）合計 1.0×10⁻²⁴。總雜訊 = √(2.6² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²)×10⁻²⁴ = √18.25×10⁻²⁴ ≈ 4.3×10⁻²⁴/√Hz；若無壓縮則 √(3.7² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²) = √25.2 ≈ 5.0×10⁻²⁴。對一個峰值應變 10⁻²¹、有效頻寬約 100 Hz 的雙黑洞合併訊號，粗估訊噪比 SNR ≈ h/(ASD×√Δf) = 10⁻²¹/(4.3×10⁻²⁴×10) ≈ 23，無壓縮時約 20。這說明壓縮光在此頻段帶來約 15% 的訊噪比提升，但鍍膜熱雜訊才是下一個要攻克的主導項。數值為教學假設，不代表任何觀測運行的實際曲線。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-budget exercise at 100 Hz (teaching assumptions): start from the quantum noise of unit 5, 3.7×10⁻²⁴/√Hz, reduced to 2.6×10⁻²⁴ by 3 dB of squeezing; coating Brownian noise 3.2×10⁻²⁴; suspension thermal noise 0.5×10⁻²⁴; technical noise (laser, control, scattered light) 1.0×10⁻²⁴ in total. Total noise = √(2.6² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²)×10⁻²⁴ = √18.25×10⁻²⁴ ≈ 4.3×10⁻²⁴/√Hz; without squeezing √(3.7² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²) = √25.2 ≈ 5.0×10⁻²⁴. For a binary-black-hole merger with peak strain 10⁻²¹ and an effective bandwidth of about 100 Hz, a rough signal-to-noise ratio is SNR ≈ h/(ASD×√Δf) = 10⁻²¹/(4.3×10⁻²⁴×10) ≈ 23, or about 20 without squeezing. Squeezing therefore buys about 15% in this band, while coating thermal noise is the dominant term to attack next. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual curve of any observing run.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 超級衰減器隔振預算練習（教學假設）：10 Hz 的地面位移 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz。倒立擺調到 0.04 Hz，傳遞率 (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵；五級機械濾波器各 0.4 Hz，傳遞率 (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴；理論總衰減 1.7×10⁻¹⁹，鏡子水平殘餘 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz。實際上交叉耦合把衰減限制在約 10⁻¹²，殘餘 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，對應 h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz，仍比 10 Hz 處約 10⁻²³ 的設計目標低 30 倍。垂直方向：若垂直殘餘也為 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，地球曲率使兩端局部鉛垂線相差 L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad，加上機械失準取總耦合 1%，水平等效為 10⁻²³ m/√Hz，可忽略。結論是 10 Hz 的真正邊界不是地震而是懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊與牛頓雜訊。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Superattenuator isolation-budget exercise (teaching assumptions): ground displacement at 10 Hz is 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz. The inverted pendulum tuned to 0.04 Hz transmits (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵; five mechanical filters at 0.4 Hz each transmit (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴; the theoretical total attenuation is 1.7×10⁻¹⁹ and the residual horizontal mirror motion 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz. In practice cross-couplings cap the attenuation near 10⁻¹², leaving 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, or h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz, still 30 times below the design target of about 10⁻²³ at 10 Hz. Vertically: if the vertical residual is also 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, Earth curvature makes the local verticals at the two ends differ by L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad, and taking 1% total coupling including mechanical misalignment gives a horizontal equivalent of 10⁻²³ m/√Hz, negligible. The conclusion is that the real boundary at 10 Hz is not seismic motion but suspension thermal, control and Newtonian noise. Values are teaching assumptions.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 低溫功率預算練習：設計分光鏡功率 674 W、臂腔精細度 1550，臂內功率 ≈ 674/2 × 2×1550/π ≈ 333 kW。假設輸入測試質量基板吸收 50 ppm/cm、厚 15 cm，鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm，吸收熱 ≈ 337 × 7.5×10⁻⁴ + 333,000 × 5×10⁻⁷ ≈ 0.25 + 0.17 = 0.42 W。四根纖維熱導 G = 4kA/L，取 k = 2000 W/(m·K)、A = 2.0×10⁻⁶ m²、L = 0.35 m，G ≈ 0.046 W/K，溫差 ≈ 9.1 K；上一級 13 K 時鏡面約 22 K。熱雜訊振幅相對室溫降為 √(22/300) ≈ 0.27。若吸收倍增到 100 ppm/cm，熱量 0.67 W、溫差 14.6 K、鏡面約 27.6 K，需把分光鏡功率降到約 420 W 才能守住 22 K，臂內功率變為約 207 kW，散粒雜訊振幅約增為 √(333/207) ≈ 1.27 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表 KAGRA 的實際運轉參數。
workedExample.textEn: Cryogenic power-budget exercise: with the design 674 W at the beam splitter and finesse 1550, arm power ≈ 674/2 × 2×1550/π ≈ 333 kW. Assuming 50 ppm/cm absorption in the 15 cm input test-mass substrate and 0.5 ppm coating absorption, absorbed heat ≈ 337 × 7.5×10⁻⁴ + 333,000 × 5×10⁻⁷ ≈ 0.25 + 0.17 = 0.42 W. The four-fibre conductance G = 4kA/L with k = 2000 W/(m·K), A = 2.0×10⁻⁶ m² and L = 0.35 m is G ≈ 0.046 W/K, giving a temperature difference of about 9.1 K, so with the stage above at 13 K the mirror sits near 22 K. Thermal-noise amplitude relative to room temperature drops to √(22/300) ≈ 0.27. If absorption doubles to 100 ppm/cm, the heat is 0.67 W, the difference 14.6 K and the mirror about 27.6 K; holding 22 K requires cutting beam-splitter power to about 420 W, arm power to about 207 kW, and shot-noise amplitude rises by about √(333/207) ≈ 1.27. Values are teaching assumptions, not KAGRA operating parameters.

workedExample.text: HI 星系偵測練習：在 ζ = 20° 追蹤一個 50 Mpc 外的星系，A_e = 0.63 × π × 150² = 44 532 m²，G = 16.1 K/Jy，T_sys = 24 K，SEFD = 1.49 Jy。通道寬 7.63 kHz 在 1420.4 MHz 相當 1.61 km/s；雙偏振積分 600 s，σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 600) ≈ 0.49 mJy。200 km/s 的譜線涵蓋 124 個通道，積分流量雜訊 0.49 × 1.61 × √124 ≈ 8.8 mJy·km/s，5σ 門檻 0.044 Jy·km/s，對應 M_HI = 2.36×10⁵ × 50² × 0.044 ≈ 2.6×10⁷ 太陽質量。若同一目標只能在 ζ = 40° 觀測，幾何面積比 0.80 使 G 降到 12.9 K/Jy，溢出讓 T_sys 升到 28 K，SEFD 變 2.17 Jy，達到相同 σ 需要 (2.17/1.49)² ≈ 2.1 倍時間，約 1280 s。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: HI galaxy detection exercise: track a galaxy at 50 Mpc at ζ = 20°, with A_e = 0.63 × π × 150² = 44 532 m², G = 16.1 K/Jy, T_sys = 24 K and SEFD = 1.49 Jy. A 7.63 kHz channel at 1420.4 MHz is 1.61 km/s; integrating 600 s in two polarisations gives σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 600) ≈ 0.49 mJy. A 200 km/s line spans 124 channels, so the integrated-flux noise is 0.49 × 1.61 × √124 ≈ 8.8 mJy·km/s and the 5σ threshold is 0.044 Jy·km/s, corresponding to M_HI = 2.36×10⁵ × 50² × 0.044 ≈ 2.6×10⁷ solar masses. If the same target can only be observed at ζ = 40°, the geometric area fraction 0.80 lowers G to 12.9 K/Jy, spillover raises T_sys to 28 K and SEFD becomes 2.17 Jy, so reaching the same σ takes (2.17/1.49)² ≈ 2.1 times longer, about 1280 s. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

summaryEn: Study A350-class airliner integration through original sketches and paper exercises on wing loads, composite directionality, tolerance chains and configuration change.
scope: 12道入門工程學習任務；引用A350公開背景，力學數值為明示教學假設。不是原廠鋪層表、裝配SOP、維修手冊、適航符合性證明或製造授權。
scopeEn: Twelve introductory engineering tasks grounded in public A350 background, with explicitly hypothetical mechanics values. Not manufacturer layup schedules, assembly SOPs, maintenance instructions, airworthiness substantiation or manufacturing authorization.

title: 三峽水電站發電系統
summary: 以巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡解析三峽水電站發電系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System through large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設淨水頭40 m、流量6 m³/s、效率0.88，P=1000×9.81×6×40×0.88=2.071872 MW。另若抽蓄上下流程效率均0.88，往返效率0.7744；高程、流量皆是假想，非場站規格。
workedExample.textEn: Assume net head 40 m, flow 6 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=2.071872 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。

scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設民用熱源 700 MWth、熱電效率 0.32、輔機 8 MWe，淨電=700×0.32−8=216.0 MWe；循環排熱約476.0 MW。僅熱平衡，不含反應性、燃料製造或操作整定。
workedExample.textEn: Assume civil heat input 700 MWth, efficiency 0.32 and auxiliaries 8 MWe: net power 216.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 476.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.

title: EMI早期電腦斷層掃描器工程
titleEn: EMI Early Computed Tomography Scanner Engineering
summary: 從 EMI 早期設備史出發，以數位假體拆解投影、重建與影像品質。
summaryEn: Start with early EMI equipment history and use digital phantoms to study projections, reconstruction and image quality.
scope: 十二步限於設備物理、數位假體與品質追溯。歷史設備與現代 QA 來源分別標示，不推定規格相同。不操作輻射設備、不使用病人資料、不提供診斷、治療或臨床掃描設定；不是醫療設備製造或驗收 SOP。
scopeEn: Twelve tasks cover equipment physics, digital phantoms and quality traceability. Historical equipment and modern QA sources are distinguished without assuming identical specifications. No radiation equipment, patient data, diagnosis, treatment or clinical scan settings are used; this is not a medical-device manufacturing or acceptance SOP.

title: EXPLORER 全身正子影像系統
summary: 以二十四步拆解光子偵測、符合事件、時間同步、校正、重建與研究品質證據。
summaryEn: Twenty-four steps examine photon detection, coincidences, synchronization, correction, reconstruction and research-quality evidence.
scope: 僅以虛構事件表與非人體教學影像學習醫學影像工程，不提供病人診斷、放射性藥物製備、注射量、掃描處方或設備操作。實際醫療由合格專業人員執行。
scopeEn: Learn imaging engineering with synthetic event tables and non-patient teaching images only. No diagnosis, radiopharmaceutical preparation, administered activity, scan prescription or equipment operation is provided; real care requires qualified professionals.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想單次脈衝：到target的雷射能量2 MJ、融合輸出3 MJ，Qtarget=1.5。若wall-plug雷射效率2%，電網驅動需100 MJ；僅回收融合熱且熱電效率35%，輸出1.05 MJ；另有5 MJ輔助輸入，淨能量=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ。未回收雷射熱，皆為假想而非NIF實測；target gain不等於電廠淨電。
workedExample.textEn: Assume one pulse with laser energy 2 MJ at the target and fusion output 3 MJ: Qtarget=1.5. At assumed wall-plug laser efficiency 2%, driver input is 100 MJ. Recovering only fusion heat at 35% gives 1.05 MJ; auxiliaries consume 5 MJ, so net=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ. Laser-heat recovery is omitted; values are hypothetical, not NIF measurements. Target gain is not plant net electricity.
